sanskrit: papraccha girijā kāntaṃ pārvatī vṛṣabhadhvajamsūcitaṃ yoginītantraṃ tanme vada jagadgurovārāṇasyāṃ kāmarūpe [kāmākhyāyāṃ] nepāle mandarācalepāvanaṃ paramaṃ dhanyaṃ mokṣaikaphaladāyakamyathānyo labhate naivaṃ tathā kuru priyaṃvadekāṅkṣanti devatāḥ sarvāḥ śrotuṃ tantramanuttamamkathayāmi tava snehāt baddhoḥaṃ paramaṃ tvayālolajihvāṃ ghora rāvāmāraktalocanatrayāmamākalāsamullāsa kirīṭojjvalamaṇḍalāmsūryakāntendukāntaughaprollasatkarṇabhūṣaṇāmsṛkkadvayagaladraktadhārāvisphuritānanāmdanturāṃ paramāṃ nityāṃ raktamaṇḍitavigrahāmvāmapādaṃ śivahṛdi dakṣiṇe lokalāñchitamkoṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ samastabhuvanojjvalamvidyutpuñjasamānābhajvalajjaṭavirājitamrajatādrisamaṃ devaṃ sphaṭikācalavigrahamdigambaraṃ mahāghoraṃ candrārkaparimaṇḍitamyoganidrādharaṃ śambhuṃ smerānanasaroruhamaśeṣabrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaprakāśitamahojjvalām [-mahojjvalam]koṭikoṭiśaraccandranyakkṛtamukhamaṇḍalāmāraktamukhamadyābhirmattabhiranvitāṃ [-anvagāṃ ca va] tathāgṛhītaśavakaṅkālajayaśabdaparāyaṇaiḥśmaśānālayamadhyasthāṃ brahmādyupaniṣevitāmkathayāmi tava snehāt na prakāśyaṃ kathañcanagurumūlamidaṃ śāstraṃ gurumūlamidaṃ jagat

sanskrit: gururyasya vaśībhūto devāstaṃ praṇamanti capibedamṛtabhavena yaḥ sa devīpuraṃ vrajetprāyaścittaṃ na tatrāpi vede'pi sthita eva hiathavā svamataṃ vedairmahārudravaco yathāadvaitaṃ devataiśvaryaṃ nādvaitaṃ guruṇā sahagururgatirgururdevo gururdevo [gururdevī] tathā priyealpajño'nalpavijño vā gurureva sadāgatiḥgurupatnī maheśāni ! gurureva na saṃśayaḥbhojanīyaṃ na sandeho vikāraścedadhogatiḥgurūcchiṣṭaṃ tathā proktaṃ mahāpūtaṃ parāt paramgurvantike yadi vaset pañcāśadvarṣamuttameiha bhuktvā varān bhogān ante devīgaṇo [devagaṇo] bhavetasau viharati vīro yāvaccandrārkatārakamtatsutaṃ tattanayāṃ vā praṇamedvidhipūrvakamyatrāśāyāṃ guroḥ sthānaṃ nityaṃ prātaśca tanmukhaḥpraṇamed bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ sa siddho nā'tra saṃśayaḥvṛkṣālī kalpavṛkṣālī latā kalpalatā smṛtāgurugehe sthitā dāsyo bhairavyaḥ parikīrtitāḥpradakṣiṇī kṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharātvatto'pyadhika evāyaṃ gurustvayā prakīrtitaḥguruḥ sa eva deveśi sarvamantre'dhunā paraḥmahāśaive ca saure ca sa gururnātra saṃśayaḥmantrapradānakāle hi mānuṣe [mānuṣo] naganandiniatastu gurutā devi mānuṣe [mānuṣī na] nātra saṃśayaḥtajjñānaṃ kurute devi śiṣyo'pi śīrṣapaṅkaje

sanskrit: adhiṣṭhānaṃ bhavettasya mānuṣasya maheśvariviśeṣamanuvakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ gurugocarambrahmayogapradāne [brahmavidyā] tu maryādā daśa pauruṣīgurupādodakaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanampotaṃ pūtañca kurute sarvapāpebhya eva higuroḥ pādarajo mūrdhni dhārayed yastu mānavaḥtenaiva rajasā devi tilakaṃ yastu kārayettadrajo bhakṣate yena ekasmin divase'pi cagopanīyaṃ prayatnena svakīyaṃ kulapauruṣamśrutaṃ te gurumāhātmyaṃ guhyād guhyataraṃ yatkathitā sā mahāvidyā siddhavidyā ca yāmaleājñāpaya mahādeva rahasyaṃ kṛpayā śivayāmāsādya ca nirvāṇamuktimeti narādhamaḥrahasyaṃ kathyate devi sarvalokā upāsakāḥsā kālīnāṃ sahasrāṇi japyānāñca [japyāni ca] hi koṭiśaḥkālī ca jagatāṃ mātā sarvaśāstreṣu niścitāvyajasi [tyajasi] tvaṃ parañcaitat pumāṃsaṃ paramaṃ tathākālividyāṃ samāsādya na tyakṣati kadācanamantragrahaṇamātre tu sarve śivasamāḥ kilakālīmantragrahādeva [tvanmantragrahaṇādeva] sarve śivasamāḥ kilatasyaiva jananī dhanyā pitā tasya surottamaḥyena bhāgyavaśād devi kālī sā vā [sā vā bhaktyā] samāśritākadāsmākaṃ kule putraḥ kālīmantramupāśrayetkālī tārā yathācchinnā guruśca bhūpatistathātārāśiṣyastyajet kālīṃ kālīśiṣyastu tāriṇīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadi vā pūjyate devi nānyad vai na prapūjayetyā kālī paramā vidyā saiva tārā na saṃśayaḥuktaṃ tat kālikākalpe tārākalpe ca te mayāviśeṣato mahādeva rahasyaṃ japamarmaṇaḥtasyāḥ pratinidhirdevi mahāśaṅkhamayī śubhātadabhāve vīravandye sphāṭikī sarvasiddhidāpañcaviṃśatibhirmokṣaḥ puṣṭistu saptaviṃśabhiḥaṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvā siddhireva maheśvaridaśanairyadi kartavyā dantasaṃkhyā tathā priyeanyatrāpi ca deveśi merutvenaivamādiśettat śṛṇuṣva maheśāni krameṇa kathayāmi tesarvatra parisaṃkhyeyamaviśeṣaṃ maheśvariśatādipratisaṃkhyāyāmaṣṭottaraṃ japet priyejapānte ca tathā mālāṃ śivasya [śirasi] dhārayettataḥdevyai samarpayed dhīmān phalaṃ tajjapakarmaṇaḥuktaṃ sarasvatītantre tasmājjānīhi kāminiśṛṇuṣva parameśāni sarva tantraprasiddhaye [mantra]tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ prajapeddaśaparvabhiḥaṣṭottaraṃ japeddevi ādyantadvitayaṃ tyajetanāmāmadhyamārabhya kaniṣṭhādita [kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa] eva camadhyamādvitayaṃ [tarjanīdvitayaṃ] parva tarjanyāḥ parameśvariaṣṭottarajape parva ādyantadvitayaṃ tyajetkāmyamapi kare kuryānmālābhāve ca matpriyesnānaṃ satarpaṇaṃ homo balistṛptiśca nityabhākkevalañcānulomena prajapet karamālayā

sanskrit: śaktimantraṃ japeddevi śaktisambhavamālayāśaktimālayā]sāvitrījapane śastā sarvadā karamālayāvaiṣṇave tulasīmālā gajadantairgaṇeśvareśmaśānadhuttūrabījaiḥ śastā dhūmāvatījapeśastā ca bagalāmukhyāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvarina samyak phalabhāgbhūyāt tasmānniyamamācaretsakuśaṃ saphalaṃ devi gṛhītvācamya kalpataḥyajñāsāvadano(?) sanskrit: kāśyāñca nodeti kadā sandhiyogādvarānane [sandhiyogo-]āyāmaprasthato devi nityeyaṃ nityadā śubhe [śubhā]brahmāṇḍaṃ sthāpayettatra sakūṭaṃ vastumānavamsarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ dvijārpaṇaṃniṣkāme [niṣkāmo] karmabandhaśca sarvaṃ nirvāṇakāraṇammṛtaṃ pūtaṃ nayet kāśyāṃ mukto mamopadeśataḥtatra yadyatkṛtaṃ karma tadanantaphalaṃ labhettatra sāṃyogikaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra caiva vimucyatesvalpatve tithikālatve kriyākālagatirbhavetsandhyāyāṃ patitāyāntu gāyatrīṃ daśadhā japetitaḥ parataraṃ kiñcit tad brūyāstava mānaseyuddhasya vāraṇaṃ deva jvarādivāraṇaṃ tathānāśutrātā [nāsti] ca jagatāṃ tvāṃ vinā parameśvaraprākṛtenaiva vākyena kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tatgrahajvarādibhūteṣu sarvakarmasu yojayetdatte ca siddhihāniḥ syāt yoginīnāṃ bhavet paśuḥsadācāraratāya ca nirjitāśeṣaśatraveidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi jagadvaśyakaraṃ paramnāradena purā puṣṭaṃ mattaḥ kailāsamūrdhanitenaiva kavacenaiva nārado brahmasambhavaḥtadasambhavamālokya viṣṇurāha vidheḥ sutamtatsarvamabhavad viṣṇau viṣṇurāha samudrajāmpapraccha nārado dhīmān sarvalokahite rataḥkimetasyāḥ phalaṃ deva kimetanmohanaṃ bhavettrikāle gopitaṃ devi kāle kāle prakāśitam

sanskrit: tacchṛṇuṣva muniśreṣṭha trailokyamohanaṃ tvidamkavacairvarjitaṃ yatra tatra māṃ pātu kālikāeteṣāṃ [ityetat] paramaṃ mohaṃ bhavadbhāgye prakāśitamidaṃ kavacamajñātvā pūjayed vīrakāminīmalpāyuḥ sa bhavedrogī kathitaṃ tava nāradasamantrakavacaṃ dhṛtvā icchāsiddhiḥ prajāyatekavacasyāsya māhātmyaṃ nālaṃ vaktuṃ mahāmuneidaṃ kalpadrumaṃ devi [deva] tava snehāt prakāśyategopanīyaṃ prayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ [paṭhayecca] mahāmuneavaśyaṃ vaśamāyāti trailokyaṃ te carācaramtatpāṭhānnāradenāpi mohitañca carācaramnarāṇāmupakārāya brūhi yogaṃ suvistaramyenāśu labhate kīrtiṃ yenāśu labhate'khilamuktaṃ phetkāriṇītantre nīlatantre ca vistaramvā pated bhuvi]yogarājo maheśāni avyartho me sadaiva hikuliśaṃ devarājasya tathā yogo mayoditaḥtathaiva niścito devi yogo'yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥayaṃ yogavaro devi tathaiva parikīrtitaḥāyāmaprasthito devi ṣoḍaśāṅgulasammitetathāyānamite devi tad vattāmre vināśanelikhenmantraṃ varārohe tāriṇyāḥ sarvasiddhidamvṛddhyarthī vilikheddevi lekhinyā sumanoharamuttarāśāmukho bhutvā pūjayitvā ca tāriṇīmkāśmīraṃ kasturīṃ lākṣāṃ sindūrañca varānane

sanskrit: tanmadhye vilikhettārāṃ sārdhavedākṣarīṃ parāmsādhyaṃ likhettacca sādhyaṃ śṛṇuṣva śambhuvallabhep. 21) amukasyāmukaṃ jñānaṃ siddhiṃ kuru ca kurvitiamukasyāmukaṃ dhanaṃ dehi dehīti kāminiklībahīnāt dīrghavarṇān ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaṭsamālikhetaṣṭapatraṃ likhettatra kiñjalkayugalaṃ yugamtathācaturasraṃ caturdvāramevaṃ yantraṃ samālikhetgurau śukre tathā some maṅgale vada budheḥni capītavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya jatunā pariveṣṭayetsvarṇapīṭheṣu saṃsthāpya saṃkhyānamācaret kṛtīvidīrṇaṃ laṅghitaṃ vāpi naiva kuryāt kadācanaghaṭaṃ kuryāt prayatnena sarvadṛṣṭimanoharamtāmreṇa caiva yuddhārthī mṛdānyatra [mṛdāpyanyatra] ghaṭañcaretdhānyaṃ kṣiptvā mukhaṃ tasya pallavaiḥ pratipādayetaṣṭāṅgulasvarṇapatre caturasraṃ samantataḥcatuḥṣaṣṭyupacāreṇa yajettārāṃ parāṃ śivāmrājake puṣpake devi ṣoḍaśācchādanaṃ kulenivedayenmahāyuktyā balimantreṇa mantravitaṣṭottarasahasrantu hutvā sādhakasattamaḥbhūmiṃ grāmamitāṃ dadyād rājyamicchati kāmukaḥśālagrāmaśilāmekāṃ svarṇarekhādyalaṅkṛtāmbhojayed brāhmaṇān dhīraḥ kumārīḥ kalpapallave [kalpapallavi]ityevaṃ kathitaṃ ramyaṃ na devaṃ prāṇasaṅkaṭeidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vīraṣaṭkarmasādhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: striyāstu siddhasaṃsthānāṃ sarvayogavilāsināmmāraṇaṃ parameśāni ṣaṭkarmedaṃ prakīrtitamkathayāmi tava snehāt ataḥ siddhikaraṃ [drutasiddhikaraṃ] paramdurgā caiva bhadrakālī karmādau karmasiddhayeśūnyāgāre mahāraṇye devatāyatane'pi vātadabhāve pitṛbhūmau vāsāṃsi kathayāmi tetadabhāve raktakṣaumaṃ nānyad vastraṃ prakalpayetvidveṣoccāṭane tāmraṃ kapālaṃ māraṇe śubhamadurbhikṣāvyādhimṛto mālā tasya śubhāvahāmṛdau vā komale vāpi viṣṭare vā sureśvariekahaste dvihaste vā caturhaste samantataḥbhaye jāte maheśāni bhairavoktamanu japetsarvabhūtānataḥ kūrcamantrānto bhairavo manuḥaśvatthena maheśāni tad dharmakīlakañcaretśanau ca māraṇaṃ devi niścitaṃ vīravanditeprāgvidvān prajapet samyak svamantramayutaṃ śavetataḥ sādhyadine mantrī yāmamātre gate niśidigvāsāgalitāśeṣacikuraḥ kulakaulikaḥlakṣasaṃkhye maheśāni śaktipūjāpurassarammāṃsaṃ madyaṃ tathā matsyaṃ huned vahnau śataṃ śatamevamuktavidhānena digbhyo vā vīrapuṅgavaḥnāpekṣā jāyate kānte cāvaśyaṃ phalabhāgbhavetpūjānte satataṃ devi tanmāṃsairvahnimarcayetkrameṇa phalamāpnoti vyatyaye pātakī bhavetgopanīyaṃ khale duṣṭe paśupāmarasannidhau

sanskrit: ṣaṭkarmasu yathāyogyaṃ vada me karuṇānidhestambhane ḍākinī jñeyā vidveṣe pauṣṭikī matāetāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ devi kathitaṃ kulamohanestambhanoccāṭane devi praśastā nāgavallabhāgaurāṅgī dīrghakeśī yā sadā sāmṛtabhāṣiṇīmantrasiddhikarī hyeṣā śaṅkhinī sāpi bhāvinīsamāṅgī śūdradehī ca na kharvā nātidīrghakākṛṣṇāṅgī ca kṛśāṅgī ca danturā madatāpitāsadā kruddhā dīrghadehā mahārāvaparāyaṇāiyaṃ sā ḍākinī proktā mṛtyuyoge praśasyategrāhyā kularasaiḥ pūjyā bhaktibhāvena kāminītattanmantraṃ maheśāna yadyahaṃ tava vallabhāvajravairocanīyo yo manurekādaśākṣaraḥbahunātra kimuktena śṛṇu yatprāṇavallabheavaśyaṃ phalamāpnoti nānyathā vīravanditebhavedetat maheśāni tadā sarvaṃ vṛthā bhavettathāpi nahi siddhiḥ syāt citrametannagātmajeśāntaṃ vahnisamāyuktaṃ vāmanetravibhūṣitamkūrcayugmaṃ tato devi amukaṃ māraya mārayakhādirāṅgāramādāya kujāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥniśāyāṃ mastake netre lalāṭe hṛdaye karemantravarṇān samālikhya pratiṣṭhāṃ tatra kārayetdīrghākārāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ sadordhvastanamastakāmśatrunāśakarīṃ devīṃ dhyāyecchatrukṣayāya caoṃ śatrunāśakartryai nama iti dattvā maheśvari

sanskrit: ekaviṃśatibhūbhāge sthitastatra sadāśivaḥtasya devasya bhūbhāge pavitre kālahastakegovindaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt pūjayeddharivāsareśaraśeṇī samākhyātā mahāpātakanāśinītāñca sampūjya yatnena mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyātmahālakṣmīḥ sthitā tatra sitapuṣpeṇa pūjayetsnātvā kuṇḍe dhruve nāma paurṇamāsyāṃ tathāśvinegautamasyāśramaṃ gatvā sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajampaścimāduttaraṃ tāvat yāvaddakṣiṇamānasamgatvā tatra samabhyarcya brahmalokamavāpnuyātdvādaśādityamabhyarcya uttamāṃ dīptimāpnuyātabhyarcyendraṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ gaurisaubhāgyamāpnuyātnārāyaṇantu sampūjya narāṇāmadhipo bhavetvarāhaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhūmirājyamavāpnuyātpāṇḍukūṭasya yā dhārā sā dhārā narmadā nadīśivaviṣṇormadhyagatā yā ca yonirviniḥsṛtānitambastanayormadhye sā dhārā parameśvaribilvaśrīparvatānte ca yā dhārā sā sarasvatīmataṅgasya ca yā dhārā narmadā sā [prakīrtitā] na saṃśayaḥkāmākhyāyāśca yā dhārā sā gaṅgā parikīrtitākāmadhenvāśca yā dhārā sā vijñeyā sudharmiṇīnīlakuṇḍasya yā dhārā subhadrā parikīrtitāśakraśailasya yā dhārā urvaśī sā nigadyateyamaśailasya yā dhārā sā ca godāvarī smṛtāagniṣṭomaśatasyāpi labhate phalamuttamam

sanskrit: koṭiliṅgaṃ tato vīkṣet prāpayedāmarīṃ tanumkoṭiliṅgantu yaḥ paśyed vājapeyaphalaṃ labhetnamaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya koṭiliṅga namo'stu tenamo yajñādhipataye koṭiliṅga namo'stu tepāyasañca baliṃ datvā stutvā japtvā visarjayetvetālaṃ taṃ mahādevaṃ vāme viṣṇudvikarṇakamdharmakāmārthamokṣāya krūrāya kathanāya catvameva brahmā viśveśa brahmarūpa namo'stu tebrahmayoniṃ viśedyastu na punaryonimāviśetśivavallabhadeśe tu mokṣamārganirodhakeniḥsṛto brahmayoneḥ sa gaṇeśaṃ dvāri pūjayetnamo lambodara śreṣṭha devānāmiṣṭadāyakatato gacchenmuktimārgaṃ śakrasyābhimukhe [mukho yathā] yadiurdhvaṃ kṛtayugañcaiva pārśve tretā ca dvāparaḥtaṃ praṇamya naro bhaktyā prāpnuyādaiśvaraṃ padamna jāyate punargarbhe yugadoṣairna lipyatetadyuge yat kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ trāhi tvaṃ [māṃ] parameśvarayadyuge [tad-] yat kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tadvyapohatu bhūmijamhetubhūta [-taḥ] kṛtādīnāṃ satyadharma namo'stu tenamāmi satataṃ bhaktyā pāpaṃ hara namo'stu terājasūyāśvamedhasya tat phalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥpūjayitvā namaskṛtya brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥdhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatutulāpuruṣadānena yat phalaṃ samudāhṛtamdakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: utthāya sūryaṃ saṃvīkṣya paṭhenmantradvayaṃ priyenamo'stu devyai girisambhavāyai namaḥgajebhyo rakṣakebhyaśca kṣatriyebhyo namo namaḥnamaste dakṣiṇāmūrte daṇḍapāṇe namo'stu tekariṣyatīti viśvāsa etat siddhestu lakṣaṇamsurādipātakaṃ ghoraṃ sa kiṃ mokṣaṃ gamiṣyatiyoniṃ praviśya manujo varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vaset [bhramet]mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati so'pi guhyametanmama priyeagastyasya ca tīrthe ca maṇikarṇe hrade tathāakṣatena viśeṣeṇa śatamārgasahasrakaḥ [-kaiḥ]kālākhyo raṇabhadraśca saurabhaśca mahābalaḥekajaṅgho'nalaścaiva kardamāliptavigrahaḥbalanāśo bhīṣaṇaśca paścimāyāṃ vyavasthitaḥkeśavaścakrapāṇiśca dhanadasyottarā gaṇāḥaviśeṣeṇa rakṣanti trayaḥ kāmeśvarīsthitāḥdvāraṃ rakṣati vai sarvaṃ maṇḍapañca svayaṃ haraḥśatasāhasrayakṣiṇyo muktidvārañca rakṣatikubjatīrthaṃ tato rakṣatyaṣṭabhirdaśabhiryutaiḥvratayajñasamārambhe vighnāni nivasanti vaianyathā jāyate vighnamiti jānīhi me priyemānasāni jñānaghnāni tāni mama śṛṇu priyesannikarṣaṃ vidūraṃ vā sahasraṃ lakṣameva caśokamohajarāvyādhitāruṇyadhananāśakamnānāvratasamākīrṇaṃ dhārmiko'smīti mānasaḥvṛkṣapatrañca tulasī dhātrī vṛkṣaphalaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivamdṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ bhavedevaṃ tīrthajātaṃ jalaṃ tathāityetāni ca vighnāni saṃyānti ca punaḥ punaḥmana eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bandhamokṣayoḥcittamantargataṃ duṣṭaṃ tīrthasnāne niṣidhyateputrārthī labhate putraṃ kīrtyarthī kīrtimāpnuyātbrahmahatyādipāpānāṃ pāpaśuddhimavāpnuyātkāvyārthī ca kavitvañca niḥsāraḥ sāramāpnuyātidaṃ svastyayanaṃ dhanyaṃ yoginīnāmatantrakamślokārdhapaṭhanādasya duṣṭagrahakṣayo bhavetliṅgāṣṭakaśataṃ cakre harikṣetrasamaṃ śubhamhṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ naranārīsamanvitamgṛhāṇāṃ purato ramyaṃ bhuvi catvarabhūṣitamnānātoraṇasaṅkīrṇaṃ vīthibhiḥ samalaṅkṛtamsatatañca jalairdhautaṃ surābhāṇḍamivāśucitasya pārśve ca dūreyadi hṛdayamaśuddhaṃ sarvametad viruddham [viśeṣataḥ]duṣṭāśayo duṣṭaratiḥ pranaṣṭavyadhitendriyaḥtatra tasya kurukṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ gayāmyasmin pīṭhe ya ācāraḥ sa ācāro vidhiḥ smṛtaḥannaṃ na dūṣayet tatra brāhmaṇena ca vṛtyatāvivāhavyatyayastatra parivittirna duṣyatiduṣyenmatsyamāṃsakampūrṇasandhyā svadharmeṇa kāladharmo na vidyatekāmarūpe na saṃnyāsastathā dīrghavrataṃ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃsargapātakenaiva strīdharmau dharmamāśrayethaṃsapārāvataṃ bhakṣyaṃ kūrmavārāhameva cahīnācārastu saumāre sarvāśī sarvavikrayīkolvapīṭhe [kola-] jātidharmān svajātyuktena vartayetmahendre caiva yogī ca brahmajñānī subuddhimānetat sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yat pṛṣṭaṃ hi tvayādhunāpiśunāya na dātavyaṃ vedabhaktivivarjitesitaraktaistathā pītaiḥ kṛṣṇaiścānyaiśca varṇakaiḥnityotsavaṃ pramuditaṃ nānāvāditranisvanamdevatāyatanairdivyaiḥ prākārodyānamaṇḍitaiḥstriyastatra pramuditā dṛśyante tanumadhyamāḥpīnonnatakucayugāḥ pūrṇacandrasamānanāḥsukalpacārujaghanāḥ karṇāntāyatalocanāḥsarāṃsi ca manojñāni prasatrasalilāni cakadambaiścakravākaiśca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥevaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ pūrṇa nānāvidhai ravaiḥāste tatra svayaṃ devo hayagrīvo janārdanaḥpuṣkariṇyastaḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kuṇḍāśca sāgarāḥsarvalokahitārthāya rudraḥ somagaṇaiḥ sahayastatra yātrāṃ kurute vipule [pūtātmā] vijitendriyaḥdevānṛṣīnmanuṣyāṃśca pitṝn santarpayettataḥsnātvaivaṃ vidhivattatra so'śvameghaphalaṃ labhetyugādau ṣaḍaśītyāñca tathānye ca śubhe tithaupitṝṇāmakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ tat karoti na saṃśayaḥvarāhakāmayormadhye tattīrthaṃ sarvakāmadam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra snātvā naro yāti bhāskarasyālayaṃ pratianena snānaṃ kuryāttu paśyeddevaṃ trilocanamgokarṇaṃ vṛṣabhākāraṃ vikarṇaṃ puruṣākṛtimuttare ca sarastīre parvate bhadrakāśakepañcadhanvantare yāvadvaravīthīti kṣetrakamsampādya vidhivadbhaktyā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥtriśūlābhayahastāya yajjaṭābhāradhāriṇe [jaṭābhāravidhāriṇe]yugarūpāya devāya candrahastāya viṣṇavemaheśāya vṛṣasthāya jñānarūpāya jñānineapunarbhavapūrve tu navadhanvantarāya catatra snātvā maheśāni mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyātsarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padamsakṛd vārāṇasīkuṇḍe snātvā tatphalamāpnuyāt [labhate kṣaṇāt]mārkaṇḍeyahrado nāma tatra snātvā vrajecchivamye vā paśyanti ca snātvā kuṇḍe māheśvare tataḥsarvapāpavinirmuktā vimānavaramāsthitāḥtiṣṭhanti tatra muditāḥ kalpamekaṃ varānanevikhyāto vai hrado varaḥ]śrāddhaṃ kuryāt prayatnena upavāsaṃ samācaretgokarṇasya ca devasya [vikarṇasya] nātidūre maheśvaritatra snātvā klamaharaṃ na punarbhavamādiśetbrahmakuṇḍa mahābhāga trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarātkṛṣṇākhyaḥ śailarūpaśca varāho nāma nāmataḥnamaste] ca muktipradāyā'stu namo namastemadane parvate ramye gatvā paśyecca śaṅkaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taṃ liṅgamavyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śraddhayā susamāhitaḥdhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairnamaskāraistathā stavaiḥsampūjya taṃ vidhānena śivalokaṃ vrajennaraḥārohayāmi śikharaṃ pāpaṃ hara namo'stu tekṣaṇenaiva samuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchatijaṭāmukuṭacandraśekharaṃ śitabhasmāṅgalepanamsvasya vāme tatpuruṣe aghoramīśānamkhaḍgagokṣīrayorvarṇaṃ uttaraṃ vāmadevakampūrvaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ devaṃ gadāpadmadharaṃ paramkapilaviṭaṅkadaṃṣṭraṃ [vikaṭadaṃṣṭraṃ] nīlameghāñjanopamampuṣpāñjaliṃ gṛhītvā pratimāmantreṇa pūjayetnamo'stu śūlahastāya kedārāya namo namaḥniṣkalaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ praṇato'smi purātanamsarveṣāmeva goptāraṃ namaste śambhumavyayamiti prasādanaṃ kṛtvā kedārasya ca paścimamkedārañca namaskṛtya kalpavṛkṣaṃ tataḥ punaḥnamo'vyaktasvarūpāya mahāmalayavāsinekedārasya ca kauvere iṣukṣepatrayāntaresaṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastamacetanamtripurāre namaste'stu kamaleśa namo'stu techatrakoragiriryo'sau sa giriḥ paripātrakaḥaṣṭaṣaṣṭistu śaile'sminmadhya unnatako giriḥpūrvabhage tu śailasya sthito madhuripurhariḥkedāramudakaṃ pītvā kāmadhenuṃ spṛśedyadianuttamottamaṃ kṣetraṃ śailaṃ mandārakaṃ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmeśvaraśca tatraiva homamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥbhāvabhūteśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇamsampūjayecchivaṃ yastu mandāre kṣetraparvateprayāge saṅgame snātvā yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥdharmeśvarasya devasya kūpastiṣṭhati cāgrataḥgosahasraphalaṃ samyak labhate ca varānanetaṃ sampūjya naro bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyateprapaśyanti bhayaṃ saṃsārasāgaredhanurekādaśānte ca tatraiva kālabhairavaḥpiśācamocane tīrthe pūjayāmāsa śūlinampūjanīyaṃ prayatnena stotavyaṃ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥsvayambhūstatra liṅgaṃ vai devānāmapi durlabhamkṛttivāseśvaraṃ prāpya saṃsāravigatajvarāḥsukhena muktimāyānti yathārhanti yatastathākṛttivāseśvaraṃ prāptaṃ liṅgayonipratiṣṭhitamyadīcchettārakaṃ jñānaṃ śāśvataṃ cāmṛtaṃ padammadanācalasyeśāne iṣukṣepatrayāntarevatsahatantu liṅgānāṃ sarveṣāmuttamottamamtasya devasya vāyavye nānāvarṇena yā śilādarśanāttasya devasya gośatasya phalaṃ labhetanujñāṃ dehi pakṣīśa tvamasya darśanaṃ prativiṣṇorāyatanaṃ prāpya tatra śivajalaṃ śubhamtataḥ prabhāte deveśi maṇikūṭasya cottaretatra snātvā caturdaśyāṃ māghe vā phālgune'thavāballabhāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā nīlakaṇṭhasya darśanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā sādaramādhavamsaṃsāre patitānāñca gaṅgā trāṇakarī bhavetaśokāmalasañjātā koladaṇḍaviniḥsṛtāmaṇikūṭe ca saṃyātā tasya tatrādhikaṃ phalamnamaste pāpavimale namo devi varāṅgane [śivaprade]svargadvārañca tatraiva imaṃ mantramudīrayetsvargadvāraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ samāroheta sudurlabhamarghyaṃ dadāmi dharmāya svargadvāranivāsinehrade vārāṇasīye ca mārkaṇḍeyahrarda tathāsnātvā paścād durlabhāyāṃ tato harigṛhaṃ vrajetkulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchativiṣṇupuṣkarakaṃ nāma sarvatīrthodbhavaṃ jalampuṣkarākāramāsthāya sthito'sau vasudhātalesnātvā cānena mantreṇa vāruṇaṃ tatra sañjapetmaṇikūṭācale viṣṇurhayagrīvasvarūpadhṛkmantreṇārohayeddevi pītapuṣpeṇa pūjayetdaṇḍahasta mahābāho kāladaityaniṣūdanapītañca dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ maṇikuṇḍalacarcitam [-maṇḍitam]sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ maṇiśailaṃ trilocanammaṇikūṭa giriśreṣṭha pītavarṇa trilocanataṃ pūrvābhimukhenaiva uttarābhimukhena vāgatvā vindhyācalaṃ paścāt kṛtvā tat triḥ pradakṣiṇammūlena snapayeddevaṃ saugandhikajalaiḥ śubhaiḥcandanāgurupadmāni yāni kāmyāni kānicitsitāmalajalaiścaiva tathā koṣṇodakena ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trisitaṃ candanaṃ padmamuśīraṃ parikīrtitamtīrthodakaṃ gandhatoyaṃ karpūrasyodakaṃ tathāsnāpayitvā yathoktena tathā [punaḥ] snānaṃ samācaretaṣṭottarasahasraistu suvarṇaghaṭitairghaṭaiḥaśaktastu śataṃ kuryāddaśadhā surasundarimārtikairvā ghaṭaiḥ snānamaśaktastu samācaretkumbhe kṛtvā vidhānataḥamṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryānmudrāṃ tatra ca darśayetmahotsavaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snānārthaṃ devadakṣiṇeudvartanaṃ pratidinaṃ kartavyaṃ ca dināntaresnehairvā rajanībhiśca taṇḍulodvartanādibhiḥsaṃghṛṣya gātraṃ patrairvā apāmārgasya mūlakaiḥkuśena cāmareṇātha gobālena viśeṣataḥdatvā gobālakaṃ kurcaṃ sarvapāpādvyapohati [pāpānapohati]na varāhasya romeṇa na vaṃśena kadācanaliṅge vā pratimāyāṃ vā śālagrāme tathaiva camāsānte vātha pakṣānte kūrcayenmama sundaridvādaśyāṃ rāhugraste ca tailasnānaṃ na kārayetnāsikānte tathā guhye liṅge ca pulakeṣu caraktavastrairbhavet kuṣṭhī pāṇḍuvyādhimavāpnuyātparidhānaṃ pidhāyaivaṃ [-va] snānaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥso'pi nāśamavāpnoti dhananāśaṃ tathaiva cabilvakāṣṭhodbhavenātha tulasīkāṣṭhakena vāpidhāya tilakaṃ śreṣṭhameṣāmekatamena caatrālipya tato dehamayanena visarjayet

sanskrit: māṃsaṃ khādaya khādaya hrīṃ nama iti mantrataḥjapedekādaśāhe ca rogaḥ syāt nātra saṃśayaḥathavānyaprakāreṇa śatrukṣayamahaṃ vadeviparītakrameṇaiva japapūjādikaṃ caretśivāya nama iti mantreṇa gaṭhanañca samācaretśatrupratikṛtiṃ likhya tatra saṃsthāpayecchivamśatrorvakṣaḥsthitaṃ rudraṃ jvaladagnisamaprabhamnaracarmāmbaraṃ devaṃ mahāvyālādiveṣṭitamśūlapāṇaye nama iti snāpayet sādhakottamaḥagnikoṇādiparyantaṃ sūryarītyā maheśvarihu/ kṣamayeti vāmena kareṇa tu visarjayetiti yaḥ śivaḥ nama ityapi sakṛjjapetavaśyaṃ jāyate devi satyaṃ satyaṃ trilocanekumbhakārasya bhavanādānayet piṭhare jalam [śūlam]ānīya ca ūkhāmadhyād bhasma paryuṣitaṃ tathābhasmopari ca saṃsthāpya vāṭikāyāḥ sureśvaripunarmadhyāhnakāle ca nirjane sati bhāvinitattāvatīmahaṃ bhūmiṃ caurebhyo rakṣayāmi catāvatīñca tato bhūmiṃ vāmāvartena bhāvinitatraiva nirjane garte śalākāṃ lauhanirmitāmsaṃsthāpya mṛdbhiḥ saṃpūrya tadgartaṃ gṛhamāvrajetayaṃ yogavaro devi durlabho vasudhātaledine dine dharmavṛddhirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥtadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tada vadasva maheśvarasārdhayāmagatāyāntu niśāyāṃ sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lalāṭe tu viśeṣeṇa varāṅge na kadācanapāde pṛṣṭhe tathā netre na dadyādanulepanamdaridraḥ karalagne ca padalagne dhanakṣayaḥpadmapatre bilvapatre karavīradale tathānetrāṇi nāñjayeddevi kajjalaiśca viśeṣataḥtāpayet pātayeddevi kajjalaṃ tatprakīrtitamamṛtaṃ prāpnuyāt so'pi ihaloke paratra caso'pi mūḍho bhavedrogī kṣipraṃ vā nāśamāpnuyātnīraiḥ samārjayedyantraṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇamoṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti ye vadanti manīṣiṇaḥoṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥdvādaśākṣarabījena kṛṣṇabījena pūjayettatrārkacandravahnīnāṃ maṇḍalāni vicintayetkarṇikāyāṃ samāsīnaṃ jyotīrūpasvarūpiṇamkeśavādipuraṃ kṛtvā dvādaśākṣarakaṃ nyasetcintayitvā tato yogaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanammīnarūpo varāhaśca narasiṃho'thavā punaḥsumerośca pādapīṭhe padmakalpitamāsanamviṣṇo kamalapatrākṣa gṛhāṇa madhusūdanamayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāṇa puruṣottamagṛhāṇācamanīyaṃ tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā niveditamlokasaṃvittimātreṇa vāriṇā snapayāmyahamsvarṇavarṇaprabhe hyete [prabhedena] vāsasī tava keśavamayā niveditān gandhān pratigṛhya vilipyatāmsāvitrīgranthasaṃyuktamupavītamanakṣatam

sanskrit: tvameva jyotiṣāṃ deva dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatāmmayā niveditam bhaktyā naivedyaṃ tava keśavapradyumnaṃ paścime caiva tathaiśānye trivikramamtathā mahāgadāñcaiva nyaseddevasya dakṣiṇedakṣiṇe vasudhāṃ devīṃ vāṅmayaṃ tatra vinyasetvanamālyañca purataḥ śrīvatsakaustubhau tataḥgrahāṃśca dikpatīṃścaiva dadyāt puṣpabalitrayamlabhedabhimatān kāmān naro nāsya tu saṃśayaḥpūjitaṃ paśyati yastu na vighnaṃ viṣṇumavyayamjanmamṛtyucarātītaḥ sa viṣṇoḥ padamāpnuyātanvahaṃ tasya dve sandhye śvetadvīpaḥ prakalpitaḥsvanāma sarvatattvānāṃ mantra ityabhidhīyatepūjayed [pūjitaṃ] yastu deveśi gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayetmudrāṃ tato nibadhnīyād yathoktakramayogataḥaṣṭāviṃśatiraṣṭau vā aṣṭottaraśataṃ tathāpadma-śaṅkhaṃ śrīvatsañca gadāṃ garuḍameva caarcanīyaṃ na jānanti harermantrān yathoditānvakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa parameśaṃ samarcayetsahasraraśmipravarāya vedhase hayāsyarūpāya namo namastenamo'stu sūryānalatīkṣṇatejase hayāsyarūpāya namo namasteramāpate bhuvanapate sadā namaḥhayāsyarūpāya namo namaste(tasmai) turaṅgavadanāya namo namasteso'pyuddharet pitṛgaṇañca hare namastetato'ghanāśanapuraghātakāya(?)hayādyarūpāya namo namaste
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇatasuranarebhyo vājivaktro murāriḥmaṇikūṭakṛtāvāsa kamalākṣa namo'stu tetatkṣaṇātpradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kuryāt padmākāraṃ namettataḥkṛtvāñjalistato bhaktyā [kṛtāñjaliḥ] bhramayitvā namettataḥyo no namedbhramayitvā ca aparādho bhavettadāmohāndhakāranarake pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥśapanti devatāstasya viphalaṃ parikīrtitamśarīre vā maheśāni tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇutāvadvarṇasahasrāṇi brahmaloke mahīyatemaṇikūṭe tvayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthāpitaḥ kena vai purākathayāmi purāvṛttaṃ pratimāyāśca sambhavamcinmayārto mahīpālaḥ pratimārthamaharniśamsargasthityantakartāraṃ paśyāmi puruṣottamamna bhuṅkte vividhān bhogān na snānaṃ na prasādhanamviṣṇoḥ pratimayogyo yaḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥtat kena vā kariṣyāmi cājñāpayatu me prabhuḥ [prabho]haridhyānaparo bhūtvā susvāpa niyatendriyaḥātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa guptastasmai ca cakrabhṛtātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa tasmai suptāya cakrabhṛtyugāntādityavarṇābhaṃ nīlavaidūryasannibhamkratunānena dānena dhiyā bhaktyā praśastayā [ca te nṛpa]yadatra pratimāṃ rājan jagatpūjyāṃ sanātanīmsāgarasya jalasyānte nānādrumavibhūṣitehaste [paraśuhaste] ca paraśuṃ kṛtvā ūrmintaṃ tato vrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti vākyaṃ samālocyacchedayannaviśaṅkitaḥchitvā paraśunā [tailarasaṃ datvā] vṛkṣaṃ tadā bhūpāla cānayaevamuktvā mahābāhuḥ prayāto'darśanaṃ hariḥtāṃ diśaṃ samudīkṣyaiva sthitastadgatamānasaḥprabhātāyāṃ rajanyāntu satatānanyamānasaḥtaṃ dadarśa mahāvṛkṣaṃ yathā tejasvinaṃ drumammahocchrāyaṃ mahākāyaṃ prasuptañca jalāntikenararājastathā viṣṇordrumaṃ dṛṣṭvā mudānvitaḥsaptadhā drumarājaḥ sa nipapāta mahītaletadūrdhvakhaṇḍaṃ kāśmīre kabandhākārameva caśoṇādityaṃ tadūrdhvāṅgaṃ śukreṇa sthāpitaṃ priyebhāgadvayaṃ kāmarūpe bhāgaikaṃ malaye girauprācyāṃ nāndīmaiśānye matsyākṣo nāma mādhavaḥmahāvarāhanāmā ca yo'ṣṭādaśabhujairyutaḥsambhavaṃ kathitaṃ devi prāpaṇaṃ śṛṇu pārvatikharjūraṃ panasañcaiva tathā tālaphalāni calakucaṃ madhukaṃ yuktaṃ tathā pūgaphalāni camūlakasya ca śākañca gājarasya [rājakasya] tathaiva cavāstūkasya ca śākañca pālaṅgasya mama priyekuṣmāṇḍaṃ pārvatīyañca tathā cāraṇyasambhavamakālapanasañcaiva tathānyadapi varjayetekacittaṃ samādhāya prāpaṇaṃ śṛṇu śāṅkarirājadhānyaṃ ṣaṣṭikañca devaballabhakaṃ tathākṣārañca kṛṣṇakṣīrañca varṇañca mārtikodbhavampaśūnāñca pravakṣyāmi vanyānāṃ grāmavāsinām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāśakantathāmāhiṣaṃ varjayenmāṃsaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtantathāhāritaśca mayūraśca nārako vartakastathāvanyakukkuṭakaścaiva śarāriśca kapotakaḥkṛṣṇamatsyāśanaścaiva patriṇāṃ tu viśiṣyatecitramatsyaṃ rohitañca madguraṃ kabikaṃ tathāmatsyānyetāni deyāni vibhālīñca vivarjayetkausumbhaśākaṃ piṇyākaṃ raktapādāṃśca keśarānpūtikraṃ kānakañcaiva varjayet sādhakottamaḥabhakṣyaṃ varjayet sarvaṃ devatādhyānasādhaneaharniśaṃ japed vidyāṃ tadgatenāntarātmanārahasyaṃ paramaṃ devi tava snehāt prakāśitamprayatnena tadā martyairgantavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥsāgadeṣu ca śaileṣu nadīṣu ca saraḥsu catat phalaṃ kṛtsnamālokya mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ vadennaraḥmahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ maheśāni sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥviṣṇulokaṃ naro yāti samuddhṛtya kulaṃ matampuṇyakṣayādihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavetvaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāsādya tatra lokamavāpnuyātkalpavṛkṣasya mūle tu pūjayed haricandanaiḥyātrāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya caviṣṇulokamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśatāvat kālaṃ viṣṇuloke sukhaṃ bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥtatra dṛṣṭvā naraḥ kaścid viṣṇuloke mahīyatena saṃspṛśet tato devaṃ daṅgabhūmau na saṃspṛśet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aputro labhate putrān nirdhano labhate dhanamāyuḥ kīrti yaśo medhāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ dhṛtiṃ paśumyān yān samīhate bhogān dṛṣṭvā taṃ puruṣottamamakāraḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathāsarvāṅgebhyo yathā śreṣṭhamuttamāṅgaṃ maheśvarivaruṇo yādasāṃ yadvad yamaḥ saṃyamatāṃ yathāsamudrāṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭhaḥ kṣīrodaḥ saritāṃ patiḥna taṃ paśyāmi deveśi yastena sadṛśo bhuvisatyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kṣetraṃ tat paramaṃ mahatbhuktvā bhogān vicitrāṃśca [vividhā] devayoṣitsamanvitānjāyate yogino [jāyate yogināṃ] devi jñānajño jāyate gṛhīdakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā paśyeddakṣiṇasāgarammandāraṃ [mandāraṃ ca] tannamaskṛtya brahmaloke mahīyatedarśanādeva śailendra viṣṇurūpa namo'stu tebrahmavidyāṃ sa vijñāya garbhavāsaṃ na saṃspṛśet [na paśyati]saṃvatsaramupoṣitvā māsamātramathāpi vāmandārasyottare bhāge yāmilā raktasannibhākavacena tu sā pūjyā dharmārthakāmadāyinījayāñca vijayāñcaiva bhadrakālīṃ kapālinīmmadhye bhavānīṃ kālīṃ ca kālarātriṃ ca saṃyajetdhyānenadhyānaṃ [-vyānena] kuryāt śṛṇu dhyānaṃ mama priyeghorairaṭṭāṭṭahāsairduritaśataharāṃ kālarātriṃ bhajāmiviśvamūrte śubhe śuddhe virūpākṣi trilocanemahārātri vicitrāṅge gopanṛtyapriye śubhecāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālāsye tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭre [mahāvidye] mahābale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāli karāla vikrānte [kāli karālavaktre ca] sarvadevanamaskṛteiti saṃpūjya tāṃ devīṃ vrataṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥsamvatsaraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vā pakṣaṃ vāpi tadūrdhvakammatsyamāṃsaṃ ca bhuñjaṃśca na rātrau bhojanaṃ caretpratyaṅgaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ gandhapuṣpairadīnakaiḥ [sugandhakaiḥ]kuryādamāyāṃ deveśi paśupāyasamodakaiḥnīla raktena saṃveṣṭya pañcapallavacarcitamnaivedyaṃ dviguṇaṃ dadyād valiñca triguṇaṃ tathāsvayamarghyañca gṛhṇīta nṛtyagītamahotsavaiḥciñcāñca nālikāśākaṃ kalāyaṃ niṅkucaṃ tathākaṃkāraṃ kusumaṃ jhindīṃ kundaṃ mandārameva capūjayitvā maheśāni pūjāsthānaṃ na vīkṣyatebrāhmaṇāya tato dadyānna śūdrāya kadācanana tatrātibhayaṃ ghoraṃ sarpacaurādikaṃ tathāsaputra pautro matimān samṛddhimupagacchatisa vatsareṇa labhate rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ nṛpaḥtatra kāmeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayecca vṛṣadhvajamhayagrīvasya pūrve tu yā śilā śuklasannibhāyatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snānadānena kīrtitamtulasīdve (?) ca mandāre kalhāre ca tamālaketasyāḥ savye ca yā yoniḥ sā vijñeyā sarasvatīyat phalaṃ vanavāse ca vānaprasthe ca kīrtitamtasyāḥ pūrve ca vivare pañcaśeṣākṛtiḥ śilādvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya upoṣya mama sundarimukto bhavettu vai devi sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpādibhirdhūpaiḥ praṇamya śirasā prabhumpradadyādharaśirasi tatra siddhiśca jāyatekāverī sā samākhyātā snānānnaśyati pātakamtasyāmeva caturdaśyāṃ snānāt pāpakṣayo bhavetkauśikyāṃ vidhivat snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyateśiprāyāṃ snānamātreṇa daridro'pi dhanī bhavetkaratoyāmupaspṛśya viṣṇuloke mahīyatetasyāḥ svacchodakaṃ pītvā na punarjāyate naraḥaśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti bhāvininarastat phalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya cadṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ naro natvā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabhamśriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sarvaiḥ pramudito guṇaiḥtrisaptakulamuddhṛtya ante viṣṇupuraṃ vrajetgandharvāpsarasaiḥ sārddhaṃ yathā viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥsarvajñaḥ satyavādī ca jāyate gatamatsaraḥāsādya vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānaṃ tato muktimavāpnuyātjitendriyo jitakrodhaḥ saptasaṃvatsarāyatamkṛtopavāsaḥ prāpnoti tato'dhikataraṃ phalamviṣṇulokaṃ samāsādya na cyavanti kadācanasudūrastho'pi yo bhaktyā kīrtayet puruṣottamamyātrāṃ karoti kṛṣṇasya śraddhayā yaḥ samāhitaḥdhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā harerdūrāt prāsādopari saṃsthitamāste yaścaturo māsān vārṣikān viṣṇupuṣkaresarvakāle tu tatraiva ye vasanti manīṣiṇaḥtapastaptvānyatīrtheṣu varṣāṇāmayutaṃ naraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa saṅgatyāgena tatphalamsarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ snānadāne prakīrtitamtat phalaṃ labhate tatra pratyahaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥtat phalaṃ labhate tatra pratyahaṃ niyatendriyaḥ ||]so'pi duḥkhavinirmukto muktiṃ gacchati durlabhāmtatra dehaṃ parityajya te'pi yānti parāṃ gatimkāmarūpopakārāya āste sa puruṣottamaḥicchannanicchannapi tatra dehaṃ saṃtyajya mokṣaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥte bhinnadehā praviśanti kṛṣṇaṃ haviryathā mantrakṛtaṃ hutāśepradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mantreṇa ca prasādayettasmai namo'stu puruṣāya gaṇeśvarāyamaṇikūṭaṃ tato gatvā prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ padamnamaste sarvalokeśa bhaktānāmabhayapradayāste mayā kṛtāḥ pūjā maṇikūṭe jagatpateevaṃ prasādya taṃ devaṃ daṇḍavat praṇipatya casūryāyārghyaṃ tato datvā brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥsa lokaṃ śāśvataṃ viṣṇoryāti nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥna nāstikāya mūrkhāya na kṛtaghnāya māninekāmarūpa iti khyātaḥ svargamokṣapradāyakaḥdeśo'sau puṇyaśīlānāṃ guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṅkṛtaḥtapaḥ svādhyāyaniratā vandyāḥ pūjyāśca te sadāpraśastāḥ sarvakāryeṣu tatra deśodbhavā dvijāḥitihāsavidaścaiva purāṇārthavidaśca [-sta] teputradārādhanairmuktā dātāraḥ satyavādinaḥsvadharmaniratāḥ śāntāstatra tiṣṭhanti dhārmikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgastyaḥ śaunakaścaiva bhāradvājakapiñjalāḥjāmadagnyo vaśiṣṭhaśca ātreyaśca parāśaraḥśāṇḍilyaścāparaṃsaśca cyavano'ṅgirasastathātasmāt [tāṃśca] pūjyāśca vandyāśca tyājyā ye śṛṇu śāṅkarite varjyāḥ pīṭhapūrvasthāḥ sauvarcala vināvadhi (?)pravakṣyāmi maheśāni śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhavakapiñjalastathāgastyaḥ mādhavaśca dharādharaḥātreyyāścābhavad dharmo bhānuścaiva dhanañjayaḥvatsaśca narasiṃhaśca dāmodaramahīdharausāvarṇāḥ śaṅkaro bhānurmadhuśca madhusūdanaḥbhāskaro bhūdharo rāmaḥ sarve śiṣṭā mahaujasāḥbhāradvājād bhaved rāmaḥ smṛtorantargṛhe dvijaḥvaśiṣṭhaścaiva damanaḥ kramaścaiva trivikramaḥbhrātarau dvau dharmaratau prajāpato kamaṇḍaloḥgaṅgānnīlāmbaro jātaḥ sa evokto maheśvarikauśikād vāsudevaśca putraścaiva mahīdharaḥete vaśiṣṭhāt sañjātā āśramasthāstathodgatāḥcyavanācca bhavedrāmastathā caiva dhanañajayaḥaparastho bhaved bradhyā narasiṃhamahīdharauete ca pannagājjātāḥ pṛthivībhāramāśritāḥāṅgirasāllakṣaṇaśca dharmavān satyavikramaḥbhīmo dāmodaro vatso vedagarghaśca me priyeekaikamuttamaṃ caiṣāṃ vrātyā jātā sahasraśaḥmahīkṣetre sthitaḥ sūryaḥ śāmbenaivāvatāritaḥsamantāt krośamātrañca bhukti muktiphalapradaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhyukṣya mūlamantreṇa śayyāyāṃ tatra saṃviśetparameṣṭhiguruñcaiva vāme'bhyarcya gaṇeśvaramtato māyamāsanāya nama ityarcayecchivelikhitvācamya yatnena svamantroktavidhānataḥpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ hū/ phaṭ svāhayā yutamaṅganyāsakaranyāsau mātṛkānyāsameva cadhyātvā bhaktyā samabhyarcya mānasaiḥ sādhakottamaḥpraṇavañca tato devi vaṭukebhyo namastathātatastu vahnibījena samantājjaladhārayājapaṃ kṛtvā samarpyātha vidhinā parameśvarihomañca tarpaṇañcaiva abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ paramkāñcanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā chidrāvaraṇamācaretevamuktaṃ mahādevi śayyāsādhanamuttamamatha śṛṇu trivārasya caturvārasya sādhanampraṇamed gurumabhyarcya maṇidharīti mantrataḥdayāṃ kurvantu te sarve siddhidāśca bhavantu metataḥ pūrvamukho vāpi uttarāśāmukho'pi vāsthānaṃ sammārjya tatraiva pretabījaṃ likhet sudhīḥtatropaviśya deveśi hṛdīṣṭadevatāṃ smaretkālyādibhyo maheśāni pūjayitvā vidhānataḥpūjābalyādikāḥ smṛtāḥkṛtvā sthānaṃ parityajya devīṃ smṛtvā gṛhaṃ vrajetyasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ sādhakānāṃ paraṃ hitambilvamūlaṃ maheśāni samantāt ṣoḍaśaṃ karamṛgyajuḥsāmasadṛśaṃ patratrayaṃ varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māsi māsi site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ [saptamyāṃ] vijitendriyaḥlauhitye vidhivat snātvā arcayecca [arcayati] samāhitaḥuttirya dāsasī dhaute paridhāya sunirmaleupaviśyodaye kāle prāṅmukhaḥ savitustathāvartulañcordhvakarṇikamraktapuṣpañca darbhañca prakṣipya tāmrabhājanepidhāya tanmaheśāni pātraṃ pātreṇa vinyasetnāsti]sampūjya padmañcārabhya gaganāttatra bhāskaramkṛtvārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ dhyātvā taṃ samupāhitaḥ [samupasyitaḥ]piṅgalākṣaṃ mahākāyaṃ padmahastāruṇāmbaramsvarūpaṃ baladaṃ śāntaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitamtatastatpātramādāya jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥtryakṣareṇa tu mantreṇa sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayetyāvanna vīkṣate viṣṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ vā maheśvaram [sureśvaram]ādityāya śuciḥ snātvā sa labhedīpsitaṃ phalamtāntrikairvaidikairmantrairbhānostasya ca buddhimānsnātvā kapotakuṇḍe ca ārohedudayācalamkaraṇe vidhivat snātvā meṣārke ravivāsaresaptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśānuddhṛtya pārvatiupagīyamāno [-ne] gandharveḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchatiyaḥ karoti narastatra pūrvoktaṃ sakalaṃ labhet [bhavet]vāre tithiravau caiva sarvakāle maheśvarivimānenārkavarṇena sūryalokaṃ vrajanti terāmeśvara iti khyātaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naro vā yadi vā nārī sarvakāmaphalaṃ labhetśatahastamidaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sūryaraśyisamudbhavamsarvatīrthāmbhasi snātvā kuśairāsicya mūrdhanidharmāraṇyasya pūrve tu saptadhanvantarāyatamsūryaraśmisamudbhūta kapotākhya saṃritpatetāreṇārghyaṃ tato datvā snātvā mantreṇa śāṅkaritasya paścimadigbhāge daśadhanvāntarāyatamphālgune vā tathā māghe saptamyāṃ snānamācaretkapotasya ca pāścātye dhanurekādaśammitamsnātvā vāruṇamantreṇa vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt[sabhaktikaṃ]śrāddhañca muṇḍanaṃ kuryāddānaṃ dadyād yathāvidhinakṣatrakūṭavāyavye śivayūpastu paścimepūrvato nāgaśailaśca tatra madhyatamaḥ priyesnānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ sarvamakṣayamaśnutecandanaṃ nāma tat kṣetraṃ vārāṇasīsamaṃ śubhamtatra snātvā ca vidhivannaraḥ kaivalyamaśnutetatra snātvā navamyāñca svargaloke |]jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyātvṛṣākāragiriḥ somagiristu vṛṣabhācalaḥcandrasūryagrahe snātvā kaivalyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥtasya sampūjanād devi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyateśeṣe brahmagṛhaṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāttataḥ parasmin divase gacched bhasmācalaṃ pratitatra ratnāhvayaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayedvijitendriyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gireraiśānyabhāge tu kānnakaṃ [kānvakaṃ] nāma vai saraḥtasyottarapūrvabhāge śivaviṣṇorbiladvayamgaṅgākuṇḍaṃ tu tatraiva dhanuḥṣoḍaśakaṃ mitamtasyāṃ diśi haviṣyāśī saṃyatastad [saṃyatastu] dinaṃ nayettato'nyadivase prāpte gacchennakṣatraparvatamdakṣiṇe rasakūṭasya nātidūre vyavasthitāsā tu puṣpanadī khyātā sarvapāpapramocanīsampūrṇamāghamāse tu snātvā viṣṇupurīṃ vrajetdvāparasya tu sā gaṅgā viṣṇukūṭasamudbhavātat tīrthe muṇḍanaṃ kuryān mahīkṣetre tu saṅgataḥtatraṃ snānaṃ japo homaḥ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajetihaloke hyarogī syāt śeṣe śivapuraṃ vrajetsā jñeyā maladhārā ca snātvā tatra ca kilviṣīpramādāt snānamātreṇa pauṣpakaṃ snānamācaretetat puṇyakaraṃ kṣetraṃ bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥcandrikā ca nadī puṇyā tasya kṣetrasya pūrvataḥtasya pūrvottare bhāge liṅgaṃ vai kṛttivāsasamcandrikāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā sampūjya kṛttivāsasamkrośāntare maheśāni pūrvabhāge vyavasthitāphenilāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā phālgune [karatāle] ca viśeṣataḥsukṛtārghye [mṛdyotordhve] sthitā puṇyā nadī pāpapraṇāśinīcaitre ca [caitryāñca] vidhivat snātvā gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhetmāghaśuklacaturthyāntu pūjayitvā maheśvaramtrisrotā ca nadī tatra dakṣiṇasyāṃ vyavasthitākṣīrodaśca maheśaśca guhāmadhye vyavasthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairnaivedyairvibhavairapiśaṅkaraṃ sevyamānaṃ tu samāsādya prasādayetputra pautrasamṛddhiśca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varastriyaḥkāmākhyā pūrvabhāge tu kṣīrodā yā nadī ṣarākṣīrodāyāḥ pūrvabhāge parvate'marakaṇṭake [śarakaṇṭake]taṃ sampūjya prayatnena na śokaṃ labhate naraḥdṛṣṭvā taṃ liṅgamatyugraṃ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥpūrvāgneye maheśāni parvato gandhamādanaḥtatra sanātvāśvamedhasya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāttīrthaṃ vilvasaro [vilveśaro] nāma snātvā naśyati pātakampūjayitvā tato bhṛṅgaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyātdakṣiṇe tasya śailasya nivedho nāma parvataḥtatra snātvā naro nārī brahmalokamavāpnuyāttasyottare tu lauhitye dhanuḥ saptapramāṇataḥtatra snātvā ca tāreṇa pretatvaṃ naiva gacchatilauhitasyodadhestīre dakṣiṇe parameśvarisnānaṃ tatra varārohe mahāpātakanāśanamsnātvā kṣīraṃ pibennārī mṛtāpatyā bhavennahitasyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge bhūmipīṭhe maheśvaribhṛṅgīśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tatra pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥśaṅkaraṃ pūjayed bhaktyā brahmaloke mahīyateviṣṇulokamavāpyaivaṃ tato mokṣamavāpnuyātkuṇḍale bibhrataṃ śubhre nāgahāravibhūṣitamsarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ [-saṃyuktaṃ] jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitampuṣpāñajaliṃ samādāya pratimantreṇa pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: namaste bhagavan deva lokapāla jagatpate[namāmyaham]śvetarūpaṃ brahmarūpaṃ kuberaṃ taṃ samarcayettasmin kuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā viṣṇuloke mahīyatebaliṃ dadyāt kuberāya vyañjanenāśūnyakammaheśasya mukhodbhūtaḥ kūrpaṭo nāma vai nadaḥrohitākāramāsthāya sthito'sau vasudhātaleityanena tu mantreṇa snātvā tu dhanadeśvaramlauhitye vidhivad snātvā ārohed vahniparvatamprāpyate viṣṇulokañca modate viṣṇunā sahatatraiva vāruṇaṃ liṅgaṃ kuṇḍañca vāruṇāhvayamtasya pūrve nātidūre kāliṅgo nāma parvataḥpaśyati]dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca bhaktyā ca na bhūyo jāyate kvacitgaṅgātīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ snānānnaśyati pātakamsnātvā ca kāmabījena spṛṣṭvā pāṇḍuśilāṃ tataḥpustakābhayahastāya sākṣasūtradharāya caprasādayet tato devaṃ martyasya [uttare] dṛṣṭigocaresaptarṣīṇāmekaikena tadrūyaṃ parvataṃ bhajetsaptācale sapta-ṛṣīn madhyādipūrvataḥ kramātkule tasya bhayaṃ nāsti puṇyavān jāyate bhuvitasyottare kalpavṛkṣaṃ vilvavṛkṣaṃ mahātarumvṛkṣāṇāṃ pūjanād devi tasya patreṇa śāṅkaritasya vāyavye dhanadapuraskārako giriḥdakṣiṇe tasya devasya vāsavasya sadastrayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhye kuṇḍe ca adhanī dhanī bhavati nānyathāyasmin kasmin sthito devi naraḥ snātvā saro'mbhasigaṇaṃ caṇḍaṃ kārtikeyaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathātasyottare madhyabhāge'ntargṛhasamīpataḥtatra siddheśvarī yonihastadvayapramāṇataḥtāṃ pūjayettu aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ samācarettasyāḥ pūrve vilvakūṭe virūpākṣaṃ samarcayetparvataṃ hastirūpañca uccaughaṃ kṛṣṇasāyinamcandrañca kārtikeyañca pūrvabhāge guhādvayeākāśagaṅgācihnena raktarakṣaṃ hiraṇmayamtrikoṇāntaṃ gataṃ toyaṃ ṣaṭkoṇāt teṣu veṣṭanamvṛṣodbhūtaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ vṛṣākāraṃ sarastaṭeyasteṣu tīrthaṃ vidhivat karoti niyatendriyaḥnāṭakasya pūrve tu dṛṣṭvā nīlācalaṃ girimmantrāṇāṃ sādhane tatra vāñchitaṃ phalamāpnuyātdakṣiṇe māraṇaṃ kuryād ramyaṃ dakṣiṇabhāgataḥsubhadrā ca layāgneye dṛṣṭimātrāntare sthitaḥtatra dīrgheśvarīṃ yoniṃ raktapāṣāṇarūpiṇīmmāyābījena kāmena aṣṭamyāṃ saṃyatendriyaḥcaturbhujā umādevī pīnonnatapayodharājaṭāmaṇḍitaśīrṣā ca raktapretopari sthitāevaṃ kṛtvā naro vīraḥ punaryonau na jāyatedurgāñca pañca tatraiva snānānnaśyati pātakamtāṃ pūjayet śrībījena nālakṣmīrjāyate kvacitpūjayecca caturdaśyāṃ śivaloke mahīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sampannaṃ caiva lauhitye parvataṃ kūrmarūpiṇamadhastāccaiva lauhitye dvāviṃśadhanurāyatamtatra snātvā sakṛt loke brahmaloke mahīyatekulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyatemadgure parvate ramye liṅgaṃ tatra ca madgurampūrvottare tu devasya vilvāraṇye guhāntaretatraiva niḥsṛtā pūrvabhāgād girivarā nadīyāmamātraṃ paścimāśāṃ punaryāti parāṅmukhītat kṣetraṃ durlabhaṃ loke yatra gatvā na śocatisitagaṅgā triyāmānte ambhaḥ śailā ca sāgatātasmin kṣetravare puṇye nimeṣamāvaset sudhīḥyatra sārdhaṃ śailaputryā jalakrīḍāṃ sadā haraḥtatra snātvā mahāmādhyāṃ gaṅgeva phaladāyinīsarvapāpakṣayastasya prāyaścittaṃ na vidyatetapodhanyaḥ puṇyadeśaḥ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyatevandye tvaṃ nirmale rudre pāpaṃ hara namo'stu tesatraṃ mantramataṃ śāntaṃ tathā vijayamambaramjale vā antarīkṣe vā sthale vā yo mṛto bhavetsarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ vrajetbrahmahatyāsahasrāṇi pāpāni vividhani camīne meṣe trayodaśyāṃ yaḥ snānaṃ kurute sudhīḥphālgunyāṃ vidhivat snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca vṛṣabhadhvajamyasyāḥ paścimavāyavye iṣukṣepadvayāntaresaṃyuktā somavāreṇāmāvāsyā yadā tu bhavetkulaikaviṃśamudghṛtya sa gacchet paramaṃ padam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devañca keśavaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā viṣṇupuraṃ vrajetśvetadvīpeśvaro bhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyateraktadhārā sā vijñeyā tasyāṃ snānaṃ vivarjayettasyāṃ ca vidhivat snātvā mahākīrtimavāpnuyāt [mahāgatim]tasyāñca vidhivat snātvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥtatpūrvasyāṃ maheśāni nadī vetravatī parātasmādīśānakāṣṭhāyāṃ yā nadī uttarasravātripurāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣakesa yāti viṣṇusadanaṃ śarīreṇa virājitaḥ [vijānatā]pūjayet parayā bhaktyā nānānaivedyavedanaiḥeṣā ca mandarā khyātā chinatti dīpavattamaḥtasyāñca vidhivat snātvā sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhetdurvārākhyo maheśāni tatra snātvā divaṃ vrajetdurvāre viṣuve snātvā kārtikyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥpañcamānasasambhūtā nadī śivajalā parāsomeśvaraṃ mahāliṅgaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ maheśvaritasyāsanne nātidūre padmā nāma nadī parāp. 339) padmamānasasambhūtā prathate cottarasravākalau pañcanadī khyātā bilvakṣetre mama priyepadmāvatī pañcadhārā khyātā pañcanadī smṛtāaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ śivaloke mahīyatekadambabilasaṃyātā tāñca yāmavahā nadīkadambamānasodbhūtā gaṅgeva phaladāyinīcampāvatījale snātvā dṛṣṭvā śambhuṃ viśeṣataḥliṅgasvarūpī bhagavān śambhustatra vyavasthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tīre tasya paścimāyāṃ nātidūre vyavasthitaḥtatra snātvāmāvāsyāñca sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhetaśvamedhasahasrasya labhate phalamuttamamsnātvā mantreṇa manujā divaṃ gacchanti pāritāḥdivyapure jale snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ trilocanamcampāvatīṃ nadīṃ laṅghya yo'nyataḥ snānamācarettatra snātvā sakṛnmaunī madhukūṭasya dakṣiṇerājasūyasya yajñasya labhate phalamīpsitamsakṛd dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ devīṃ bhaktyā pūjya praṇamya caanyāśca tatra tiṣṭhanti virajā lokamātaraḥāste vaitaraṇītīrthaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ paramdevyāḥ pūrve nātidūre kuṇḍaṃ vaitaraṇīyakamāste svayantu tatraiva kolarūpī hariḥ svayamkapilā gogṛhe somatīrthaṃ ca lobhasaṃjñaketīrthakṣetreṣu matimān viraje saṃyatendriyaḥnaraḥ svayaṃ tatra snātvāmaralokaṃ sa gacchatisa karotyakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṛṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥparityajanti puruṣāste mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vaipaśupāyasagandhaiśca mahāvibhavavistaraiḥliṅgāntaragatā yonirmaṅgalā nāma candrikāvāgbhavaṃ madhyabījañca śrībījaṃ purato bhavetṛṣiḥ syānnāradaḥ chando gāyatrī parikīrtitādharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu yojayenmama suvratetatra saṃsthāpya kalaśamaṅgerāpūjanañcaretcamakaṃ vādanenāsya praṇavādyaṃ visarjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kadalañca śamīpatraṃ dhatrīñca tulasīṃ tathāvarālīñca tathā matsyaṃ na dadyādapi karhicitaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ samarcayetciñcābhyaktanaraḥ pṛṣṭvā tathā pañcaśirā apiabhakṣairnārcayed devīṃ nīlīraktaṃ na dāpayetmahādevyai na dadyāttu dadyād haṃsaṃ ca chāgalamjavāpuṣpaṃ kuṅkumaṃ ca bilvapatra sakomalamjalajāni ca deyāni tathā kālodbhavāni cadevīṃ ca dvibhujāṃ pītāṃ svarṇakaṅkaṇadhariṇīmvistare vā tathā carmakambale puṣparetasaḥkṛṣṇājine jñānasiddhiḥ śrīmokṣau vyāghracarmaṇicarmāsane daridraḥ syāt pāṣāṇe vyādhijaṃ bhayamtṛṇāsane yaśohāniḥ parṇe ca vittavibhrabhaḥtatraiva paścime bhāge vārāhīṃ pratipūjayethayamedhasya yajñasya prāpyate cottamaṃ phalamdhruveṇa pañcapatreṇa gandhādyaiḥ pratipūjayetrambhātīrthaṃ vijānīyāt snānād bhayaparikṣayaḥsarodvayaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭirdhanuṣāñca pramāṇataḥtatra śailaṃ cañcalākhyaṃ nārohecca kadācanapaścime kajjalasyānte kapilāyāśca saṅgamemṛdmūrte (?)kapilāyāśca saṅgamāvadhi śāṅkaridakṣiṇasyāṃ triyāmānte raivate parvatāntarenavapīṭhasya yattīrthaṃ śṛṇu vai tasya devatāḥekatra tīrthaṃ kṛtvā ca ekatra caiva devatāḥpūjayet parayā bhaktyā pratipīṭhaphalaṃ labhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahālakṣmīrvilvavṛkṣo jātaḥ śrīśailaparvatevṛttāntaṃ paramāścaryaṃ vada me karuṇāmayasatye tu pūjayāmāsa liṅgaṃ rāmeśvarābhidhamtatra me'nugrahād vāṇī sarveṣāṃ priyatāṃ gatātādṛk prītirna lakṣmyāñca jāyate keśavasya caprāptaṃ malliṅgamekānte tapastepe'tidāruṇamtadā sā vṛkṣarūpeṇa sthitā liṅgāgrataḥ satīkoṭivarṣe maheśāni tato me'nugraho'bhavatsadaiva parameśāni viharet sā sadaiva hisadaivāpūjayad mām sā madbhaktā sātulā śivesarvatīrthamayo devi sarvadevamayaḥ sadātatphalaistatprasūnairvā tatpatrairyaḥ prapūjayettatkāṣṭhacandanaṃ bhāle yo dhārayati saṃbhramātatastaccandanaṃ devi dhārayenna kadācanabilvamūle maheśāni prāṇāṃstyajati yo naraḥatastatsādhanaṃ devi sarveṣāṃ priyakārakamabhyarcya yatnato devi kṣetrapālaṃ prapūjya casiddhiṃ dehi jagatkartā dehi sthānaṃ namostu tetataḥ sthānantu sampūjya likhettatra varānanetadante mūlamantrañca vilikhet sādhakottamaḥsaṃkalpyāṣṭottarayutaṃ japtvā cchidrāvadhārayetityevaṃ kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ sārāt sāraṃ parāt paramidānīṃ śṛṇu deveśi muṇḍasādhanamuttamamnaramahiṣamārjāramuṇḍatrayaṃ varānaneśivāsarpasārameyanṛṇāṃ [vṛṣabhānāṃ] bhavā maheśvari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kurukṣetraṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatra brahmasaraḥ smṛtaḥdaśāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnuyāt nātra saṃśayaḥtasyāṃ ca vidhivat snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatiudakāpsarā tu prathame dvitīyā paścimāpsarāḥkavilāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā makarasthe divākaremuktaye sarvapāpānāṃ brahmaṇā nirmitā purāanena snānaṃ kṛtvā tu dadyādarghyaṃ vibhūtayedṛṣṭvā kṣīrañca toyañca tato'rghyaṃ samudīritammahāsenaṃ vahnijāyāmarghyamantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥpūrṇāyāṃ vā maheśāni śivasya sadanaṃ vrajetiha loke tvarogī syāt saṃprāpya cottamaṃ sukhamkuśāvarte daivate ca samprāpte [saṃgate] kubjikāmukhemānase kubjidhārā ca prācīdhārā sarasvatītatra pūjā japo homaḥ kṛtaṃ bhavati dehināmdattaśrāddhaṃ tadā tatra kṛtaṃ bhavati cākṣayamūrdhvabhāge tu yāmārdhe ekasyaiva tu saṅgamamtasyāṃ ca cāruvān snātvā rogī bhavati nānyathāpūrvasyāñcaiva yā dhārā kīrtitā sā sarasvatīuttare kṣetra aiśānye dhanuṣāñca pramāṇataḥkubjiprāptaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitṛṇāmanṛṇo bhavetkubjikāyāḥ prasādena mucyate brahmahatyayāhaṃsayuktavimānena yānti sarve triviṣṭapamtāvat kṣetraṃ bhadrakālyā gatvā sampūjya kālikāmkalidvāparayoḥ sandhau guptakālī sarasvatīkṣetrasyārohaṇāddevi labhate vipulāṃ śriyam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyatinṛtyanti pitarasteṣāṃ tuṣṭāścaiva pitāmahāḥādīśvaraṃ mahāliṅgaṃ pūrvabhāge pratiṣṭhitamspṛṣṭvā tu mānasaṃ tatra mucyate bhavabandhanātye punarbhāvitātmānastatra snātvā janārdanamdhanānāṃ kāñcanaṃ yadvat pavitrāṇāñca dakṣiṇāaśvamedhastu yajñeṣu yathā śreṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥdevarṣīṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭho nārado mama suvrateuttare kālikṣetrasya devadevo janārdanaḥkuśāvartasya pāścātye krośamātrāntare sthitaḥcaturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāmekādaśyāñca parvaṇiso'śvamedhamavāpnoti tatra vā sevane kṛtedakṣiṇe kalpavṛkṣaśca krośamātrañca madhyamamatra yaddīyate dānaṃ kurukṣetrādhikaṃ phalamprayāge kubjitīrthe vā vagāhya na punarbhavetaśvakrānte picchilāyāṃ muṇḍane uttamaṃ phalamtāvatsakhyaṃ kalpaśataṃ brahmaloke virājatebhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ vrajettatra snātvā mahāmāghyāṃ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulamabhūdbrāhmī ca vārāhī lakṣmīścaivānumadhyamāsampūjya ca trayodaśyāṃ mucyate bhavabandhanātbhādre māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ na śoko jāyate kvacitviṣṇudhārājale snātvā nākapṛṣṭhe [svargaloke] pramodatekālidhārājale snātvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyātkṣetraṃ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ nāma kardinaṃ ha varjayet (?)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śṛṅgāṭakaṃ samāruhya pūjayecca kapardinamante bhargagṛhaṃ yāti tato mokṣamavāpnuyātkālanarā nadī khyātā sarvapāpapramocinīnavamyāṃ vā maheśāni pūjayet pārvatīpatimviṣṇukūṭasamudbhūte pāpa hara namo'stu tevāntaṃ daśākṣarayutaṃ raśmibinduvibhūṣitampūjane'rghyapradāne ca yo japedvijitendriyaḥkallolā ca śikhaṇḍī [śikhinī] ca śatarudrā ghṛtārcikācatuḥ snātvā caturdaśyāṃ grahadoṣairna lipyatekallolāsaṅgame snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohativāsavaṃ snāpayāmāsa varāhasya mukhodgatātatra śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tīre kurukṣetrasamaṃ phalamte dhanyāḥ puruṣā jātā ye vasantyuttare priyetasyāḥ pūrve ca krośānte maṅgalāyāśca paścimetasyāṃ snātvā maheśāni tatkṣaṇāt pātakī bhavetgautamasyāśramājjātā ataḥ [yataḥ] śailā [śailāt] sarasvatīpūrve sauraśilā tasya pūrvabhāge vyavasthitāyāvat [tārā] pūjāvahā devī tāvat toya na saṃspṛśetūrdhvā yā [ūrdhvārthe] gautamakṣetrāt puṇyatoyā saridvarātīre naiva vaset tasyāstoyaṃ naiva spṛśet kvacituddhṛtena ca toyena yaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥsitagaṅgāmbhasi snāyādāgastye vā samāhitaḥsarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ pīṭhaṃ paramadurlabhambhadrapīṭhetivikhyātaṃ śatatīrthasamanvitamgṛhagopurasaṃyuktaṃ mahācatvarabhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsādo jayamadhyastho mantro'ya parikīrtitaḥviniyogo dharmakāme jāyate mama suvratesvastikaṃ prathamaṃ deyaṃ patrāṣṭakasamanvitamdharaṇīsadanaṃ kuryāt saraktaṃ [mūla] guṇasammatampūrve kāmañca śrībījaṃ prāsādaṃ praṇavaṃ tathāraśmibindusamāyuktaṃ smarañcaiva vahiśchadegairikena likhitvā ca kuṅkuma-rocanena vānāgajena sapuṣpeṇa na kuśena kadācanana kadācid budhaḥ kuryāt śambhuṃ gauryā viyojanamarghyapātraṃ svarṇamayaṃ vilvāmitrakapātrakamekāṅgulantu śarakāsa yatra vinisammitam (?)śastaṃ bhadradārumayaṃ sahakāramapatrayācaturbhujaṃ trinetrañca dakṣiṇe ca triśūlakamśvetaṃ śvetāmbaradharaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitamdevadānavagandharvairarcitaṃ vā manoharamasitāṅgādayaḥ patre śrīkaṇṭhādīṃśca tadvahiḥśaṅkhapadmanidhiścāṣṭau brahmāṇamagrato'rcayetrāmādyāḥ sarvataḥ pūjyā grahāṃścaiva ca dikpatīnnaivedyañcaiva pānīyaṃ śrīphalañca nivedayetmodakaṃ pāyasañcaiva dhānyaṃ haimantikaṃ tathā(dhānyañcaiva nīvārādīn)]śimvīṃ karkīñca mānañca kavīraṃ madhukāni cacandraṃ śākaṃ candrabimbamagravaktraṃ prarohakamvādhrīnasañca eṇañca śaśakaṃ salakaṃ tathāvārāhañca tathā kaurmaṃ kṛṣṇacchagaṃ tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahiṣasya ca khaḍgasya prayatnena vivarjayetsarārīñca kapotañca tathā pārāvataṃ sitamṭiṭṭibhaṃ raktapucchañca hārītaṃ kāṣṭhakukkuṭamtathā citrabakaṃ navyaṃ vartakaṃ raktatuṇḍakamśastānyetāni māṃsāni varjanīyāni tvaṃ śṛṇumayūrañcaiva dātyūhaṃ tathā ca grāmyakukkuṭammatsyaṃ vaiḍālikaṃ varjet rājīvaṃ madguraṃ tathākuvaṅkuṭaṃ jālapādān tathā citrabakaṃ priyebhojayecca prayatnena śambhunā tān śṛṇu priyeśastakaṃ vikirañcaiva varvāśākañca vṛtrakamvṛtrikā pucumardañca tathā ca hinamocikā [dīnamīcikā]puṣpāṇi yāni deyāni varjanīyāni yāni cajalajāni ca deyāni karavīrāṇi dāpayetdroṇapuṣpañca nālañca javā siṃhāsyakaṃ tathāmallikā campakāśokaṃ punnāgaṃ nāgakeśaramketakīṃ vandhujīvañca śirīṣaṃ bakulaṃ tathāmādhyañcaiva sitāśokaṃ karṇikāraṃ vivarjayetaṣṭottarasahasreṇa śivamālā upāhṛtāvarjayet sarvadeveṣu trivarṇañca vivarjayetsarvakṣṛṇaṃ sarvapītaṃ na deyaṃ mama suvrateraktakṛṣṇaṃ na dadyāt tu śvete pītaṃ na dāpayetśivamālā bāhumātrā caturaṅganasammatājalajānāṃ yathāyogaṃ mālye dattaṃ vivarjayethastamānena tat kuryāccaturhastaṃ tathottamamkaniṣṭhaṃ daśahastañca tathā ṣoḍaśahastakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyeṣāñcaiva patrāṇāṃ tatra saṃkhyā na duṣyatipañcapatrakṛtaṃ mālyaṃ śāṅkarañca na duṣyatitulasīvilvakahlāraṃ dhātrīpatraṃ tamālakamcaturdaśyāṃ thā rātrau śivāya ca nivedayetna kāṣṭhena na vaṃśena na keśena kadācanaśatahastamitaṃ datvā rājalakṣmīmavāpnuyāttulasyāḥ śatahastena śivāya ca nivedayetkaravīrasya raktasya dadyānmālyaṃ samāhitaḥrājasūyasya yajñasya labhate phalamuttamamjātīyūthyoḥ kṛtā mālā sarvaśvetena duṣyatimalayācalasambhūtamathavā bhṛguṇānvitamdvisamantu pradadyāttu ekaikaṃ na kadācanacatuḥsamañca kathitaṃ dvisamañca kalāgaruḥagaruṃ na dadedekaṃ guggulena samanvitamniśavo kṛṣṭakañcaiva kuśītaṃ gandhamuramadamtilatailena snehena ghṛtenābhyaṅgamācaretśālipiṣṭakacūrṇena yavacūrṇena śāṅkarivāriṇā prathamaṃ snānaṃ kṣīreṇa tadanantaramguḍena snānaṃ kuryācca kṣīradhārāñca pātayetśatena madhyamaṃ kuryāt kaniṣṭha pañcaviṃśakamśatena madhyamaṃ devi kaniṣṭhaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥarghasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryād vāruṇaṃ kalaśaṃ punaḥastreṇa snāpayeddevi mahāsnānaṃ vidhīyatenidrārthaṃ samupāsate]māsānte vā maheśāni kūrcayet mama sundari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na kūrcayet śūkarasya vālairnaiva kadācanaprabhāte snāpayelliṅgaṃ madhyāhne tadanantarammadhyandine śeṣayāme mahāpūjāvasānakesaptabhirbilvapatraiśca pañcapatraiśca mārjayetnārikelajalairdevaṃ snāpayenmadhubhistathāpadmapatrasya rajasā vastrakārpāsajena vāghṛtena cālayeddīpaṃ paritaḥ pañcakaṃ nyasetsnānabhojanakāle caturdaśyāmaṣṭamīṣu cagodohamātramāpekṣyaṃ pūjānte dantamātrakampauṣasya ca trayodaśyāṃ divyeśaṃ na spṛśet kvacittṛtīyaṃ kāmaśatruñca caturthaṃ hi vikambanamvyastena vā samastena tadā antanamo'nvitampūrṇimā māghamāsasya magharkṣe lakṣyate yadākāyavāṅmanasāśu tadbhāvenānanyamānasaḥkalpavṛkṣaṃ vaṭaṃ ramyaṃ yatra sākṣājjanārdanaḥtaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpāt saptajanmasamudbhavātyaḥ paśyati tṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe divyanāmakamkārtikasya caturdaśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ pinākinamyatphalaṃ sarvadāneṣu vratena niyamena cadṛṣṭvā naroñjaliṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat praṇipatya cadṛṣṭvā liṅgaṃ naro natvā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabhamśriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sarvaiḥ pramuditairguṇaiḥtriḥsaptakulasamuddhṛtya naraḥ śivapuraṃ vrajetgandharvāpsarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivaḥ syāt sa caturbhujaḥsarvajñaḥ satyavādī ca jāyate gatamatsaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhyasya ca śivajñānaṃ tato muktimavāpnuyāttasyeṣṭāni prasidhyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇārasaṃ rasāyanañcaiva pādukāñjanameva cakamaṇḍaluṃ sākṣasūtraṃ yaṣṭimajīvanaṃ (?) tathājvaladagnisphuliṅgormivepitaṃ triśikhaṃ yadiviṣe nyastaṃ viṣaṃ hanyāt kuṣṭhaṃ hanyāt tanau sthitammahāgrāhagṛhīteṣu jvalamānaṃ vicintayetbālānāmaṅgakeśānāṃ rakṣā bhavati nityaśaḥevaṃ tatra prabhāvo'pi devadevasya śāṅkaritrisandhyamāsamekantu sarvarogān vināśayetlaṅghane samasūtrasya brahmahatyāñca vindatinivartanaṃ punastatra vāsaṃ kṛtvā tadāvadhiyasyāgre bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā prakuryāt praṇatiṃ budhaḥjyotirliṅgasya nirmālyaṃ naivedyaṃ parameśvarianyeṣāṃ śambhuliṅgānāṃ sthāpitānāṃ varānanenaśyed vilvaphalenāpi tasmāt tatparivarjayetsomeśvarañca kedāraṃ manīṣaṃ kāmamīśvaramdivyeśañcaiva jalpīśaṃ nandīśaṃ kakudeśvaramcyavanākhyaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ koṭīśaṃ siddhināyakamprakīrtitāḥnayet saugavatīrthañca snāpayedarṣajairjalaiḥtatra dṛṣṭvā naro nārīṃ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyātpūjayedvidhivad devaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvātha kaścanavasante viṣuve yātrāṃ kuryānnīlācalaṃ pratikuryād hi divase yātrāṃ vittake ayanaṃ vinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ nayecca dakṣiṇāṃ diśamvarṣāsu caturo māsān caturdaśyāṃ divāgamedarśayeddivyayānañca tatra dṛṣṭvā ca muktibhākkapilāśatadānena yatphalaṃ puṣkare smṛtamkanyāśatapradānena yat phalaṃ makare ravauvalidānena vidhivad yatphalaṃ samudāhṛtamsuvarṇaśataniṣkena dattena yatphalaṃ smṛtampañcamyāṃ tvamāvasyāyāṃ daśamyāṃ grahaṇeṣu catatra dṛṣṭvāsanaṃ dhānyaṃ sarvaṃ hanti na saṃśayaḥvakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa pratipuṣpeṇa pūjayetpaśūnāṃ pataye caiva divyeśāya namo'stu tetryambakāya trinetrāya vaibhavāya namo namaḥdaṇḍine śaṅkukarṇāya kāmaratnāya vai namaḥvilohitāya dhūmrāya kamalāya namo namaḥnama stutāya guhyāya gopeśāya namo namaḥnamo jyeṣṭhāya proṣṭhāya gopeśāya namo namaḥpañcāṅgīyavihaṅgāya divyeśāya namo namaḥyajñavāhāya daṇḍāya divyeśāya namo namaḥyatphalaṃ snānadānena devatāprekṣaṇena canatvā tīrthaṃ named dūrān naraścodaṅmukhaḥ śuciḥsaṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastamacetanamnamaḥ śivāya śāntāya sarvapāpaharāya canābhimātrajale sthitvā vidhivad devatāpitṝnūrdhvabāhuṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utthāyārghyaṃ nivedayetmānasañca tato gacchet kuverācaladakṣiṇe

sanskrit: tatra svacchodakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ śivasya vivaraṃ smṛtam [subham]śivamānasadeveśa yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtamanena vidhivat snātvā sva [ṣat] pitṝṃśca pratarpayettvamāpaḥ saritāṃnātha jagat kāraṇasattamamityanena tu mantreṇa snāyāde [snāpayeccaṃ] tannivedayetdhanuraṣṭapramāṇañca kuṇḍaṃ vārāṇasīyakamsāgarebhyaḥ samuddhṛtya jalamekīkṛtaṃ tvayimanteṇa snātvā vidhivaddadyādarghyaṃ vibhūtayesarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sa gacchet tridaśālayamtarpayet pīṭhadevāṃśca sarvān bandhāṃśca yatnataḥprayañcha kāmānatulān pāpācca trāhi sarvataḥbrahmaśailasya vāyavye nātidūre vyavasthitammantreṇa snātvā deveśi dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvarammārkaṇḍeyo muniśreṣṭhastapastepe mahāmatiḥkalpavṛkṣaṃ tato gatvā sakṛt kṛtvā pradakṣiṇamnamo vyaktasvarūpāya mahāpralayavāsinepāṭhaḥ adhikaḥ]paśyed devañca divyeśaṃ muktirnāstyatra saṃśayaḥdakṣiṇāśāsamārohānmahābhayakaraṃ bhavetuttare caiva dhanavān jāyate mama sundarimūlamantreṇa sampūjya devaṃ divyeśvaraṃ haramtrilocana namastestu namaste nāgabhūṣaṇamārkaṇḍeyahrade devi vārāṇasīhrade tathāchāyāṃ tasya samākramya kalpavṛkṣasya pārvatidṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṅgasambhūtaṃ brahmatoyasamaṃ param

sanskrit: athavā parameśāni narāṇāṃ pañcamuṇḍakānniyutañcāthavā koṭiṃ nṛmuṇḍān parameśvariāyāmaprasthito devi caturhastau samācarettataḥ paraṃ mahādevi śatahastamitāñcaretpūrvoktabhūtanāthāya namo mantreṇa deśikaḥevantu dakṣiṇe devi śmaśānādhipamādarātśmaśānamuttare tadvat pūjayitvā baliṃ dadetpādyādibhiranenaiva kuṇḍebhyaḥ paripūjayettatraiva pūjayed bhaktyā bhāratīṃ svasvavigrahām [śubha]anena manunābhyarcya baliṃ tasyai nivedayetdayāṃ kuru mahābhāga siddhido bhava majjayeśave kuryād vahnisaṃsthaṃ pāśamindukalānvitampādyādibhiranenaiva kuṇḍebhyaḥ paripūjayetvāyavye hrīṃ bhadrakālyai namo mantreṇa tatparamagnau hrīṃ caṇḍogrāyai namo mantreṇa sādhakaḥśmaśānavāsino ye ye devā devyaśca bhairavāḥanena praṇavādyena puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ kṣipetviṣṭarāsanamāstīrya upaviśya maheśvaristhānaṃ pariṣkṛtya natvā devīṃ dhyāyan gṛhaṃ vrajetkīlakaṃ naiva kuryāttu trimuṇḍopari karhicitbilvamūle śmaśāne vā nirjane caikaliṅgakeevaṃ vā prothayitvā ca nāraṃ muṇḍaṃ vidhānataḥyat kṛtvā sarvasiddhānāmadhipo bhuvi jāyategurustvaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ karuṇāmayasāgaratvayā tatra viśeṣeṇa vada me candraśekhara

sanskrit: saṃjapet śatarudrīyaṃ kañcid vedādikaṃ japetgovindo brahmaṇaścaiva pāripātraḥ subhadrakaḥādityaśca kaseruśca manaśca mānasastathāagrataḥ pūrvabhāge tu nīlaśca kumudastathā(rāmaśca lakṣmaṇaścaiva śubhado |)]kuruśca dharmarūpaśca kāhālo lona eva cakamalaḥ kāmadhenuśca haraśca makarandakaḥete lauhityasyānte [ete vai madhyaprānte tu] tu paścimādiṣu kīrtitāḥāgneye jālaśailaśca aiśānye rākṣasācalaḥsahasraṃ vārāṇasīkṣetraṃ śṛṇu cāntargṛhaṃ priyenārohenmalabhadrañca mahāpātakamāpnuyātetadantargṛhaṃ devi sarvatīrthamayaṃ smṛtamduṣkṛtaṃ yanmaheśāni kalpe brahmavadhaiḥ samamtaddurlabhaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥso'pi duḥkhavinirmukto muktimāpnoti mānavaḥ [durlabhām]atra dehaṃ parityajya te'pi yānti parāṃ gatimamuktāstan na paśyanti muktāḥ paśyanti cetasātatra pivan na sevante saṃsārabhayamocakambhaviṣyanti sadādevi dharmāśrayavivarjitāḥsarvapāpapraśamanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalau yugebhadrapīṭhaṃ praviṣṭasya tat sarvaṃ vrajati kṣayamjanmāntarasahasreṣu puṇya-yānamavāpnuyāttat sarvañcaiva paurastyaṃ caureṇāpi hṛtañca yatmahākūle [mahātīrthe] nimagnañca tat kulaṃ pāralaukikamantargṛhaṃ samāsādya te yānti paramāṃ gatim

sanskrit: tatra snātvā brahmalokaṃ na paśyed yamasādanammayūre caiva divyeśaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajampāripātre sthitā durgā tasyā mantreṇa pūjayetvijaye ca jayantākhyaṃ nāgakaṃ mama lakṣaṇamkaśeruśaile yogīśaḥ mānase manasā śivākārtikākhye mahāśaile'tyugrastatra [yadyugrastatra] nāyakaḥgayāśiro gayāśaile viṣṇoścaiva padadvayamkṛṣṇaśaile sthitaḥ kṛṣṇo vanaśaile vanastathāsubhadre nīlavāsī ca mandare ca janārdanaḥkuberaśaile padmākṣi śivaviṣṇorviladvayamdharmaśaile mahāyūpe devī kāmeśvarī sthitālolākhye jambhakeśaśca liṅge paśupatīśvaraḥkamale kamalaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmadhenau tu keśavaḥkāmaśaile sthitā sītā anasūyāśrame priyeprapitāmahaśca gomedhe gavākṣe viṣṇuravyayaḥtatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kāmakuṇḍasya dakṣiṇesampūjya gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyacandanaiḥjāgaraṃ kurute tatra sa yāti paramāṃ gatimtasyāḥ svacchodakaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vidyatedhanuṣāñca tathā koṭī rakṣyate gaṇanāyakaiḥkṛttivāseśvaro devo draṣṭavyaśca punaḥ punaḥte dhanyāste kṛtārthāśca taiḥ prāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalamṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni canīlaśailasya pāścātye dakṣiṇe'pyatha suvratetatra sthitvā nimeṣañca sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet

sanskrit: daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ tatra vāsena tatphalamtena devamanuṣyeṣu seturvārkastu gīyatesūryatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśakamstutiṃ kuryācca stotreṇa nīlakaṇṭhe kadācananamaḥ kapālamālāya divyeśāya namo namaḥmayūraguhāvāsāya divyeśāya namo namaḥśaśāṅkādityanetrāya divyeśāya namo namaḥkhaṭvāṅgaśūlaḍamaruvilasadvāhave namaḥgopeśvarāya varadāya namo namastegatvā snātvā ca vidhivanmantreṇānena sādhakaḥsa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ snānamātreṇa mānavaḥpāṣāṇenāvṛtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ hastapañcadaśāyatamadhastāt samasūtrañca kuṇḍaṃ vārāṇasīyakammucyate pātakairghoraiḥ saptajanmārjitairapivāsudevasarastatra snātvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet [pradam]brahmācalaṃ tato gatvā brāhmaṇān tatra pūjayettatra snātvā navamyāñca brahmaloke mahīyateaṣṭadhanvantaraṃ yāvat pañcadhanvantaraṃ tathābhāskarākhyaṃ saraḥ pūrve paṅktidhanvantaraṃ viduḥśakrarūpī śilā tatra tasya madhye vyavasthitaḥtataḥ ṣaṣṭirdhanurmānaṃ tīrthaṃ sārasvataṃ paramdvāviṃśaddhanurākīrṇamamṛtākhyantu vai saraḥtate'nu krauñcatīrthañca dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥtato'ṣṭadhanurākīrṇaṃ nandikuṇḍaṃ samujjvalamdhanuḥ saptadaśaṃ yāvad ūrdhvāśārāsakaṃ (vāsaka) saraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trayodaśyāñca snānena śivalokañca gacchatināsti tena samaṃ tīrthaṃ yamunāyā na saṃśayaḥkuṇḍaṃ hāri saṃjñakañca snātvā kratusamaṃ phalamṛṣidhanvantare pūrve puṣkarācaladakṣiṇedurgākūpañca tatraiva kālahastapramāṇataḥpūrve nagācale tatra sthāne śrīpuruṣottamegayākuṇḍajale devi gajavaddhi dhanurmitamsarvapāpavinirmukto mucyate vai ṛṇatrayāttatra snātvārcayelliṅgaṃ na yāti bhāskarībhayamtatraiva mānasaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇe caiva jānīhipaśyet siddheśvarīṃ yoniṃ raktapāṣāṇarūpiṇīmatyādakṣiṇabhāge tu nātidūre ca saṃsthitākāmakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā kāmānāpnoti nityaśaḥastahastamitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pāṣāṇatrayamadhyagammadhyāhne lavaṇaṃ vā tu aparāhṇe tu kṛṣṇakamyā dhārā kāmakuṇḍasya jaṭodakā prakīrtitādakṣiṇe śivakuṇḍasya yā dhārā sā viyannadīvahnikūṭasya madhye tu yā dhārā giriniḥsṛtāpaścime makarandasya niḥsṛtā bhūmipīṭhagāvakrakūṭasya yā ghārā sā vijñeyā ca gomatītaduttare saptadhārā dhanuḥ saptatrayāntaresnātvā ca vāruṇe kuṇḍe vārurṇa lokamāpnuyātsaptahastamitaṃ liṅgamāyāme cākṣihastakamtasmādīśānakāṣṭhāyāṃ vahnikūṭe'nalaṃ śivamlauhityapāyasi snātvā āruhya vahniparvatam

sanskrit: vahnikūṭasya vāyavye sarpākārastu tad [sarpākārastadā] giriḥpurastād bhairavasyātha kuṇḍaṃ mānasasaṃjñakamtasya tīre girivaro nando vipulaparvataḥekākṣareṇa haṃsena pūjayed vṛṣabhadhvajammayūrad vāyukoṇe ca dhanuṣāṃ saptakaṃ mitamtato gacchet svargadvāraṃ kāmadīśān tato diśiupoṣya rajanīmekāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhetdhanustrayaṃ mayūrasya antike nandanaṃ smṛtamtasyottare brahmasaro mūrtirgośca saraḥ śubhamtato gacchenmaheśāni varāhasya biladvayam [vilatrayam]tatra gatvā caturdaśyāṃ lauhitye parikīrtitamekahaṃseśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ madhye tu parikīrtitamekahaṃseśvare snātvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhettīrthaṃ rāmahradaṃ tatra aṣṭaṣaṣṭirdhanurmitamkṛtakṛtyo bhaved devi aśvamedhañca vindatitasmin pañcahrade snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥravikandarpayormadhye yā dhārā sā sarasvatītatra snātvā mahāmādhyāṃ prayāgasnānajaṃ phalamjyotiṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ samyak samaśnutetaṃ praṇamya jagannāthaṃ vājimedhaphalaṃ labhetarcayitvā mahādevamupavāsaparāyaṇaḥtato vrajenmayūrañca pūrvāśābhimukhena tupade pade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ bhavati dharmataḥmayūraṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ girirūpadharaṃ harimkalpakoṭiśatasthāya kalpavṛkṣadharāya ca

sanskrit: mayūragirimāruhya dakṣiṇaṃ sāgaraṃ mayānamaste brahmaputrāya namaḥ śantanusūnavemayūragirimāruhya paśyato vihagācalamtadā abhīkṣṇaṃ deveśi brāhmaṇānāñca sampadaḥtadā tu makare rājye hāhākāraśca jāyateyadā bhavati deveśi cāturvarṇasya sampadaḥtadā tu kṣatriyo rājā dharmarājye sthiro bhavetpañcavarṣāntare devi jalpīśaścāti mlecchakaḥyadā tu dakṣiṇe tasya krūro rājā bhavedanutadā pariharedvāso bhadrapīṭhe viśeṣataḥsaṃśayaḥtadā pṛthvī bhaved bhogyā bhaviṣyati phalādhikābhānave'rghyaṃ tato dadyād brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥtatra snātvā maheśāni tiryag yonau na jāyateca tridivaṃ) | pāṭhaḥ keṣucit pāṇḍulipiṣu nāsti] vrajettasyāñca parvaṇi snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatikapotakuṇḍasambhūtā kapilenāvatāritātasyāḥ pūrve ca krośānte divyanāmā sarasvatīayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāntyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥyadā pūrvamukhaṃ yāti brāhmaṇānāṃ bhayantadāyadā aiśānye gamanaṃ mahāmārī tadā bhavetpaścimasthāśca ye kecid dhana-dhānya-kṣayo bhavettatra vāsaṃ na kuryācca dūrataḥ parivarjayettasmin snāne bhaved yaddhi vāyurlakṣmīḥ pravardhateyāvacca bandhanamurvyāstāvad kulaṃ śapanti ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nadīnirodhake toye yastu snānaṃ samācarettasyāḥ paścima-bhāge tu dakṣiṇe parameśvaritasyāḥ sampūjanādeva sarvān kāmānavāpsyatetatra liṅgaṃ gaṇeśasya pūjayitvā śriyaṃ labhetyonirūpāṃ mahāmāyāṃ pūjayed bhaktitatparaḥdviputra iti vikhyātastatra snātvā divaṃ vrajetsā dhārā tāpinī nāma snātvā naśyati pātakamniḥsṛtā sarvapāpaghnī digvāsā nāma viśrutātasyāṃ snātvā mandireṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatikārttikyāṃ grahaṇe caiva ayane viṣuve tathākārtikaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ yaḥ snāyāt parameśvaribhaumavāre caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāñca śanaiścarenamaste sarvapāpaghni svacche svacchāmbuvāhinitadvatśrāntaṃ sadānantaṃ pārśvaṃ daśasu varddhitagsnātvānena tu mantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ samāhitaḥmuṇḍanañca tataḥ kuryādupavāsaṃ samācaretdigvāsālokavikhyātā tīrthānāmuttamā nadītārayet sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca śāṅkarisadevāsuragandharvā ṛṣayastu tapodhanāḥprātaḥ snātvā naro yastu niyamastho jitendriyaḥyojanaśatasāhasraṃ śrūyate sariduttamābrahmacārī śucirbhūtvā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥevaṃ dharmasamācāro yastu pāpān parityajetśatavarṣasamaṃ prāṇī svarge modeta śāṅkaridivyagandhaiśca liptaśca divyapuṣpopaśobhitaḥ

sanskrit: tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo rājate vā sa dhārmikaḥstambhairmaṇimayairdivyairdhvajavaidūryabhūṣitamreje vāgīśvaraḥ śrīmān sarvastrījanavallabhaḥsaṅgame tīrtharajasya bhuktiṃ muktiñca vindatitasyāñca vidhivat snātvā śivaloke mahīyateaśoka[soma]kuṇḍe daśamyāñca yaḥ snāyāt parameśvarisomasya duhitā kanyā cyavanena ca pālitātataḥ kagyāśramo nāma sarvatīrthamayaṃ śubhamdhanurdvādaśakaṃ yāvad antaḥ kṣetraṃ maheśvarirudrasya ca tathā viṣṇoḥ krauñcasya ca gaṇasya cavāsavasya tathā śyāmaṃ pāṣāṇābhaṃ paraṃ priyeyadā viṣṇupadaṃ raktaṃ dṛśyate parameśvaritasyottare mahāpuṇyaṃ tathā rudrapadaṃ priyevirājapaṃ [vivarjayet] vidhānañca tasmādatra samācarettārayet saptagotrāṇi kulamekottaraṃ śatamsarvalokaviśuddhātmā brahmaloke mahīyatejñānaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya yastu dehaṃ parityajetasmin kṣetre ca ekāgre lauhitye virajeṣu casiddhācale maheśāni paścimābhikrameṇa tunāradasya ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramadurlabhamtapastaptaṃ tatra pūrvaṃ nāradena mahātmanā [surarṣiṇā]brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tena brahmasara [brahmeśvara] iti śrutamrāmatīrthaṃ tato gatvā svajanānmucyate bhayāttāmreśvaraṃ [bhāseśvaraṃ] tato gacchet sarvavyādhivināśanamtato gacchet pūrvabhāgaṃ piṅgaleśvaramuttamam

sanskrit: tasmin tīrthe ca deveśi kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchatitāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyateakṣayaṃ modate svarge yāvaccanbradivākaraute muktāḥ svargamāyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathānivartitā purā tena vahantī sā mahānadīpradakṣiṇe tu yaḥ kuryāt yasmin kṣetre maheśvaritasyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge iṣukṣepadaśāṣṭakeāmrasyādhaḥ sthitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥ ṣoḍaśakaṃ mitambhūmipīṭhe sthitaṃ devaṃ śaṅkaraṃ parameśvaramsiddhacāraṇa-gandharva-kinnarāśca mahoragāḥpūrve brahmasaraścaiva uttare pārvatīvaṭaḥetanmadhyagataṃ kṣetraṃ sugandhaṃ nāti-viśrutamsnātvā ca dikkarāyinyāṃ saṃspṛśet pārvatīvaṭamtāraṃ ca maṅgalaṃ haṃsaṃ haṃsaṃ śravaṇavādanamchando'nuṣṭuv bhavo deva ityārthe viniyojayetkhaṭvāṅgañcaiva śūlañca varadañcābhayaṃ tathāsarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ sarvālaṅkāramaṇḍitampīṭheśān pūjayedagre yaddigīśān bahiryajetdevasyottarabhāge tu nātidūre vyavasthitamtatrābhiṣekaṃ kuryāttu pitṝdevārcane rataḥtriśūlatīrthayāmye ca dhanuḥ ṣaṣṭeranantaramsamabhyarcya tataścaitre māsi kṛṣṇe viśeṣataḥvarjayenmuṇḍanañcātra tathā kanyāśrameṣu catato vrajet kulakṣetraṃ devyāḥ kṣetraṃ sudurlabhamdevasyaiśānyabhāge tu saṃsthitā parameśvarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: manasā prārthitān kāmān labhate nātra saṃśayaḥkṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ baddhvā jānuspṛṣṭamahītalaḥnamo'nugrahakartre ca nāgeśāya namo namaḥpuruṣāya namaste'stu nāgeśāya namo namaḥnamastrailokyanāthāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥnamaḥ cakreśasaṃjñāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥnamastriśūlahastāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥkalākalādhināthāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥtatra devaṃ tryambakākhyaṃ liṅgaṃ mūrtigataṃ parambhūmipīṭhe vyavasthānaṃ tāreṇa pratipūjayetsaṃspṛśetdharmāraṇyaṃ mahākṣetraṃ gacchet tatra maheśvarinānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitameko viṣṇustathā cendro [candro] vidyādharagaṇairvṛtaḥmāsi māsi tu dvādaśyāṃ yo drakṣyati mama priyedevasya paścime bhāge viṣṇoḥ puṣkaratīrthakampaurṇamāsyāṃ tu jyaiṣṭhasya yastu yātrāṃ samācaretmahājyaiṣṭhyāntu yaḥ paśyenmādhavantu nareśvaramśikhidhvajānte yo jātaḥ śālo nāma bhaven nṛpaḥbālaprāyo yadā tatra kaivartaśca vināśakaḥekadvivarṣe sa bhaved droheṇaiva svayaṃ [tato] hataḥyadā punarbhavo jātastasminneva bhavennṛpaḥyadā tu yavano rājā vāṇaśūnyaśca vatsaraḥyadā kalerbhavedrājā tasmin kāmasamudbhavaḥlakṣmīnārāyaṇo nāma bhavedvaṃśonnataḥ sutaḥ

sanskrit: tadyogādabhavat kaulo divyavīro maheśvarisamāyogī [sa no yogī bhaved] yajeddevi mumukṣuḥ kulakāminiātmānaṃ paramaṃ brahma cintayedathavā na cetdivyayogamidaṃ devi sāvadhānena gopayabindutrayaṃ kalākrāntaṃ prathamaṃ paricintayetbālārkakoṭisaṃjyotiḥ prakāśitadigambarambinduyāvanmadhyadehaṃ kaṇṭhādikaṭiśīrṣakamyonyādikañca pādāntaṃ kāmāntaṃ paricintayetevaṃ kāmakalārūpaṃ svātmadehaṃ vicintayetsaṃkṣepāt kathayiṣyāmi tayorācāramuttamamidamācaraṇaṃ devi paśorna divyavīrayoḥyadi daivād maheśāni madyādi ca na labhyatetathāpi na hi vaktavyamidamācamanaṃ śivetasmād madyādikaṃ devi sevitavyaṃ dine dineguruṇā dīkṣito bhūtvā kaulanyāsaṃ samācaretmayoktaṃ tat krameṇaiva abhiṣekadvayaṃ caretdivyaṃ vā vīrayogaṃ vā yathā karmānusārataḥyastu divyo bhavet satyaṃ sa viṣṇurnātra saṃśayaḥyatra deśe narastiṣṭhed divyo vā vīrapuṅgavaḥsiddhikṣetraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ samantāddaśayojanamyoginī durlabhāpyetadḍākinībhiḥ sarīsṛpaiḥguhyakairdānavairvāpi mārībhiryakṣakinnaraiḥ [māyābhiḥ]avaśyaṃ maṅgalaṃ tatra tatpurīparivardhanamsphuranti sarvaśāstrāṇi sarvasmādapi nityaśaḥtaravo'pi hi jīvanti paśuḥ pakṣī sa jīvati

sanskrit: yadā brahmasarodbhūtiḥ ratnapīṭhāt samāgataḥye ye madhyā nṛpataya uttamāḥ santi pārvatiyaḥ pāpaḥ kṣmāpatirdevi tasmin rājye vinaśyatitattīre nagaraṃ kṛtvā rāṣṭraṃ pāpairnṛpo hataḥtasya paścimabhāge tu yā nadī sā sthitā śubhātarkarūpagate varṣe saubhārācca parasparamaiśvaryatantre tadvarṣe śeṣe rājā vinaśyatitadavadhi ca kāmākhyāṃ yo rājā paśyati dhruvamtadā brahmasaro jātaḥ śaṅkaraḥ kakudeśvaraḥyasmin śāsati saumāraṃ drohastu vividho bhavetkāmapīṭhatrayañcaiva svayameva svayaṃ hṛtaḥaśvakrāntādvayaṃ kuṇḍaṃ samudbhūtaṃ svakālataḥasmin śāsati rājye tu drohasturyavidho bhaveteṣaḥ pañcākṣaro mantro mālāyāḥ parikīrtitaḥjapānte śirasi nyasya satrānte ca stutiṃ paṭhetanulomavilomena mūlamantreṇa pūjayetjaya kāmeśi cāmuṇḍe jayabhūtāpahāriṇiviśvamūrte śubhe śuddhe virūpākṣi trilocanemanojave jaye jambhe bhūtākṣi kṣudhite kṣayecāmuṇḍe ca mahākāli kāli kapālahāriṇicāmuṇḍe kulamālāsye tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭre mahābalebhīmākṣi bhīṣaṇe devi sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkarikāli karāli vikrānte kāmeśvari harapriyekāmākhye kāmarūpasthe kāmeśvari harapriye(atra paṭalasamāptirnāsti)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
