sanskrit: yatra kutra mṛto devi divyo vā vīrapuṅgavaḥkuladharmamimaṃ devi saṃsevyaṃ sanirantarammunayo mānavo nāgāḥ siddhagandharvakinnarāḥkuladharmaprasādena te sarve kulanāyakāḥye yathā māṃ prapadyante te tathā phalabhāginaḥvānaprastho patiścaiva bhaveyuste kulānugāḥguḍārdrakarasenaiva surā tu brāhmaṇasya cavaiśyasya mākṣikaṃ proktaṃ kāṃsyasthaṃ varavarṇinibhūrjadhānyādikaṃ yadyaccarvaṇīyaṃ pracakṣatebrāhmaṇī brāhmaṇasyaiva kṣatriyā kṣatriyasya catrivarṇānāṃ maheśvariśūdrā vā brāhmaṇādīnāṃ trivarṇānāmabhāvataḥtrivarṇavihitānāñca yatīnāṃ śṛṇu sampratimaithunaṃ paramaṃ [śayanaṃ] divyaṃ yatīnāṃ parikīrtitampauṣṭikādīni sarvāṇi madyāni tasya śāmbhavipūrvoktā ca bhavenmudrā devatā sādarānvitākṣatayonistāḍitavyā akṣatāṃ naiva tāḍayetdvādaśābdādhikā yoniryāvat ṣaṣṭiḥ prajāyateavadhūtasamācārāḥ śūdre sarvāḥ prakīrtitāḥbrāhmaṇīṃ kṣatriyāṃ vaiśyāṃ tyaktvā tu sarvajātiṣugṛhamedhī bhavecchudro nānyāśramī bhavet kadāguruvad dve trivarṇe tu tathā mātāmahe kulekālī tārā chinnamastā sundarī bhairavī tathāetāsāṃ sādhakācāraścāvadhūtaḥ samaḥ smṛtaḥsarvasthāneṣu sarvatra na viśeṣaṃ kvacid bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ vipro devatāyai svagātrarudhiraṃ dadetp. 44) śaktināśaḥ vikāro'sti svadeharudhirārpaṇeśuddhyādi sakalaṃ devi vyañjakasyāparārdhakambhairavāya dvitīyena śivatvañca tṛtīyakampareṇa paratāṃ yāti mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥjāyante na bhairavāste veśāstatsamadarśinaḥtathā māyāvṛte vṛtte jñānadīpena dṛśyate [hanyate]jīvanmukto dehabhāvo dehānte kṣemamāpnuyātbrahmadhyānaṃ maheśāni brahmanirvāṇakāraṇamsvakīyajīvadehādi brahmāṇḍo'nanta eva cana cintanīyaṃ tatsarvaṃ nāstīti paribhāvayetahameva jālarūpaścādhāradehavarjitaḥbrahmadhyānamidaṃ proktametat sthiratarāya cakṣaṇaṃ brahmāhamasmīti yaḥ kuryādātmacintanammayā vā brahmaṇā vāpi viṣṇunāpi kathañcanadravyābhāve maheśāni jalenāpi samācaretvakṣye'yutavidhiṃ bhadre śṛṇuṣva kamalānanepibed yogī maheśāni satyaṃ satyaṃ śivaḥ [varānane] svayampāpapuṇyaṃ paśuṃ hatvā jñānakhaḍgena śāmbhavimanasā sendriyaṃ sarvaṃ saṃyamyātmani yojayetaśeṣabrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ parabrahmaṇi saṃnayetgopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ mama sarvasvasādhanamjāyāśeṣa jagannātha bhaktavatsala īśvaradivyavīraprabhedena śrutaṃ yogadvayaṃ mayāāsaphalaṃ sādhanañca vada me parameśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svāhātadante svapurāvāhi kāli sambodhanadvayamdehi padāt kālībījamante vahnivadhūntathāmahācamatkārakarī mahākālena bhāṣitātataḥ siddhā bhaved vidyā svapne tiṣṭhati nityaśaḥmṛtasañjīvanīṃ vidyāmataḥ śṛṇu nagātmajeamṛtaṃ bījamābhāṣya mṛtasañjīvanīti casasupteyaṃ mahāvidyā sārātsārataraṃ smṛtamnityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japamātreṇa śāmbhavisiddhidā sā bhavedvidyā mṛtasañjīvanī tataḥmantraṃ japan spṛśecchavaṃ tadā devi varānanevakṣye madhumatīṃ vidyāṃ sarvarañjanakāriṇīmtrailokyākarṣiṇī vidyā prokteyaṃ devadurlabhātataḥ siddhā mahāvidyā sarvajñānaprakāśinīnadīṃ ratnāni ca purīṃ striyaḥ śailān vanaspatīnpurasthānaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ rājñāñca vidviṣāmapinaktaṃ talpaśatajapāt siddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥpaśyāvatīmahāvidyāṃ sarvavidyāvinodinīmpraṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ tadantaramtrailokyavārtāmante ca kathaya dvandvamuccaretaṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ japedvarṣadvayaṃ priyetalpe sthitvā naktayoge japed mantraṃ śatāṣṭakamvṛttāntaṃ kathayet svapne vidyā padmāvatī śubhāalpasādhyaṃ mahādeva drutasiddhikaraṃ mahatpurā te kathitaṃ devi yogināṃ jñānasambhavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gopitavyaṃ prayatnena sarvadā paśusaṅkuleśatrunāma likhitvā tu vāmapādatale nyasetaṣṭottaraśataṃ devi tadā vādī vaśo bhavettārkṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā sarpo jaḍo bhavati kāminitathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi vaśīkaraṇamuttamampraṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya sundarī bhairavī tathāvaśaṅkari tathā procya aṃ iṃ ṛṃ tathā vadetanena manunā devi tailañca candanañca vātaccandanena tilakaṃ bhāle dadyānnagātmajecettu paśyati yaṃ devi sa vaśo nātra saṃśayaḥkiṃ punarmānavān devi sārvabhaumān narādhipānsarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ devi mohanaṃ paramādbhutampraṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya vadedrājamukhīpadamkāmabījaṃ tataḥ paścāddevī devīpadadvayamsambodhanāntaṃ deveśi padametaccatuṣṭayamsvāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ sarvavaśyaprado mahāntrivāraṃ dakṣahastena mukhaṃ saṃmārjayet kṛtīavaśyaṃ jāyate vaśyaṃ jagadetaccarācaramsvāpnavatī ca yā vidyā kathitāvagatā mayātadvadasva mahādeva yadi te'nugraho mayipraṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya vadhūbīja'm samuddharetdivā bhuktvā haviṣyānnaṃ rātrau japtvā sahasrakammanasā cintitaṃ yadyat tat sarvaṃ parameśvariyena vijñānamātreṇa sarvaṃ jānāti niścitamvidhānaṃ pūrvavat sarvaṃ japānte prārthanaṃ śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmadevasurūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥiti mantreṇa saṃprārthya sarvaṃ jānāti bhāvataḥ [tattvataḥ]rahasyaṃ paramaṃ ramyaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamamnirantaraṃ mahādevi sevitaḥ siddhaśaṅkaraiḥyācantaṃ parameśāni tasmāttvāṃ samupāśrayettvāṃ japantu tato [vinā] devi phalasiddhiḥ samīritāsiddhavidyāprabhāveṇa syuḥ susiddhāḥ surāsurāḥgopanīyaṃ khale duṣṭe paśupāmarasannidhautasmāt sarvaprayatnena gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥbhaktāya pāpahīnāya sādhakāya mahātmanedevadānavagandharvasiddhacāraṇasevitamparaṃ pāraṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ mahatkathayasya mahādeva kevalānandavṛṃhitamatyantaguhyaṃ paramaṃ devāsurabhayaṅkaramśṛṇu vakṣyāmi cārvaṅgi samāsena śivapriyebrahmāṇḍasyāyuṣaḥ śeṣe sarva sattvavivarjitamtvāṃ māṃ vinā maheśāni nāsīt kiñcijjagattrayemamādhikā yogyatā vā tavāpi vā maheśvaristhātuṃ sthānaṃ na kutrāsti kutra sthāsyāmi bhāviniviviktoḥaṃ sadā divye [devi] bhavasaṃsārakarmaṇiiti śrutvā tadā devī krodhenāruṇalocanāyad yat kṛtaṃ tvayā deva māmupāśritya sarvadāyoge hi te maheśāni mayā sarvamidaṃ tatamkāraṇāvasthayāpannā sadāhaṃ dhāturūpiṇī [dhātrīrūpiṇī]kāryabhāvasamāpannā sadā prakṛtirūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mama māyāmayamidaṃ viśvaṃ devacarācaramiti śrutvā vacasteḥaṃ vajratulyaṃ sudāruṇamvāritoḥaṃ [paritoḥaṃ] sadā devi duḥkhenāntarajena cajagāma paścime bhāge brahmāṇḍasya varānanesvadehabhasmanā daityaṃ prāgadṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ tathā [mudam]koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaprasthitampañcāśallakṣavadanaṃ jvālāvalisamākulamsarvabhāvairmatsadṛśaṃ vidhāya taṃ sudāruṇamso'pi tasthau dānavendraḥ śayyāṃ kṛtvā jalārṇavetadā mama mano jñātvā tvamavādīśca māṃ pratiājñāpaya mahādeva paśyāmi sakalaṃ śivauvāca tvāmahaṃ bhadre āgaccha paścimāṃ diśamstrīṇāṃ svabhāvo deveśi ya evādhaḥ sthito bhavetiti jñātvā mayoktaṃ tanniṣedhavacanaṃ śivetatra gatvā mahādevī jaganmohanakāriṇīkarān prasārya sakalān āha cāṭuvaco bhṛśamtrāhi māṃ kāmajaladhau nimagnaṃ svāṅgadānataḥāliṅgya patibhāvena jīvanaṃ rakṣa sundaritataḥ sā tvamavādīśca sakaṭākṣaṃ śucismitamtvaṃ vīryavān sarvavināśanaśca tvāṃ vai varāmo yadi tatkaroṣisa me hi bhartā na cānya eva tadādito yuddhamitaḥ śrayasvauccairnibhartsayāmāsa pralayāmbhodhighargharamsamāhartuṃ tadā daityo dhāvati smākhilaṃ jagattadā bodhena [vegena] mahatā japtvā [gatvā] ca dānaveśvaraḥpādāghātāduparatā magnāścaiva jalārṇave
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhvādhaśca kaṭāhāntaṃ mahābhīmataraṅgakamkṣamo'bhavatyadyad yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena kathituṃ naiva śakyateyattejasā maheśāni tatrāpi krodhamūrcchitaḥāścaryaṃ śṛṇu deveśi yuddhaṃ vṛttaṃ mahojjvalamjalajātāt kaṭāhāttu dhūlirutpadyate [budhirut] bhṛśamahaṃ yogaṃ samāśritya sūkṣmasūkṣmataraṃ vapuḥkathañcidapi na prāpya tvāṃ prahartuṃ daityarāṭ tadāvardhayitvā śarīraṃ svaṃ gharṣayitvā ca bāhunāiti sañcintya manasā vardhayitvā kalevaramuvāca tvāṃ tadā daityaḥ hatā yāsyasi kutra vātvayokto'sau ghoradaityastiṣṭha tiṣṭha sudurmateadhunaiva mahāduṣṭa jānāsi nahi māṃ kadā [kathaṃ]mayaiva pālyate sarvaṃ mama māyāmayaṃ jagatśṛṇu mūḍhavarāsmākaṃ paramaṃ maṅgalaṃ mahatbhajante māṃ yathā ye hi tathā kāmaṃ dadāmi tetvayāhaṃ sevitā daitya bahukālaṃ na saṃśayaḥśivo'si nātra sandeho yat kṛte yadbhramastavayad dṛṣṭvān punaḥ ko'pi kadāpyāvirbhavet kilatadrūpaṃ paramaṃ dhāma kālī rūpamiti śṛṇuityuktvāhaṃ tadā devi bhavāni bhavamocanīasakṛt parameśāni jātā tvaṃ kālikā tadāmuṇḍamālā valī ramyā muktakeśī smitānanāamākalāsamullāsā kirīṭojjvalavigrahāmahārāvaiścaturdikṣu yātā ghoraparākramaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samantād ghorarūpasthā mahāyuddhamahotsukāḥbhāsante satataṃ devi sarvāḥ sūryamayāḥ punaḥpratīto'sau mahākālyā dṛṣṭvā śrīmukhamaṇḍalamtatastaṃ dānavādhīśaṃ jñāne bhaktaṃ sunirmalambrahmāṇḍasahitaṃ mātā carvayitvā mṛtā kṣaṇātnānāyantrasya bṛhataḥ patākā vyāpikā sadāahaṃ jagāma sahasā tatra kāntāramuttamamsaṃdṛṣṭañca śrutaṃ yadyat kathituṃ naiva śakyateatīva bṛhadākārāḥ brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭikoṭiśaḥevañca vividhākārā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥsarvāścaryamayaṃ devi dṛṣṭvā kuśalamānasāḥahaṃ kā kutra āyātaḥ ko na pṛcchati kutracitkadā mama]tatra gatvā mayā sarvaṃ dṛṣṭamāścaryasundaramsukhamokṣayoḥdehaḥpurāṇamaṅgāni smṛtayo yāni yāni cajīvātmanoryathābhedastathā bhedāgameṣvapidṛṣṭvā varṇāvalī yātu tīvratejomayī śubhāanyāni sarvaśāstrāṇi kṣudrāṇi yāni kāni catato mayā śataṃ devi karṇikāntarmahojjvalamkoṭi koṭi mahāvahnitejomaṇḍalamaṇḍitamsūryakoṭisamābhāsaṃcandrakoṭi suśītalamvahnikoṭimahojjvalaṃ paraṃ brahmamayaṃ dhruvamsarvayajñamayaṃ devi sarvatīrthamayaṃ sadābrahmajñānamayaṃ devi brahmānandamayaṃ tathā

sanskrit: pramāṇaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ brahmatejaḥ paraṃ hitamsarvamāyāmayaṃ devi sarvavidyāmayaṃ punaḥsarvamuktimayaṃ devi sarvavedamayaṃ tathāsarvaśāstramayaṃ devi sarvayogamayaṃ tathāgataśarvaryatho'drākṣaṃ yathā sūryodayojjvalamsaṃśayaḥtataḥ ki~jalkapuñjeṣu gatvā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā kilanyāyo mīmāṃsakaṃ sāṃkhye pātañjalaṃ tathā punaḥtato varṇāvalīṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇikāprāntadeśataḥāyurvedabhiṣagvedā mayābhyastā tadaiva hisahasrādityasaṅkāśā śūdravarṇā mahojjvalāmayābhyastaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ tat kṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥtadantare yathā dṛṣṭaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhamvedāntamiti vikhyātaṃ varṇapuñjamahāprabhamtadantare mayā dṛṣṭaṃ varṇapuñjasamujjvalamsarvajñānamayaṃ devi sarvatīrthamayaṃ sadāpramāṇaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ śāstrādīnāṃ maheśvarimayābhyastaṃ hi tat sarvaṃ tat kṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥsarvajñānasarvatattvaṃ sarvasiddhimayo hyahamtata uḍḍīnamāsādya dvidale cāgataṃ mayātadā mama smṛtirjātā brahmaviṣṇukṛte punaḥcyutau svedau maheśāni tābhyāṃ jātau guṇocitautadā tau ca gatau tūrṇaṃ nāsikārandhrayordvayoḥīḍāyāśca tato viṣṇustatra gatvā ca tau śubhausadantau satataṃ devi vismṛtaṃ ki bhaviṣyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāvīśvarau maheśāni mahāduḥkhena duḥkhitautasmai dattaṃ mayā jñānaṃ mantraṃ paramamaṅgalamtasmai dattaṃ sarvaśāstraṃ vāṅmātreṇāgamaṃ vinātamādāya gatastatra brahmāṇḍe parameśvaraḥmahājñānī mahādevi tatkṣaṇāt sa pitāmahaḥsa vidhiḥ parameśāni mama śāsanatastadāgatavyathastadā brahmā hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ sadaiva hitadaṅgīkṛtya tajjñānaṃ saha tābhyāṃ maheśvariśivābhiryoginībhiśca mahānṛtyaparāyaṇānānāvādyamahollāsā nānālaṅkāragāthikā [-gāyikā]utthitaiḥ patitaiḥ puṣpairdivyagandhairmahotsukāśataśo brahmāṇḍasamā patākābhiśca rañjitāataḥ stotuṃ samārabdhā vayaṃ kālīṃ karālikāmtadādau [tadāsau] vidhirastauṣīt sarvaśāstreṇa bhaktitaḥyadguṇastvamaho dhātaḥ sarvaśāstrārthavismṛtaḥityājñaptastato dhātā kṛtakṛtyo'bhavattadātatastamavravīcchivādharmajño'si pālakastvaṃ bhava sṛṣṭeśca rakṣakaḥtatoḥaṃ paramāṃ nityāṃ kālīṃ brahmasanātanīmviṃśakoṭivatsarāṇāṃ māmuvāca tadā tu sāsaguṇastvaṃ mahāyogī sṛṣṭisaṃhārako bhavapañcakoṭidivyavarṣaṃ māmuvāca tatastu sākiṃ prārthyate mahādeva dadāmi nātra saṃśayaḥtiṣṭhāmi satataṃ mātastvadīyacaraṇāmbujetat koṭikoṭyaṃśayuddhaṃ kariṣyatyeva yo mayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaviṣyati [bhaviṣyasi] sa [tva] deveśa mahiṣāsuranāmadhṛktatā taṃ [tvāṃ] nāśayitvāhaṃ bhadrakālī svarūpataḥidānīṃ tvaṃ mahādeva mama pādatale sadāityājñaptā vayaṃ devyāḥ patitāḥ padasannidhautatraivāntaragāt kālī cidrūpā brahmaniṣkalāgopanīyaṃ prayatnena sarveṣāṃ sadhanottamamvadanto bhṛśaduḥkhārtā nimagnāḥ śokasāgarekīdṛk caraṇarāgaṃ te kṛpāsāgarasañcayamkiṃ bhūtaṃ nakhacandrāṇāṃ jyotiḥ paramamaṅgalamkiṃ bhūtaṃ kiṃ bhavenmātaḥ kva yātamidamadbhutamasmākaṃ mātṛbhāvena na paśyāmaḥ punaśca tat [tvāṃ]ruditvā ca ruditvā ca vayaṃ sarve tathā [tathāhvayan] sthitāḥnītā vayaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ varṣāṇāmambujekṣaṇemātaryātaḥ kva yātā tvamasmākaṃ [yātāsi] kiṃ bhaviṣyatidayā nāsti aho mātarvayante dīnabālakāḥtvāṃ vinā jananī nāsti nāsmākaṃ tāt [bhāva] eva cakathaṃ bhavati he mātarjñāyatāṃ svayameva hisovāca yoginī vāṇīṃ mahāmṛtapravarṣiṇīmmama nāśo nāsti kadā niḥsandehāstu tiṣṭhatadhyātvā tadrūpamamalaṃ japaṃ kuruta me manumidānīṃ brahmaṇo dehe viśa viṣṇo sthiro bhavayāvat sṛṣṭiṃ karotīśa imāṃ jñānakriyāmayīmicchājñānakriyāśaktīḥ sarvakāryārthasādhanīḥmahyaṃ dattvā jñānaśaktiḥ sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇīahaṃ viśāmi yuṣmāsu pūrṇarūpeṇa śaṅkare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ayaṃ hi vaktā śāstrāṇāṃ nāpyanyo'pi vidhirhariḥmohayiṣyāmi brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāpi maheśvaramayañca mādhavo dehe praviṣṭo brahmaṇastadātato brahmā svayaṃ jñātvā svayaṃ juhoti cāvyayamkiṃ karobhi kva gacchāmi iti cintāsamākulaḥjalameva sasarjādau vyāpakaṃ paramaṃ mahattatra sthitvā hemarūpamasṛjad vārthasañcayam [vīrya]tattad brahmāṇḍamākhyātaṃ plavate kāraṇārṇavekaromi satataṃ devi rudramūrtidharaḥ svayamekaikarudrarūpeṇa tiṣṭhāmi satataṃ śivetathā karomi satataṃ sthitvā tatkāraṇārṇavepratibrahmāṇḍamadhye tu tiṣṭhāmo nātra saṃśayaḥpraviśyekaikarūpeṇa anyatattvacatuṣṭayametaistu pañcabhistattvaiḥ sarvāṃ sṛṣṭimakārayatbrahmadehāt samudbhūya pālayāmāsa tāṃ sadāahaṃ hi parameśāni brahmadehaṃ samāśritaḥsarva kāryaṃ mamaivaitajjānāti hi jagannidhiḥdevādisakalaṃ devi digvidik ca carācaramsarvaṃ jānāti hi brahmā matkṛtaṃ māyayā punaḥruṣṭā cet [sā] saiva mātā me bhūmiyogaṃ prayacchatiyasya tuṣṭā mahādevi mama mātā hi kālikāaśrutaṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ brahmādīnāmagocaramidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yat proktaṃ kāraṇārṇavamsīmānaṃ vada deveśa yadi sneho'sti māṃ pratiatigopyaṃ sugopyaṃ hi brahmaviṣṇvādyagocaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahārṇavo bhaved devi mahākālo maheśvaraḥśūnyarūpaṃ hi krīḍārthaṃ bhartāraṃ paryakalpayatbhūtvārdhatejaso rūpā mahākālañca vibhratīsīmā pṛṣṭā tvayā devi sīmā [saiva] brahmaiva kevalamtat prakāśaṃ mahādevi vyāpyavyāpakavarjitamidaṃ hi sakalaṃ devi sarvaṃ māyāmayaṃ punaḥidaṃ hi kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparamidaṃ hi paramaṃ jñānaṃ sarvamāyānikṛntanamakoṭikoṭimahādānāt koṭikoṭimahātapātkoṭikoṭimahātīrthā vagāhācca [snānāt] maheśvaritadā mukto bhaved devi saṃsāre na punarbhavetyathānyo labhate naivaṃ [naiva] tathā kuru prayatnataḥgopanīyaṃ prayatnena mama sarvasvamuttamamjñānine devadeveśiṃ anyathā narakaṃ vrajetbrahmajñānaṃ mayā devi kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasigopanīyaṃ sadā bhadre paśupāmarasannidhaugaṇeśanandicandreśa govindavidhivanditayā proktā paramā vidyā kālī kaluṣanāśinīmudrāṃ baliṃ tathā homaṃ bhāvaṃ sthānaṃ tathaiva caidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi sthānaṃ bhedaṃ maheśvarajhaṭityeva mahādeva kṛpayā vada śaṅkaraprayāsasya ca bāhulyaṃ hitvā hi parameśvaradrutasiddhikaraṃ devi mahāmokṣaphalapradamtatra yad yat kṛtaṃ karma tadanantaphalaṃ labhetna tu maivaṃ mahādevi bhāvayuktaḥ saśaktikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anantaphaladā pūjā sarvatraiva jale sthaleśāktaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ vāpi śaivaṃ vānyaṃ tathā punaḥprātaḥ kālaṃ samārabhya yāvanmadhyandinaṃ bhavetnirvāṇaṃ tasya deveśi avaśyaṃ jāyate śiveavimuktaṃ mahādevi tathā gaurīmukhaṃ punaḥtatra yadyat kṛtaṃ devi kiṃ tasya kathayāmi tenepālasya kāñcanādriṃ brahmaputrasya saṅgamamuttarasyāṃ kuñjagiriḥ karatoyāttu paścimedakṣiṇe brahmaputrasya lākṣāyāḥ saṅgamāvadhiṛṇāni trīṇyapākartuṃ yasya cittaṃ prasīdatitīrthayātrāṃ samāsādya yadyeko'pyatra gacchatitriṃśadyojanavistīrṇaṃ dīrgheṇa śatayojanamīśāne caiva kedāro vāyavyāṃ gajaśāsanaḥtrikoṇameva jānīhi surāsuranamaskṛtamtatra yadyajjalaṃ devi tat sarvaṃ tīrthameva hisiddhapīṭhaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ brahmapīṭhaṃ tadantaramnavayoniriti khyātā caturdikṣu samantataḥdviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhadre phalamevaṃ suniścitampūjane japane caiva dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ phalamāyonimahiparyantamāvidyāgandhamādanambrahmaviṣṇusureśādyaiḥ sevitaṃ paramādbhutamyonipīṭhe maheśāni pañcakrośamite śiveye ca sūryākaraṃ kleśaṃ prāpnuvanti na karhicitte sarve śaṅkarā jātāstrinetrāścandramurdhajāḥpūjanaṃ japanañcaiva kurute sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanmadhye ca mahādevi girirnīlācalojjvalaḥtanmadhye parameśāni manobhavaguhā parākoṭiliṅgasamākīrṇā kāmākhyā kalpavallarīasyāḥ sparśanamātreṇa lauho yāti suvarṇatāmasyāḥ sparśanamātreṇa śivatvameti mānavaḥatra yadyat kṛtaṃ karma tadanantaphalaṃ bhavetāpātālād hradaṃ devi procchalajjalamaṇḍalamaiśvaraṃ tajjalaṃ devi kāraṇārṇavasaṃjñakamsaṅketenaiva kathitaṃ mātarjānīhi sundaritajjalasparśa mātreṇa tadhradasparśanena capuṇyapāpavinirmukto jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvamjihvākoṭisahasraistu vaktrakoṭiśatairapihrade hastaṃ viniḥkṣipya jalamadhye maheśvarimantrasiddhirbhavettasya tat kṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥjapanti ye hi mantraṃ te siddhimāyānti tatkṣaṇātetatte kathitaṃ devi kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍalamkintvasya kathyate devi māhātmyaṃ te yaśasvinichinnamastā bhairavī sā sapta sapta vibheditābhagaklinnā bhagādhārā tathā caiva bhagandarīupavidyāśca yāḥ proktāḥ sarvābhistābhireva cabrahmamukhāśrayaṃ pīṭhamugratārādhidaivatamvyaktād guptaṃ puṇyataraṃ durāpaṃ sādhakottamaiḥmanobhavaguhāvahnau devīśikharamunnatamsiddhi kālī brahmarūpā devatā bhuvaneśvarītatpīṭhopari saṃviśya daśadhā ca japenmanum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yat kṣaṇaṃ te mayā proktaṃ hṛnmadhye hi sulocanearghaṃ jālandhare jñeyamuḍḍīyāne tadardhakamnīlakaṇṭhasamīpe tu nātra kāryā vicāraṇātrayodaśāhe mahāsiddhirekābhrakānane tathārāḍhāyāṃ vikaṭākṣāyāṃ drutañja parvatātmajepuṣkarākhye ca lakṣeṇa prayoge viṃśalakṣataḥtathaiva viraje kṣetre lakṣadvādaśataḥ śivekailāse daśalakṣeṇa jayantyāṃ pañcalakṣataḥavaśyaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ syājjapanāt pūjanācchivemātṛjārasamaṃ devi sarvadā parigopayetkāmākhyāyonimāhātmyaṃ yaduktaṃ me tvayā śivatattvena [taṃtrena] tanmayā jñātaṃ kalau kiṃ na susiddhidamkimetat kāraṇaṃ nātha vada me karuṇāmayapṛthivīgarbhasambhūto dānavānāmaddhīśvaraḥpṛthivīvacanāt so'pi dānavo yuddhadurdharaḥpunaśca bhagavān tasmai nivāsāya dadau mudājitvā'bhiṣecanaṃ rājye viṣṇuḥ śaktiṃ dadāvapisusnātaṃ narakaṃ tadvad vidheyāmāsa vai tadābrahmatvaṃ brahmaṇā prāptaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca mayā punaḥtasmādyoniṃ pūjayasva yatnāt sarvātmabhistvamūmyadā te vimukhī mātā tadā te na śubhaṃ sutaiti jñātvā pujayasva viśeṣeṇa vadāmi kimnarakaḥ pālayāmāsa viṣṇūvataṃ yadyadeva hibrahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro vaśiṣṭho'tīva sadyatitatraivaikadine devi pūjayituṃ [japtuṃ caiva] sureśvarīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra taṃ varayāmāsa narako brahmasambhavamidānīṃ pūjyate devī pūjānte tvaṃ gamiṣyasiuvāca narakaṃ vipro vaśiṣṭhastāmralocanaḥkāmākhyāpūjane kāle mā labhema gṛhāntareidānīṃ paśya vīryaṃ me tava nāśakaraṃ mahatkamaṇḍalormahādevīṃ śaśāpa dāruṇaṃ muniḥhitvā tvāṃ hi vrajāmyadya na kiñciducyate tvayāsiddhirna jāyate karhi kāle madvacanāt punaḥnīlācalaṃ parityajya gato'sau khāṇḍavaṃ girimmahājyotirmayī devī sarvaprakāśarūpiṇītatkṣaṇāt parisandagdhā gatā kailāsamandirammahāndhakārapaṭalairāvṛtā tadviyogataḥtatastāṃ paramāṃ māyāṃ viṣaṇṇavadanāṃ punaḥkathaṃ śive samāyātā tyaktvā tadyonimaṇḍalamtvaṃ devi paramārādhyā sthīyatāṃ me hṛdi svayamsarvaṃ pratikaromyeva viṣaṇṇavadane kathammadyonimaṇḍale nātha dvāraṃ me samupāgataḥdvārapālo'bhavadrājā yāvanme pūjanaṃ bhavetevaṃ nityaṃ niyamitaṃ narakenāsureṇa catatastenaiva muninā śāpo dattaḥ sudāruṇaḥśāpaṃ śṛṇu mahādeva kathane rodanaṃ mamatad mama vihataṃ deva ko vopāyo'sti me vadabrahmavadhodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ satyaṃ te'dya bhaviṣyatisiddhirna jāyate karhi kāle madvacanāt punaḥāgatyāhaṃ yonipīṭhe jajāpa kālikāmanum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmākhyāṃ sthāpayāmāsa pūrvavad yonimaṇḍalebrahmaśāpo maheśāni phaliṣyati suniścitamnarakasya prasaṅgena tat sarvaṃ kathitaṃ mayiyacchrutvā sādhavaḥ sarve dayāmeṣyanti sarvadātaddināt parameśāni brahmaśāpaḥ pravartateprajāpīḍā rogakṛtvā bahudoṣo bhaviṣyatidevadānavagandharvāḥ sadā pīḍāparāyaṇāḥsaumāraiśca kuvācaiśca yavanairyuddhamulvaṇamtato raṇe ca saumāraṃ jitvā yavanavāñchitam [īpsitaṃ]tat sahāyaṃ samāsādya kuvācaḥ svīyarājyabhākkumārīcandrakālendau gate śāke maheśvarikāmarūpe tathā rājyaṃ dvādaśābdaṃ maheśvariṣaṣṭhavargapañcamādistataḥ śarīramicchatiyavanaśca kuvācaśca saumāraśca tathā plavaḥevameva bahuvidhaṃ vakṣye lakṣaṇamīśvarivaśiṣṭhasya tapasyādāvagniḥ śāmyati kāminisvargahāre śilāpāte caike vepurasannidhaubrahmaputrasya deveśi sūkṣmadhārā tu tasya cavigato bhavitā nūnaṃ saumārakāmapṛṣṭhayoḥgamiṣyanti ca rājānaḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥtribhirmlaicchaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ bhaviṣyatilohityo raktapūrṇaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥkāmākhyā varṇakaśyāmā [kaṇakā] balihastā hasanmukhīparvatāgraṃ samāśritya raktapānaṃ kariṣyatikaratoyānadīṃ yāvat kariṣyati mahadraṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato vipro nṛpo bhūtvā kāmarūpanivāsinaḥevaṃ varṣatrayaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍī dvijo nṛpaḥtato dvādaśadale nābhiḥ kalpate pūrvabhūmipaḥtadrājyaṃ sakalaṃ devi dharmeṇa pālayiṣyatisavitaṃ [saritaṃ] tanayaṃ sādhvī rājānaṃ rājaputrakamtāvat sparśācale sparśamaṇirāvirbhaviṣyatibhaviṣyanti tadaiva syāt vaśiṣṭhaśāpamocanamkāmākhyāsannidhāne ca bhaviṣyati kalau yugeyathoktaphaladā devi kāmākhyā hi bhaviṣyatikāmākhyā devavandyāṅghrikamalā lajjitā svayamkiṃ śrotavyamito devi girije kathyatāṃ tvayākva gacchasi muhurnātha kṛpayā vada śaṅkarasādhvī satī śāsikā hi revatī janaviśrutā [janavismṛtā]tat kucau kaṭhinau dvandvau yonau tasyāśca pīnatātat sannidhau maheśāni tayā me ramaṇaṃ mahattvayā sārddhaṃ ratiryasyā nālpasya tapasaḥ phalamidānīṃ kimabhūt sā hi kṛpayā parayā vadatat sādhvīcaritaṃ kiñcit kathayāmi śucismitevedāṅgasambhavā sādhvī yoginī sā surī matāmāmāptumutkaṭaṃ taptamasmin me kṣetrakāmade [kāmadā]tatraiko brāhmaṇo yāto bhikṣārthaṃ tāmuvāca hatataḥ śaśāpa viprastāṃ mlecchatāṃ yāhi durmadeityuktvā sa yayau vipro mlecchatvamāpa yoginītasyāstu tapasā devi krītoḥamabhavaṃ sadātasyāḥ putro vinusiṃho madaurasasamudbhavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vinirjitya nṛpān sarvān ekaḥ śrīmān mahāmatiḥkuvācā dhārmikāḥ sarve rājāno yuddhadurmadāḥtiṣṭhatyavyaktarūpeṇa paṭṭa ākalpamambikeyathā jāyā nandimatā tatheyaṃ yoginī matāvinusiṃho'pi kalpānte parāṃ siddhimavāpsyatibhaviṣyanti mahātmāno gaṇeśāḥ [dhaneśāḥ] sarvaśālinaḥviharanti sadā devi krīḍante bhairavā yathātadā tadā'vatīryāsau svasya kāmasya pālakaḥkalpāntamevaṃ deveśi yāvacchāpo vimucyatekalpameva maheśāni kalau varṣaśatatrayamkāmākhyā tu mahāmāye tadante sakalaṃ bhavetkāmākhyāyā maheśāni sākalyena mayā dhruvamtakṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya pratīkāro hi tat kṣaṇātnarakānniṣkṛtirnāsti tasyābhāvānna saṃśayaḥnānāvidhamahotpātairyāvat syāt sāptapauruṣamsarvadevamayo vipro brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥbrāhmaṇairbhujyate yatra tatra bhuṅkte hariḥ svayampitaro devatāḥ sarve bhuñjate nātra saṃśayaḥbrāhmaṇañca kumārīñca śaktimagniṃ śrutiñca gāmpūjitaikā kumārī ceddvitīyaṃ pūjanaṃ bhavetkumāryaśca śaktayaśca sarvametaccarācaramsarvā eva parā devyaḥ pūjitā syuḥ na saṃśayaḥlabhyate koṭiguṇitaṃ viśvāsānnātra saṃśayaḥgogrāsaṃ pāvanaṃ loke sarvapāpanikṛntanamkalpakoṭiśatāyutaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paraloke mahābandhurdharmo nāstyatra saṃśayaḥtataścāgamike dharme dharmeṇaiva pravartatetatastu bahujanmānte jñānamāsādya mucyatejñānānmuktirmahādevi satyaṃ satyaṃ mayocyatetadā yogī vimuktaḥ syādityāha bhagavān śivaḥtasmāt karma mahāmāye sarvadā samupācaretna vṛthā gamayet kālaṃ dyūtakrīḍādinā sudhīḥdvividhañcaiva tat karma bāhyāntaravibhedataḥaśucirvā śucirvāpi yatra kutra sthale'pi vākuryācca mānasaṃ dharmaṃ na doṣo mānase kvacitjapayajño maheśāni matsvarūpo na saṃśayaḥsarvadā parameśāni jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥsarve te japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīmvyāghrādyā jantavo devi tathaiva kupitāntarāḥdānavā bhairavā duṣṭā ye vai śmaśānavāsinaḥna spṛśanti ca pāpāni kadāpi sādhakaṃ priyeupāṃśuḥ syāt śataguṇaḥ sahasro mānaso mataḥkiñcit suśravaṇopeta upāṃśu parikīrtitaḥvācikastu japo bāhyo mānaso'bhyantaro yataḥjapena devatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdatisādhanañca japañcaiva dhyānañcaiva varānaneyadi bhāgyena deveśi bahujanmārjitena cabrahmajñānañca yat proktaṃ samādhistat prakīrtyateitaḥ paraṃ mahādevi kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasiplavaśca yavanaścaiva saumāraśca maheśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kathaṃ jātā mahādeva vada me karuṇāmayanānyo vaṃśadharaḥ kaścittadvaṃśe tu trilocaneyuvatī sundarī ramyā tapaḥśīlā mahāmatiḥsthitvā viśveśvarāgre tu dvāre me muktimaṇḍapetaddvārapālako devi cukṣubhe tāṃ nirīkṣya cakapālamālī madirāmoditonmattaveśavānkīrterjāto mahādevi bandhukāmalakadyutikīrteḥ suto mahādevi mahākālasya retasaḥtayā'niśaṃ ratiñcāpi mahāṅkuśamahābhujammahāṅkuśaḥ] śālvaṃ rājyaṃ datvā mahāṅkuśesamarcayan yathā kāśyāṃ tathā tatrāpi sarvadāevante kathitaṃ devi caritaṃ plavasammatamāsīt tretāyuge rājā bahudharmaparāyaṇaḥpitṛśatrūn vinirjitya saptadvīpāṃ vasundharāmbahukāle mahāmāye tataḥ svamadamohitaḥnipātya pitṛśatrūn yaḥ pitṛśrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ hi yattasmāttu pāpasañcāro jātastasya mahābhujaḥahaṅkāro yuddhacaryaḥ sadā naivāvyavasthitiḥtasya tenaiva bhāvena rājalakṣmīrvinicyutāmantrayitvā ca rājāno laṅghayitvāmbudhiṃ tadāādau parājitastebhyo bāhurmāsena niṣkramanmamāra tadvane bāhuḥ samastaṃ niṣprabhaṃ tadāvaśiṣṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātau rakṣarakṣeti vādinauetasminnantare bhūpaḥ sagaraḥ khaḍgamūrchritaḥ [krodhaḥ-]tattathā bhūpamālokya vaśiṣṭho brahmasambhavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mā hiṃsīrbāhunandana abhayaṃ dattavānahambrahmavākyaṃ vṛthā na syāt pratijñā me'pi pūrvajāiti sañcintya tat sarvaṃ vaśiṣṭhamabhyavedayattatra tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gatoṣmi kiṃ karomyataḥyadyupāyaṃ na karoṣi śreyo ye maraṇaṃ tadāevaṃ śrutvā vaśiṣṭho'sau satvaraṃ pratyabhāṣatavedācārabahirbhūtān kārayāmāsa dūrataḥitthaṃ me vacanaṃ tiṣṭhet pratijñāpi ca te vibho [śiśo]vede'pi sthiramevaṃ hi samānaṃ samudāhṛtamte'pi vai kṣatriyāḥ sarve haihayāstālajaṅghakāḥsuṣeṇamunimāśritya tadācāravirājitāḥyamāśritya mahādevi mlecchācāraparāyaṇāḥsaṃyogañca viyogañca mantrāṇāñca dvidhā gatiḥbāhyāntaraviyogena saṃyogo hi anuttamaḥtāmasaḥ paralokasya bāhyastaddharma īśvaraḥmayā datto varastebhyo śṛṇu kāmayituṃ varamkālaṃ tathendvaṣṭanavān gate śāke kalau yugeevameva maheśāni kāmarūpādhipāḥ śivebahubhūpasamākīrṇaḥ kalau bhuṅkte mahīṃ mudāidānīṃ śrūyatāṃ yuddhe saumāracaritaṃ tathāvihāya devarājyaṃ ca [devarājaṃ ca] kauśāṅgyā sahitaḥ svayamtauryatrike samyagicchā jātā bahuvidhāstathāādideśa samānīya nṛtyaṃ kartuñca rambhayānānāvidhividhānena indraṃ tutoṣa mohinīsā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ratirdhairyaṃ tayorjātaṃ tasyāstatskhalane punaḥuvāca niṣṭhurāṃ vāṇīṃ śṛṇu devi manoharāmataḥ pracalitaṃ cittamāvayoratikarmaṇievamuktaṃ duṣṭaśāpaṃ kauśāṅgīmukhaniḥsṛtamvilalāpa bahuvidhaṃ dhṛtvā ca caraṇe muhuḥgamiṣyasikaṅkatī mohinī ramyā dhārtarāṣṭraṃ patiṃ gatātūrṇañca kaṅkatī sāgāccandracūḍaṃ giriṃ bhiyāprāpyartuṃ svargaveśyā sā dvitīyadivase diśigatvāpaśyat tu sundarīmbodhayitvā ca sarvaṃ [sarvāṃ] tāṃ kāntāṃ kāmavimohitāmkaṅkatyā parameśāni parvate gandhamādanetataḥ so'rindamaścābhūt mlecchācāraparāyaṇaḥsarvamāṃsādano devi kirāto ghaṭito yathāmadyamāṃsabhagāmodī kadācāraparāyaṇaḥtatastāṃ devarājo'sāvuvāca tatpurasthitaḥtapasā te'tisantuṣṭo yadicchasi dadāmi cadraṣṭuṃ na śaktā deveśa yathecchasi tathā kurubhavet satyaṃ na sandehaḥ puttroyantu narādhamaḥyathecchasi kuru tathā māṃ tu naya drutaṃ prabhodevādhīśa eṣa kāmyo nānyaḥ kāmyaḥ kadācanatvarito neṣyāmyadhunā tvāmahaṃ susthirā bhavaataḥ śatāṣṭaviṃśe ca puruṣe kṣayite [hārite] satipuṇyaślokā dharmamayāḥ sadācāraparāyaṇāḥbhaviṣyanti na sandeho brahmatattvavidaḥ punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: layameṣyanti tatraiva yāvadābhūtasaṃplavamguptena tvāmahaṃ pṛcche kāmākhyā kā vadasva mekāmākhyā saiva deveśi sarvasiddhipradāyinīsarvaṃ me kṛpayā nātha vadasva candraśekharatadāhaṅkāradoṣeṇa pūrito'sau pitāmahaḥtamahaṅkāramādāya sthito brahmā jagannidhiḥkevalāhaṅkārayuto dhātrā bhūto hi sarvadātathāpi māyayā devi brahmāhaṅkāramoditaḥtaddehāt kalpayāmāsa tadahaṅkārataḥ śiveniḥsṛtya brahmaṇo dehād daityaḥ paramadāruṇaḥtataḥ palāyanañcakre viṣṇunā sa pitāmahaḥkeśipuramidaṃ khyātaṃ tatra sthitvā hi dānavaḥbrahmāṇḍamaṇḍaleastauṣījjagatāṃ dhātrīṃ [mātāṃ] kālīṃ vighnavināśinīmnijabījasvarūpāñca kāmabījasvarūpiṇīmmāyābījasvarūpāñca kūrcabījasvarūpiṇīmghorarāvāṃ śivasaṅgīṃ muktakeśīṃ digambarīmpraṇamāmi sadā hṛdyāṃ tāṃ mātāṃ bhuvaneśvarīmbho viṣṇo tvaṃ mahābāho kimicchasi ca tadvadaāvayoḥ sakalaṃ nītaṃ [hṛtaṃ] nityaṃ tat tena maṇḍalamdehi dāsyaṃ padāmbhoje māhātmyaṃ tannivedanamidānīṃ parisaṃjñātaṃ te yānti ca tavādhikāḥahaṅkārāptamīkṣitvā vighnaṃ dattaṃ durāsadammā bhayaṃ kuru bho viṣṇo sthiro bhava mahāmatehuṅkāreṇaiva taṃ bhasmīcakāra dānavottamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: keśīṃ mahāsuraṃ kālī vidhimāha tatastu sātatpāpasyāpanodāya kriyate parvatottamaḥtadgrāsabhasmanā nityaṃ gauste pāpaṃ kṣayiṣyatikamaṇḍalujalakṣepāccakāra parvataṃ vidhiḥtadgrāsabhasmanā gauśca tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirbhaved dhruvamyathā yathā [yathāśruti] cātti gauśca tadgrāsaṃ parvatottametāvattu niṣkṛtirdhāturyāvad govardhano giriḥevamevāparādhaste prādhānye yadi jāyatetato brahmā jagaddhātā viṣṇuśca jagatāṃ patiḥdadāmi vatsau tat sarvaṃ bhavantau kātarau kathammahāmuktipradañcaiva tvadīyamatinirmalamkathaṃ tat pūjayiṣyāvaḥ sarvaṃ maṅgaladāyakamsarvadā pūjayiṣyāvo mahābhaṅgalakāraṇamtadāvayordānavādyairaśubhaiḥ kiṃ kariṣyatip. 109) avaśyaṃ nau tariṣyāvo dustarāt tvatpadārcanātjalahuṅkārabījena [yena] cakāra bhasma dānavammahātejomayaṃ viddhi tadbījaṃ param padamaṃāpātālaṃ krośamātraṃ tadbījaṃ tejasāvṛtamtatsthānaṃ tvaṃ samādāya māṃ pūjaya yadīpsitamdevadānavagandharvairanyairapi mahāmatesarvāpadbhyaḥ paritrāṇaṃ tvāṃ kariṣyāmi sarvadāicchāśaktistu dattā vai ādyañcaiva mayā purāsaiva vṛndāsvarūpeṇa pure'tra sambhaviṣyatikeśipurasya bhavitā tayā te krīḍanaṃ dhruvamdaityavighnaṃ hi bhavitā sarvadaityaniṣūdanī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: keśidaityavadhārthāya yatra te pūjanaṃ kṛtammama tejaḥ samudbhūtaṃ jānīhi yonimaṇḍalamjānīhi prakṛtiṃ deva yoniṃ me yāṃ tu māmakīmkutrāpi ca bhayaṃ na syāt tava kvāpi pitāmahajānīhi tadadhiṣṭhātṛrūpaṃ me'ti suśobhanamyonimaṇḍalamāsādha kāmākhyāṃ yastu pūjayetna bhayaṃ tasya kutrāpi kasmādapi prajāyatepṛthivyāṃ bhārate varṣe kāmarūpaṃ mahālayamnavayonyātmake brahman kāmarūpe manoharamkintvidānīṃ bhavatpāpaṃ prapaśyāmi [na paśyāmi] kathañcanakāyikaṃ vācikañcaiva mānasañca tathā punaḥtat pāpadhyānadhārābhirbaddhībhūtaṃ divāniśamtat trayasya praśamanaṃ vadāmi tacchṛṇuṣva meśreṣṭhatāmehi he deva dṛṣṭvā pīṭhaṃ tapaḥ kurutāvat kuru tapo ghoraṃ tadante pātakadvayamtatra tapovaśāt tattu kenāpi nahi vīkṣyatesthānaṃ tadgāsyate vatsa sarvaloke nirantaramkālīṃ paramakalyāṇīṃ tāṃ natvā vidhikeśavauprācīnamatigopyaṃ hi vṛttāntaṃ kulanāyikesārātsārataraṃ devi bhaktimuktipradāyakamīśvaroḥamīśvaroḥamuktavantau jalārṇaveaprameyaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ madīyaṃ pāvanaṃ paramtanmadhyeḥaṃ rudrarūpo babhrāma vṛṣavāhanaḥstutvā ca vividhaiḥ stotrairūcaturmāṃ punaśca taukastvaṃ vada bhīmarūpa utthito'si jalārṇave
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: utthitoḥaṃ ca yuvayodīśvaratvaṃ parīkṣitumnigūḍhaṃ dhyānto jñātvā santuṣṭo mādhavo'bhavatkevalaṃ rudrarūpaṃ māṃ jñātvā'sau kamalāsanaḥvicikitsāparo bhūtvā viṣṇumāha tadā vidhiḥbho viṣṇo matkapālād yo jāto rudro'pyasau mataḥcakāra bahudhā devi vighnaṃ dattaṃ sudāruṇamtadvighnamasuro bhūtvā madhyāhnasamaye raviḥsarveṣāṃ sakalaṃ nītamindrādīnāṃ maheśvarigaruḍañca vinā lakṣmīmanyat sarva hṛtaṃ balāthimālayaṃ samāsādya viṣṇurāha tadā vidhimtenaiva cāparādhena vayaṃ sarve prapīḍitāḥtadaiva maṅgalaṃ lebhe bhūyo me rocate hṛdihimālaye tadā devāḥ prasādo me'bhavat tadābrahmāṇa sārathīṃ kṛtvā vedān rajjūṃstathaiva cadhanuḥ kṛtvā sumeruñca jyāñca kṛtvā tu vāsukīmcarācareṇa sahitaṃ devadaityādibhiḥ sahayatra bhasma kṛtaṃ devi jagadetaccarācarammṛtānāṃ sarvadevānāṃ tejastatra vyavasthitamnirmāya māyayā dehaṃ traipuraṃ tasya vakṣasitattejasi mahākālyāḥ parā caitanyarūpiṇīmahādīpaprayāṇantu tejasaḥ kālīkīrtitamato girimukhaṃ nāma munibhiḥ parigīyateānandakānanaṃ tasmād gīyate vedavādibhiḥyathā tu sāgare gacchan śīkaraḥ sāgaro bhavetyathā nānājalaṃ devi gaṅgāyāṃ patitaṃ yadi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvaṃ kālyabhavat pūrṇaṃ nāsti bhedo maheśvaritāṃ kālīṃ śirasādhāya pañcakrośamayīṃ sadāato viśveśvaratvaṃ me sadaiva nātra saṃśayaḥviśveśvaraḥ sa eva syānnāparaḥ parameśvaritatra tasyāḥ kṛpā jātā vāgbhavā yā'śarīriṇīataḥ kāśyāṃ mṛtānāṃ tvamānandaṃ dehi sarvadādadāmi paramaṃ brahma mumūrṣoḥ karṇagocarejale sthale cāntarikṣe vārāṇasyāṃ mṛtāstu yedadāmi paramaṃ brahma teṣāṃ hi karṇagocaremahākālyāḥ prasādāt jñānayogataḥkāśīsparśanamātrāt te pūrṇānandamayāḥ sadātūlarāśiṃ dahatyagniḥ kiñcitkālādyathā śivekāśīsthānaṃ puṇyacayaṃ kiṃ vāhaṃ kathayāmi tetadā kāśīphalaṃ kiñcit devi vaktuṃ kṣamo bhavette sarve muktimāyānti kāśyāñced bhāgyato mṛtāḥyugabhedājjanaireva dṛśyate hi caturvidhādvāpare sā śilārūpā kalau bhūmimayī śubhāsatyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi śapathena vadāmi tepāṣāṇeśvaralobhitvāt tiṣṭhet kāśyāṃ sa yantritaḥprāṇānte'pi mahādevi kāśīṃ na nistyajedbudhaḥvṛthaiva mūrkhalokena kāśīṃ prāpya samujjhitamtadā naiva tyajet kāśīṃ prāṇānte'pi kadācanasa gacchedapi yatnena mama vārāṇasīṃ purīmprāṇānte muktidātāḥaṃ kāśyāṃ sthitvā sadaiva hiparamaṃ pāvanaṃ mokṣaṃ kimataḥ śrotumicchasi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jagadūrdhvakalādhīśa vada kolānipātanammahākālīprasaṅgena vṛttāntamidamadbhutampīḍitastena pāpena tapaścakre sa sarvavitaṣṭākṣarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ mahākālyāḥ sadā japantasyāḥ santoṣamātreṇa viṣṇorhṛdayapaṅkajāttena daityena balinā sarvaṃ nītaṃ durātmanāhṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma brahmaṇaḥ kamalāsanamkolānagaramāsthāya kumārīrūpamāsthitāānandajaladhau magnāḥ śikhivannanṛturghanāttamayācata tadbhakṣyaṃ kumārī daityapuṅgavamkṣudhitāhaṃ mahārāja bhojyaṃ mahyaṃ pradīyatāmdayayā tāṃ kare dhṛtvā viveśāntaḥpure svayamatropaviśa bāle tvaṃ āsane maṇirañjitebhuktvā sā sakalaṃ devi punardehītivādinīnāhaṃ tṛptā vadantīṃ tāṃ kolovāca tadā'suraḥityudīritamākarṇya kālī bālāsvarūpiṇīkṣaṇena bubhuje kālī kolāsuraṃ mahābalamtataḥ kolāpuraṃ śūnyaṃ kṛtaṃ kālyā kṣaṇācchivenirantaraṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ cakruste nanṛtuḥ paramavidyādharī devapatnī kinnarībhiḥ samantataḥasarvalokaiḥ pūjitā ca kumarī sā gṛhe gṛheevaṃ te'dya mayā proktaṃ kolāsuraniṣūdanamvāgvajrañca brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā jānīhi kāminisantuṣya brāhmaṇān devi tuṣṭā vayaṃ sadā surāḥyadyakāryaśataṃ devi brāhmaṇaḥ svayamācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāpamānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ sarvadā surapuṅgaveaprasūtiśca sā kālī kumārīrūpadhāriṇībrahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ kumārī pūjyate sadākumārīpūjanaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nārhāmi sundaritasmācca pūjayet bālāṃ sarvajātisamudbhavāmjātibhedānmaheśāni narakānna nivartatedevībuddhyā mahābhaktyā tasmāttāṃ paripūjayetekā hi pūjitā bālā sarvasya pūjanaṃ [deva pūjanam] bhavetkumārīṃ labhate kānte sarvasvenāpi sādhakaḥtadā tasya mahāsiddhirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥpriyaṃvadesarvasiddhiyuto bhūtvā krīḍate bhairavo yathāhaṭhāttu [tathā tu] jāyate sarvaṃ yadyanmanasi vartateavyāhatājñaḥ [avyāhataśca] sarvatra yathā purandaraḥ śivevidyādharī rājanārī sevate taṃ divāniśamkumārīpūjane kāle sādhakaḥ śivatāṃ vrajetmahāpuṇyatamaṃ bhūyāt samantāt krośapañcakamapūjayat kumārīṃ tāṃ veśyākulasamudbhavāmbhūtvā nityā hi tatsthāne [tat svapne] gṛhṇāti pūjanaṃ sadāmokṣadā sā purī jñeyā pañcakrośamayī śubhātatsarvaṃ pūjanaṃ tasyāścitrametannagendrajeevantu pūjitā bālā kampillena mahātmanāadyāpi dṛśyate loke [lokaiḥ] śilārūpeṇa tiṣṭhatāsarvayajñayutaṃ devi maharṣīṇāñca veṣṭitamye vasanti mahādevi kāmpillanagre pure
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvasampatsamākīrṇānante devyāḥ prasādataḥyadi kāmo bhavet ko'pi vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ vrajetkiñcidevaṃ mahāmāye punaḥ kiṃ parikathyateidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kaholacaritaṃ paramhitaṃ hi sarvalokānāṃ yogināṃ hṛdayārthadamparibabhrāma medinīm |] sarvatīrthapūtaḥ sarvārthavarjitaḥsarvavarya ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ paribabhrāma medinīmsahasrasūryasaṅkāśaḥ sa evāsīt purā śivetadākāśasamudbhūtā śrutā vāṇī maharṣiṇāsa guruḥ sarvasattvānāṃ sakalaṃ te kariṣyatigatvovāca kaholo'sau [-me] vṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ hi tamcandrākṣarī sarvajñānabhāvanī [-mānavī] cinmayī śubhākathitañca mayā tasmai kaholaputra tacchṛṇubhāvayitvā pūjayed yaḥ sarvājñānavināśinīmityājñaptaḥ kaholaḥ sa ṛṣirvedaviśāradaḥtasya te saṃśayā vighnāḥ palāyante dine dinetatastasmin kṛpā jātā mahākālyā ṛṣeḥ śubhāātmānaṃ kālikārūpaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanamsarvamāyāvinirmukto jātaḥ sa ṛṣiruttamaḥātmadehādikaṃ kiñcijjānāti na ca karhicitbhasmībhūtaṃ maheśāni ṛṣesstasya mahātmanaḥatyācāreṣu sarveṣu rataḥ syāt sphurate hi saḥcakāra līnaṃ tamṛṣiṃ svīyadehe tu kāraṇedevāsuramunīndrāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanāmkāṃ vidyāṃ prāpya sā jātā tāṃ vadasva mayi prabho
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śravaṇāt sarvapāpāni nāśamāyānti nānyathāmahādevyā mahākālyā mahādevena bhāṣitampunaśca nijabīja hi vidyāyaśaskarī parāmama jaṭātaṭe sthitvā [sthitā] japedvidyāmaharniśamsiddhamantrasvabhāvena [-prabhāve na] kālī tejo'tibṛṃhitā [tejopa-]ato hi sarvatīrthānāṃ sā vidyā sarvapūjitāyannāmasmaraṇādeva pāpino muktibhāginaḥteṣāñca pātakaṃ hitvā sa gacched vaiṣṇavīṃ purīmdharmārthamokṣakāminaḥ] prāyaścittaparāṇyapisadā devi śubhā gaṅgā pravāhayetyatra deśe [pravahati] vased gaṅgā sa deśaḥ puṇyabhājanaḥtatra yat kriyate karmaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥsaṅgamaṃ [sāṃgaṃ-] vā vihīnaṃ vā kathitaṃ śambhuvallabhebhuktvā ca vividhān bhogān kṛtvā ca sukṛtaṃ sadāyatra [k pustake adhikaḥ] gaṅgāpravāho'sti devarṣigaṇasaṃstutejñānato mokṣamāpnoti vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatprabhāvataḥ [tadabhāvataḥ]gaṅgāmuddiśya yo gatvā pathi prāṇān vimuñcatitattīre yastyajet prāṇān nyāyato'nyāyato'pai vāyāvadasthīni gaṅgāyāṃ nikṣipyante mṛtasya cagaṅgājalasamāyogānmriyate yatra kutracitgaṅgātīre caturhaste piṇḍaṃ dadyāt samāhitaḥpitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kṛtvā [bhūtvā] viṣṇuloke vasennaraḥmahātṛptirbhavet satyaṃ pitṛṇāñca śatābdikamdivā vā yadi vā rātrau sandhyāyāṃ vā mahāniśisarvaṃ kuryāttu gaṅgāyāṃ kālabhedaṃ na cācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadante parameśāni cāṇḍālo nityaduḥkhitaḥjanmatrayaṃ maheśāni tadante śūdrayoniṣucaturjanmavyatīte tu kṣatriyatvaṃ trijanmataḥgaṅgāyāṃ harate yo hi yatkiñcit parameśvariābhūtasaṃplavaṃ [ka pustake adhikaḥ] devi kathitaṃ te sureśvariśvapaco jāyate yo nityaṃ daśajanmani kāminisaptajanma mahādevi tadante niṣkṛtiṃ labhetkālikāyā maheśāni gaṅgāmāhātmyakāraṇamapāre ghorasaṃsāre patitānāṃ mahārṇavegurustvaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ yato [mataḥ] bhavānśrutaṃ sarvaṃ jagannātha tvanmukhāmbhojanirgatamkāṃ vidyāṃ samupāśritya karālabhairavaḥ svayamvidravanti bhayārtā vai yasmāddevāsurādayaḥtāṃ vidyāṃ śrotumicchāmi vada nātha digambarabrahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sarvasvaṃ jīvanāvadhikathyate nāmamātraṃ hi jñāyatāṃ kulabhairavividyā rājñī ghorakālī aniruddhasarasvatīmene [akarot] sa pūtamātmānaṃ sarvasmādadhikaṃ svayamsa tūdayācale pūrva tapastepe'ti duṣkarambhūtvārdhacaraṇo devi varṣāṇāṃ niyutadvayamkanakāśrame tathā lakṣamuḍḍīyāne dvilakṣakampuṇyaśaile tathā lakṣaṃ pañcaviṃśatimānataḥevaṃ taptaṃ [tepe] tapo hyevaṃ koṭivarṣaṃ suduṣkaramtathāpi taṃ prati prītā mābhūt kālī kadācananivedayāmāsa tathā vṛttāntaṃ tapasaḥ śive
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mannāthaḥ parameśāni bhāvanāvaśatāṃ gataḥkathaṃ tvāṃ paramācāraṃ kathayāmi savistarmguhyātiguhyaguhyeti brahmādīnāmagocaraḥkālīpratyakṣabījo'yaṃ mama sarvasva eva casattvaśānto mahāyogī gopitastena yatnataḥmama [sarvasvametaddhi] svasvapadaṃ śambhurnirudvego'pyacetasaḥsadācārasya nigūḍhaṃ tattvajñānaṃ mahāmatiḥajarāmaratāṃ prāpto mahāśāntaḥ pareśvaraḥpadaṃ madīyaṃ gurutvaṃ datvā tasmai samāsataḥsarveṣāṃ tu sahastrāre tiṣṭhāmi kamale pareśivaḥ śivoḥantu śivo na bhedaḥ kutracit sadāso'pi śānto mahāyogī ācārakṣama eva saḥśivasya kṛpayā caiva kevalaṃ sādhakaḥ kṣamaḥūrdhvato'yaṃ bhīmakarmā karālabhairavaḥ sadāyathā me kālikārādhyā tathācāro'yameva hiyogyaṃ na paramācāraṃ dātuṃ kālīhṛdaṅgamamājñāpayāmāsa gaccha putra trilocanaṃ pratiyāto mātuḥ kālikāyā stataḥ [samīpaṃ] sa bhairavaḥ svayamyadyajjaptaṃ tapo hyevaṃ yātu yātu vṛthā hi tatataḥ śarīraṃ tyakṣyāmi na vakṣyāmi kadācanaseyaṃ samīritātavāṃśajam [avadhāraya]gurvājñā viphalā yātu tava vai bhairavottamakathaṃ tubhyaṃ mahāsiddhiṃ darśanaṃ vā dadāmyahamādināthaṃ tava guruṃ vṛttāntaṃ kathayedṛśam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadāvaśyaṃ mahācāraṃ tubhyaṃ sa tu pradāsyatiacirāttaṃ pradāsyāmi yadyanmanasi vartatekulācāraṃ vinā yo hi japet sa nārakī bhavetadhikaḥ |] mahākālyā śrutvā [labdhā] sa bhairavottamaḥmahākālaṃ mahādevaṃ śūnyarūpaṃ jagadgurummahākālyāḥ karālabhairavaṃ prati |]tadā niyamapūrvaṃ hi karālabhairavo'vadatmahākālo jagannātho'bhiṣiktaṃ tañcakāra hadadau nāma karālāya krodhavaktro'tiviśrutaḥ(sa) madirāmatsyamudrāntu pātraṃ kāraṇapūritamtadānīṃ śuśubhe sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaramśrīgurupādukāmparamānandapūritaḥśakti kope [śaktipāde] maheśāni bhūyo natvā guroḥ padamastauṣīt parayā bhaktyā saṃsārasāgare sthitaḥarūparūpaṃ sphuṭameva satyaṃ kṛpāvatāraṃ khalu śūnyarūpamprakāśabhāvaṃ praṇamāmi nityamyajjñānajaṃ locanameva satyaṃ sa ca praviṣṭastvayi nātha satyamtameva kālīṃ paramārthabījaṃ namāmyahaṃ taccaraṇāravindamprātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne teṣāṃ muktipradā bhavagaccha śīghraṃ yonipīṭhaṃ devīśikharamāśritaḥacirādvāñchitā [tasiddhiḥ] siddhirbhavitā te na saṃśayaḥevaṃ vadati sā kālī tasmādveśyāparo bhavatasmādbhrāntiṃ parityajya kuladharmaṃ samāśrayaviśuddhacitto bhūyāccet siddhiḥ syādaparārdhagā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yonipīṭhaṃ samāsādya devīśikharamāśritaḥpañcaveśyārato bhūtvā kulācāraparāyaṇaḥvidyārājñīṃ ghorakālīmaniruddhasarasvatīm [-aniruddhyāṃ]kālī karālavadanā tejorūpā sanātanītaddṛṣṭvā sumahattejo bhairavo bhayavihvalaḥāśvāsyovāca taṃ krodhaṃ vācā'mṛtasamānayāmuhurmuhurnanāmāsau tataḥ kālīmuvāca hamano'bhīṣṭaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ sarvadā me manomayīnityaṃ nigrāhakastvaṃ hi bhava bhairavasattamasa me putratvamāgacchet satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥtava vaktraṃ kālarūpaṃ sarvanigrāhakaṃ parammahākālo bhairavo'pi vajrapāṇirbabhūva saḥvajrapāṇirmahākālīprasādādīśvarābhidhaḥgopanīyaṃ sadā bhadre yoniḥ paranare yathāidānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kāmarūpasya nirṇayambheṣajaṃ paramaṃ deva kiṃ me tat kathyatāṃ vibhopūrṇaśailasya sambhūtistretāyugamukhe'bhavatghorasya kalipāpasya vināśāya maheśvaritrayaṃ trayaṃ mahākṣetraṃ puṇyāraṇyaṃ trayaṃ trayampratipīṭhe sthitā gaṅgā pārvatī pratipīṭhakekalau gṛhāt sudūre ca tīrthabuddhiḥ prajāyatepratipīṭhe pṛthagdharma ācāraśca pṛthak pṛthakpṛthak pūjā pṛthaṅmantro martye ca tārapīṭhakamjālandharantu pāścātye pūrṇapīṭhantu pūrvataḥjālandharantu vāyavye kolāpūrantu [kolvā-] uttare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīhaṭṭamapi pūrve ca upapīṭhānyatho śṛṇuprastāre oḍrapīṭhasya āyāme'ti guṇaṃ bhavetcaturdvārasamāyuktaṃ vāyuvimbena cihnitamtatra someśvaraṃ liṅgamādipīṭhaṃ tathā paramkṣetraṃ virajasaṃjñañca ekāmraṃ tadanantaramkuśasthalī mahāpuṇyā daṇḍakasya vanaṃ tathāpaścime dhenukāraṇye uttare tu gayāśiraḥtriṃśadyojanavistīrṇamāyāme śatayojanambhūgolapīṭhakaṃ nāma yatra vai golakeśvaraḥavimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ haṃsaprapatanaṃ tathākurukṣetraṃ tu tatraiva yatra māyāsvanā nadīkacātmakaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ tatra pātālaśaṅkaraḥdakṣiṇe vṛṣabhaṃ liṅgamuttare kadalīvanamānanābhaṃ tathā padmaṃ raktavarṇaṃ vibhāvayetaśītyaṣṭau ca prastāre trikoṇaṃ pīṭhamuttamamsītāyāśca mahākṣetramagastasyāśramastathāmādhavāraṇyakaṃ kṣetraṃ harasyāraṇyakaṃ tathāuttare brahmakṣetrañca dakṣiṇe sāgarāvadhietanmadhyatamaṃ pīṭaṃ puṇyākhyaṃ nāma nāmataḥśivarātrau ca gamanaṃ sauramāsena māsakamtatpuṇyaṃ tatsamaṃ vettha navavyūhaṃ trimaṇḍalammadhyapīṭhaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ yatra kāmeśvaro bhavetkanyāśramaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatra rudrapadadvayammānasaṃ kṣetrakañcaiva yatra viśveśvaro haraḥpicchilā yā dakṣiṇato gautamasya mahāphalā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇe mandaśailaśca uttare vihagācalaḥayutatrayañca trissrotaḥ pañcodbhavaṃ tathā daśatasmin vasati sā devī jñānāddhyānādbhavo'pi vāsaumāramiti kathyatedikkarasya ca vāyavye nīlapīṭhaṃ sudurlabhampārijātaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatrādityastu śaṅkaraḥśivampūrve sauraśilāraṇyaṃ paścime svarṇadī śubhāetanmadhyagataṃ pīṭhaṃ [puṇyaṃ] bhuktimuktipradāyakamsahasrayojanavyāsaṃ [-vyāmaṃ] hayatāmrañca pañcamamsaumārākhyaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ śivatattvañca pīṭhakamkedārakṣetraṃ prathamaṃ yatra kedāraśaṅkaraḥdurgāraṇyaṃ somāraṇyaṃ bhadrāraṇyaṃ tathaiva cacauhārākhyaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatra gatvā na śocatinandanaṃ pārijātañca śivāraṇyaṃ tathā parampurve tu hīrikā nāma nadī puṇyatamā smṛtādakṣiṇe nāthavṛkṣastu pīṭhantu parikīrtitammāsahīnantu prastāre tripīṭhaṃ nāma nāmataḥkumārakṣetraṃ prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ nandanādvayamsiddhāraṇyaṃ dvitīyantu tṛtīyaṃ vipulaṃ vanampañcatīrthaṃ bhavet pūrve paścime dhanadā nadīetanmadhyagataṃ devi śrīpīṭhaṃ nāma nāmataḥabhyarcya vidhivadbhaktyā paścād yātrāṃ samācaretgurupitroranujñāpya brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥsiṃhe dhanuṣi meṣe ca na gacchet pūrvapīṭhakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛṣe'ṅganāyāṃ makare na gaccheddakṣiṇālayamkarkaṭe kīṭamīne ca na gaccheduttaraṃ sudhīḥmakare karkaṭe mīne nair-ṛtyāṃ parivarjayetsiṃhe mīne karkaṭe ca aiśānyāṃ tu na cintayetna gacchenmandavāre ca pūrvadeśaṃ mama priyekujavāre tathottaraṃ [cottaraṃ ca budhe'pi] budhe cāpi diśaṃ bhajetśanivāre tathaiśānyāṃ some cāgnau viśeṣataḥna gacchedyātriko yātrāṃ yoginī sammukhā yataḥtrayodaśī pañcamī ca na gaccheddakṣiṇāṃ diśampūrṇimā saptamī caiva vāyavyāṃ sarvathā tyajetviṣkumbhaḥ prītirāyuṣmān pratipatsu vivarjayetsukarmā ca dhṛtiścaiva tṛtīyāyāṃ vijānīhicaturthyāṃ varjayeddevi pañcamyāṃ harṣaṇaṃ tathāvarīyān parighaścaiva saptamyāṃ parivarjayetnavamyāṃ śubhaśukrañca daśamyāṃ brahma eva cauttarātrayaṃ trayodaśyāṃ viśākhāntu caturdaśīmpratipat kṛttikāyāntu dvitīyāyāntu jyeṣṭhakeyātrāyāntu na duṣṭaṃ syāt karaṇasya vicintanamaṣṭamyāñca navamyāñca sadākāleṣu varjayetgodhūlisamaye caiva pūrvadeśe vijānīhiaiśānyāñca tathā rātrau nair-ṛtyāṃ sandhyayordvayoḥvāruṇādiṣu yogeṣu yathākāle samācaretprācīdiśaṃ samāgacched yātrāṃ kuryādudaṅmukhaḥkusumaṃ yāvakaḥ śaṅkho bherī vādyañca bhūmipaḥsiddhānnaṃ māṃsapiṇḍañca bhaktaṃ bhājanajaṃ gurum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kanyā vai mithunaṃ veśyā pūrṇakumbhāḥ striyastathāagre dadhiphalaṃ yātrā śubhadā parikīrtitātadā siddhiṃ vijānīyādanyathā vighnamādiśetna kuryād yātriko yātrāṃ vāyase vanasaṃsthitekrandanaṃ kalahaṃ śrutvā na gacchettu kadācanadevatādar"anaṃ yātrāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayetvāpīkūpataḍāgādi yantrasyārambhakastathādevavrataṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ yajñasyārambhaṇaṃ tathāprāgdarśanañca devānāṃ na kurvīta kadācanana kālaniyamastatra tathā ca rohiṇīvratedeśadāhe grahāṇāñca viśubhaṃ karma ārabhetityarthaṃḥ) nepāle'vantyāṃ ca budhasya himathurāyāmarkajñasya rāhoraṅge ca baṅgakejālandhare caturhastamūrmikaṃ hastapūrṇakekolvapīṭhe turyahastaṃ cauhāre dviguṇaṃ bhavetupapīṭhe ca pātāle hastameva vijānīhibaladevāśrame caiva tathā kanyāśrameṣu cayānenārthaphalaṃ vidyāttathācchatre ca pāduketīrthe prāpyānuṣaṅgena tīrthasya ca phalaṃ labhettīrthe cācamanaṃ varjet pādaprakṣālanaṃ tathāanyatīrtharatiñcaiva sadā tīrtheṣu dūṣaṇamna tīrthatīre nivased dakṣiṇe tu viśeṣataḥtīrthe tathottare bhāge [tīrthasyottare bhāge ca] aṣṭakoṭisahasraśaḥtīrtheṣu brāhmaṇaṃ naiva parīkṣecca kadācanavanditavyāśca pūjyāśca teṣāṃ vākyena pūtatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na kālaniyamaḥ śrāddhe piṇḍe tu varjayenmadhugrahaṇe caiva tīrthe ca tathā ca pitṛvāsarebrāhmaṇe dānayogyaṃ na śrāddhayogyaṃ na tadbhavetnāvāhanaṃ na cārghyañca na cāgnīkaraṇaṃ tathātīrthaśrāddhe na kurvīta vāsaḥ sūtrapradāpanamśrāddhaṃ samāpya tat piṇḍaṃ na dadyācca kadācanadivase daśa cāṣṭau ca pañca saptatrayaṃ tathālauhitye caiva śoṇe ca gayāyāṃ virajeṣu camukurāṅge ca ekāmre maṇḍalañca vivarjayetaṣṭāvaṣṭau samānte [vatsarānte] vā muṇḍanañca punaścaretuttarābhimukho bhūtvā bāndhavān snāpayedbudhaḥtattirthasya turīyāṅgaṃ phalaṃ prāpya na saṃśayaḥkṛtvā tīrthaphalasyārdhaṃ brāhmaṇasya vidhīyatena snāpayettvāptagotraṃ na tīrthe tu pratigrahamna gṛhṇīyādito'nyatra tilaṃ gāñca viśeṣataḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena parayajñaṃ vivarjayetsadāsau saṃsthitastatra pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥtattu pīṭhaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ sāmprataṃ priyevāyukūṭasya carame dhanurhastapramāṇataḥtantuvāyuṃ samabhyarcya vāyulokamavāpnuyātdakṣiṇeṣaṇmukhaśca jayantaśca aśvakrānte janārdanaḥyo vasedvāyukūṭe tu dhanānāmadhipo bhavetpāpī bhavati godante aśvakrānte tu muktidaḥlauhityamadhye deveśi dhanustriṃśat pramāṇataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttare candraśailasya tyajet ṣoḍhā dhanurbudhaḥpañcaviṃśatidairghyeṇa candrakuṇḍāhvayaṃ saraḥcandratīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ piṇḍārakaṃ samamsudhīśavaṃśasambhūta mādhavaprītidāyakabhṛguḥ prāyaḥ sarvayugaṃ ādipaṃktisamanvitamnādabindusamāyuktaṃ punarjāntaṃ subhāvikammeṣe mīne paurṇamāsyāṃ japan kāmamanuṃ niśisnānañca divase kuryānmahāpātakanāśanamavacchinnamantrasiktastu yāvattiṣṭhati medinītasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge caturdhanaḥpramāṇataḥkārtike śuklapakṣe tu snānaṃ tatra samācarettasmānna saṃśayastīrthaṃ viṣṇutuṣṭipradāyakamtasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge aṣṭāviṃśaddhanurmitamvarṣāsu caturo māsān yastatra snānamacaretmantreṇa snānaṃ kuryāttu arghyadānena [arghyabhāvena] sādhakaḥamṛtādhivāsaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇināṃ kilviṣāt paramsnātvā [svāhā mukteḥ] ṛṇatrayānmukto bhavabandho na jāyatemāghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ snātvā muktiñca vindatidakṣiṇe aśvakrāntasya kiñcidāgneyagocarenāgalokādutthitaśca kalkirūpī [devadevo] janārdanahsamāharet]brahmaṇāsevite puṇye vārāṇasyāḥ kalādhikegṛhāṇārghyaṃ sastrīkaśca yuktiṃ tatra dadāmyahamnamaḥaśvamedhādikaṃ puṇyaṃ mausalasnānamātrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dānamakṣayatāṃ yāti pitṛṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathāsa yogaḥ padmako nāma aśvakrānte sudurlabhaḥsnānaṃ ye'tra kariṣyanti teṣāṃ lokā mahodayāḥkariṣyanti maheśāni satyametadudāhṛtamkārtikī tu viśeṣeṇa puṇyā [sarva] pāpaharā parāyadā tu snānamātreṇa śubhairapi subhāvitaiḥupapātakasaṃsargāḥ svayaṃ yānti mumukṣayātat prāpnoti naraḥ kṣipramalpāyāsena śāṅkariyathāśaktyā ca bhaktyā ca sa vibhurbhuvane vaset [viṣṇuloke mudā]yaḥ karoti naraḥ so'pi mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyātte'pi tasyānubhāvena svargaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥte mṛtāḥ svargamārūḍhāḥ padmāsanacaturbhujāḥprāyopaveśaṃ ye tatra prakurvanti narottamāḥnṛtyanti pitarasteṣāṃ tuṣṭāścaiva pitāmahāspṛṣṭvā [spṛṣṭāstu] tu pāpinastatra mucyante bhavabandhanātyāvadatandritaḥye punarbhāvitātmānastatra snātvā janārdanambrahmā viṣṇustathā rudro nityaṃ sannihitāstrayaḥvirajāmalatoyaṃ [virajamamantraṃ] tat triṣu lokeṣu viśrutamye tu varṣaśataṃ sāgryamagnihotramupāsatesarvayajñaphalaṃ tulyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradamtīrthe trisandhyā samupāsitā]bhṛṅgāreṇa karaṅkeṇa mṛṇmayenāpi śāṅkarisamādhinā samādheyāt saprāṇāyāmapūrvakamtena dvādaśavarṣāṇi bhavet sandhyā suvanditā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upavāse'pyanantaśca prāpnoti sumahat phalamekāhaṃ yo vaset tīrthe sa tat puṇyaphalaṃ labhetsaṃśayaḥ] tatra tasmai dadyādataḥ parampāṭhaḥ kha pustake] saṅgamastu varṣāsu ca pradṛśyateyastatra muṇḍanaṃ kuryāt prayāge muṇḍanaṃ phalamiha loke daridro yo bhraṣṭarājyo'thava punaḥkṛtvā pūjopahārañca devānāṃ pitṛtarpaṇamekacakro [cakravartī] bhaved rājā satyametanna saṃśayaḥbhavanti vividhāstasya yairyātrā kartike kṛtāśṛṇoti vā sa pāpaistu sarvaireva pramucyatebahuvarṣaśatena cakimatra bahunoktena na tadastīti bhāṣitamsarvayajñaphalaṃ tulyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradamyairgatvā aśvatīrthe tu snātaṃ sakṛd yathāvidhiśikhariṇīñca pradātṝṇāṃ yuvatīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥkāśīvāse yugānyaṣṭau dinaikaṃ puruṣottametat sadṛśaṃ guṇaṃ vidyādaśvatīrthe kṣaṇe kṣaṇesarvakratoradhikamapyadhikaṃ bhavāmbhaḥca kasmin sthāne bhavān sthitaḥnāmnā ca katamaṃ sthānaṃ śobhate dharaṇītalekānyakubje vedagarbho bhṛgukacche pitāmahaḥprabhāse padmajanmā ca svarganadyāṃ surapriyaḥnīlācale ca kāmeśaḥ piṅgalo hastiparvatebhasmācale bhayānandaścandrakūṭe ca mādhavaḥbhadrapīṭhe ca divyeśo aśvakrānte janārdanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmapāṇiḥ kuśahaste mānaśaile munīśvaraḥkanyāśrame ca rudro'haṃ [bhavedrudro] maināke viśvanādakaḥmūlikākhye tathā viṣṇurmahendre bhārgavastathāmaṇikūṭe hayagrīvo varāho vinduparvateparameṣṭhī brahmaputre viśvaśaile tu gahvaraḥvṛndāvane padmapāṇiḥ kuśahastastu naimiṣebhāgīrathyāṃ padmagarbhaḥ kāmpille kanakapriyaḥvaśiṣṭhaścārvude caiva śvetanadyāṃ manobhavaḥyajñagarbhastu āgastye urvaśyāṃ madhusūdanaḥvāyanaścaiva gomante kāśyāṃ viśveśvarāhvayaḥgangādharo madrapīṭhe mātaṅge caiva tryambakaḥgaṅgāhrade trilokeśo bhittipuryāṃ divākaraḥdāsavane mahāliṅgaḥ aśoke tu vināśakaḥmārkaṇḍeyo vaṭe caiva ikṣudvāre divākaraḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ sthānaṃ mayā te parikīrtitameteṣāmapi yastvekaṃ paśyet ca bhaktimānnaraḥmānasaṃ vācikañcaiva kāyikaṃ yacca duṣkṛtambhavati mokṣamārgī ca yatrāhaṃ tatra saṃsthitaḥdhyānena ca sthireṇāśu prāpsyate parameśvaridvāviṃśatidhanurmānaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabhampūjayitvā tatra rudraṃ jyotirvyomaphalaṃ labhetuṣitvā tatra deveśi prāpsyate paramaṃ padamdvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ aśvatīrthaṃ kalau yugeyadanyatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthe yāti ca lāghavamdvādaśāhaṃ daśāhaṃ vā māsārdhaṃ māsameva vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahādevaṃ tato devī praṇatā paripṛcchatikathaṃ tat kṣayamāpnoti tanmāmācakṣva śaṅkarasarvatīrtheṣu vikhyātamaśvakrāntamataḥ parametadeva paraṃ jñānametadeva paraṃ tapaḥyathā nārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ puruṣottamaḥdattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ śerṣa tapastaptaṃ kṛtañca yataśvakrānte paro yogo aśvakrānte parā gatiḥmerumandaratulyo'pi rāśiḥ pāpasya sarvaśaḥaśvakrāntaṃ sthitaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pāṃśubhirvāyuneritaiḥna sā gatiḥ kurukṣetre gayādvāre ca puṣkarena dānairna tapobhirna yajñairnāpi ca vidyayābrahmahāpi adhyāgacchedaśvakrāntaṃ kadācanana tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kadācidapi dṛśyatesarvo'pyasya śubhaḥ kāla aśvakrānte varānaneaśvatīrthe tu kākinyāṃ dattāyāṃ labhate'kṣayamphalaṃ varṣasahasrasya labhate matparāyaṇaḥekāhañca vaseccātra tayostulyaṃ [tattulyaṃ] phalaṃ bhavettat phalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ aśvatīrthe kṣaṇe kṣaṇesevanāccaiva madhyāhne aparāhṇe ca śāṅkariaśvakrāntaṃ samāsādya sarvo vrajati saṃkṣayamsarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ brahmalokoparisthitaḥyathā surāṇāṃ sarveṣāmādistu madhusūdanaḥanulomavilomābhyāṃ tathā vyastasamastayoḥtathaivottaramāraṇye tadeva phalamaśnutepañcakālokanādeva naraḥ prāpnoti tat phalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sānnidhyamaśvatīrthe ca muktidvārasamīpataḥtāvat pañcakamṛtastu brahmaloke mahīyatenirdahet pātakaṃ sarvaṃ sakṛt snātvā tu śāṅkariekena janmanā muktiṃ [sa tu] yogānmokṣañca vindatisarvataḥekaikaśo maheśāni [yaḥ karoti] punāti saptamaṃ kulamdhanuraṣṭapramāṇena siddhakuṇḍamihocyatedvijātīnāntu kathitaṃ tīrthānāmiha sevanamenolopī brahmacārī tīrthānāṃ phalamāpnuyātpunīhi sarvapāpebhyastīrthavarya namo'stu tetrayodaśyāṃ snānamātre punātyubhayataḥ kulamcatuṣaṣṭidhanurmānaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmasaraḥ smṛtampāpakartṝnapi pitṛn tārayennātra saṃśayaḥsvayantu brahmaṇā sṛṣṭam īśvarapriyakāmyayāityanena tu mantreṇa snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhidatvā dānañca vidhivad brahmaloke mahīyaterāmakṣetraṃ vijānīyāt tasya kuṇḍaṃ kule priyetīrthebhyaḥ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ varānanetava tīre mahābhāga śrīrāmeṇa mahātmanāityanena tu mantreṇa vaiśākhe kṛṣṇapakṣaketasya pūrve navadhanuḥ sītātīrthaṃ varānanetatra snātvā divaṃ yānti saśarīrā dvijātayaḥsītayā rāmabhadreṇa nirmitaṃ tīrthamuttamammaunī bhūtvā trayodaśyāṃ tatra snātvā mahāphalammucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmaloke vasenmṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatrābhiṣekamātrañca vijayī sarvadā bhavettatra liṅgaṃ maheśasya vijayaṃ nāma viśrutamuṣitvā tatra deveśi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥsarvapāpaharaṃ śambhornivāsaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥīpsitān labhate kāmān rudrasya dayito bhavetvakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa snātvārghyaṃ vinivedayetyogakuṇḍa mahābhāga māṃ punātvamarārcitatatrāpi [tasyāti] snātvā vidhivat santarpya pitṛdevatāḥsnātvā kaulena bījena tattvenārghyaṃ nivedayettithihastamitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ devagandharvasevitamindraśailasya yāme tu dhanurdvādaśamanataḥadṛśyamūrtirbhagavān saptāśvarathavāhanaḥ [tatra saptaratheritaḥ]yadā haraśca [mahāharaśca] niratanivāsaṃ kṛtavānihabhānubījena snātvā tu arghyaṃ tāreṇa dāpayetdurgakūpadvayaṃ tatra brahmayūpaśca tiṣṭhatimantrāṇāmayutaṃ japanpitṛṃśca tārayettena brahmaloke mahīyateyasya mitrasya yadvittaṃ śodhayet pūrvajanmanimaṇīśvaraṃ tataḥ paśyennirayācca pramucyateindrakūṭasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā maṇināthaṃ sa vāyunācarame lomatīrthasya dhanuḥ pañcapramāṇataḥnāgakuṇḍe hi vaikuṇṭhaḥ snātvā nāgān samarcayet [samāhvayet]snānaṃ kurvanti ye martyā bhaktyā śrāvaṇapañcamīmśrādhaṃ pitṛṇāṃ ye tatra kariṣyanti narā bhuvicandrāduttarataḥ śailaścatuḥṣaṣṭipramāṇataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gayāśīrṣaṃ pūrvabhāge dhanurdvāviṃśamānataḥgayātīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ pitṝṇāñcātivallabhamyātrābhede dadet piṇḍaṃ gayāyāñca sakṛtpriyegāyanti pitaro gītaṃ kīrtayanti maharṣayaḥeṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥtasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇastu viśeṣataḥdhanyāstu khalu te martyā gayāyāṃ piṇḍadāyinaḥpāyasena catilapiṇyākakairdeyaṃ bhaktimadbhirnaraiḥ sadāmūṣikagṛdhrakākāśca nānudṛśyaṃ caranti tekartuṃ tatra prayatnena bhuktirevāca kāraṇamāyuḥ putrān dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ kāmānanyān prayacchatiakālepyathavā kāle gayāśrāddhaṃ sadā naraiḥpiṇḍadānañca tenāptaṃ pitṛṇāñcāti vallabhamāśayā parayā bhaktyā āśāmeṣāṃ prapūrayetacchinnā santatisteṣāṃ sadākālaṃ bhaviṣyatipitaraścaiva karhicittaiḥ satvaraṃ tattat kāryaṃ dvijaiḥ pitṛparāyaṇaiḥviṣuve tu tathā vāpi janmanakṣatrapīḍanekṛte śrāddhe nave puṃsāṃ pīḍā bhavati dehajāśatrurājabhayaṃ tathā]labhate nātra sandehaḥ prajāpativaro yathāmātṛmukhyaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ pitṛmukhyantu anyataḥpātayet kṣīradhārāśca ārohet somaparvatamkuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gṛhaṃ gatvā samabhyarcya gṛhadevīṃ yathāvidhiyuñjīta brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ dakṣiṇāmupapātayetdaśāśvamedhikaścaiva tathā viṣṇupadeṣu capunarākarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śāpaḥ patati mūrdhaniāgastye viraje caiva pātayecca dinatrayamsomaśailasya aiśānyāṃ dṛṣṭimātrāntare priyemaṇīśvarasya aiśānye kiñcit pūrvādigocaredvāviṃśad dhanurāyāmaṃ sarvadevaiśca saṃyutamkaratoyā divyanadī lohityo ghargharastataḥdṛṣadvatī devikā ca tathā carmaṇvatī nadīkāverī yamunā caiva ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥudadhirgahvaraścaiva kṣīrodaśca tathā payaḥhradāśca saritaścaiva tīrthāni vividhāni cavaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ samāyānti sumadhyamejaganmāye jagadbīje jagatpāpapraṇāśiniityanena tu mantreṇa anyenārghyaṃ nivedayetdvāviṃśatidhanurmānaṃ kuṇḍaṃ maṇikarṇikāhvayamsatyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyameva suniścitamyugādiṣu ca saṅkrāntau uparāge maheśvarimaṇikarṇe suraśreṣṭhe maṇīśvari maṇipriyemantreṇānena snātvā tu praṇipatya prapūjayet [visarjayet]nīraṃ nīraṃ vahantīva pāpaughāni punīhi mām[prārthayenmantramuccaran]kalāhastadvayāṃśena siddhakṣetramihocyatemantro'yaṃ devadevasya ṛṣigargairudāhṛta [ṛṣi gargaṃ-]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chando'nuṣṭup bhavo [rudro] deva iṣṭārthe viniyojayetparamaṃ mṛgasthamsaṃjñam] paścāddevaṃ vāmanaṃ kālasaṃjñamsvairmantraiḥ svīyakalpoditaiścaaiśānyāṃ maṅgalā devi etanmadhyatamaṃ priyedakṣavaktre ca kāmeśīṃ hayagrīvantu paścimepūrvavaktre ca virajā uttare kauśalodbhavamramaṇāyāḥ samudbhūtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pañcaśataṃ śatambhūmyantarasthaṃ lakṣañca sārdhalakṣaṃ jale priyebhūmipīṭhe saptalakṣaṃ vṛkṣamūle tu lakṣakamsandhyā sandhyāṃśake caiva kuṇḍaṃ lauhityapāvanamtryaṃśe sandhyāṃśake caiva yadā śūdro bhavennṛpaḥante naiva śākeśvarī sphuṭitā madhyameṃ'śakebhūśāke mādhavo vyaktaḥ sudhāṃśe virajā priyevāyavye mānaśailasya varāho nāma parvataḥtasya pūrvadakṣiṇe ca naranārāyaṇaṃ saraḥtasya paścimatīre ca liṅgaṃ someśvaraṃ param [haram]sevanāt kṛtapiṇḍānāṃ pāpajit kāmadaṃ nṛṇāmsa śatadhanurāyāmaṃ prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamamtīrthaṃ bindusaraḥ puṇyaṃ snānāt pātakanāśanambhūliṅge ca bhavet koṭījyāmutra ca sarasvatīnāṭakācalapūrve tu mataṅgo nāma parvataḥantargṛhamṛtā ye ca yānti brahma sanātanammaṇiśaile sthitā ye ca ye mṛtāste'punarbhavāḥaśvatīrthendramadhye tu brahmāvadhirudāhṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āṣāḍhe varṣaṇe viṣṇoryadā matsyodaraṃ bhavetśatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ snānānnaśyati niścitamkārtike dṛśyate kiñcit phalaṃ daśaguṇottarambhasmācalaṃ sthiraṃ kṛtvā samīkṣet kāmamuccarantat kṣetrasyottare bhāge dhanurarkapramāṇataḥmāghe māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāñca samāhitaḥdinakṣaye ca grahaṇe na snāyāddhi kadācanatāraṃ śravaṇaśūnyañca vārāhaṃ sa śikhī sthitaḥpṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudrasarāṃsi camantreṇa vidhivat snātvā uttarāśāmukhena tupūrvāśāmajjanaṃ kṛtvā mahālakṣmīḥ sthirāyate [vimucyate (?)]ṛṣayaḥ siddhagandharvāstīrthāni ca sarāṃsi cabhṛgvantaṃ gaganaṃ devi bhṛguḥ svargāntiko manuḥravivāśareraktāṃśo viṃśasambhūta mahāpātakanāśanatat pūrve tu pañcadhanuḥ kāmākhyaṃ nāma vai saraḥdhātrīphalaṃ mukhe kṛtvā yastu snānaṃ samācaretcaitre sitatrayodaśyāṃ snātvā rājyañca vindatisaṃskṛtaḥsūryatīrthe cārghyadānaṃ yaḥ karoti varāṅganedvādaśakṛttathāṣṭau vā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhetsnātvā ravyudaye kāle kuṣṭhī pāpādvimucyatetatrābhyarcyārghyadānena sā nārī puṣpitā bhavetsapta janmani dāridryaṃ mṛte sā [tadabhijāyate] cābhijāyatekaravīreṇa vārkeṇa tathā dhātrīphalena ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhāve karavīrasya patrāṇyapi nivedayettathā raktatayā devi śastaṃ bhāskarapūjaneekañca karavīrañca raktapadmasahasrakamtasmāt sarvaprayatnena karavīreṇa pūjayetuccaret karavīreti na tathā koṭijāpyataḥsaṃvatsarasya madhye tu vāraikaṃ saptamīvratamaparāhṇaṃ paraṃ kālaṃ pareśāni [vijānīhi vratasya ca] vijānīhidvipakvaṃ varjayed yasmād ghṛtañcaiva kalāpakamamlañcaiva tathā tiktaṃ dūṣitañca na bhakṣayetmadanasya dakṣabhāge dhanuḥ paṃktipramāṇataḥgaṅgātīre naraḥ snātvā pitṝn devāṃśca tarpayetviṣṇupādarajaḥsambhūte gaṅge tripathagāminitulāyāṃ makare caiva śuklāṣṭamyāñca bhāminitasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥyaḥ śrutvā majjayenmartyaḥ sarvajñatvamavāpnuyātkāmākhyāyāśca krīḍārthamāgastyaṃ kuṇḍamuttamamdevadānavavidyādhṛgvanditaṃ [-gandharva-] sarvakāmadamśalyenotpāditaṃ kuṇḍaṃ mahādevyāśca tuṣṭayedaśamyāṃ snānamātreṇa puṣkarasya phalaṃ labhetsahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ viṣuve ca dinakṣayesnānañca varjayeddevi bhāryāhānirbhavedyataḥ [dhruvam]guhyaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāyatra gatvā naraḥ sadyo mucyate sarvapatakaiḥgaṅgādisaritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāḥ sapta eva hiyathā carācaraṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhāsayellaghu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgneye tasya kṣetrasya kiñcit paścimagocarevāsave parame tīrthe snātvābhyarcya ca vāsavamvakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa dharaṇyārghyaṃ [indrāya-] nivedayettatrāmbhasi nimajyātha yathoktaphalado bhavadhanuḥsaptapramāṇena rambhātīrthaṃ maheśvarisahabhartrā mṛtā yā ca jñānānnārī pativratāyāti nāstyatra sandehaḥ śeṣe ca guruvāsarekāmadravi namaste'stu trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarātkṣetrasya paścime bhāge dhanustriṃśat pramāṇataḥmukhasya kṣālanaṃ kṛtvā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vāsnānaṃ kandarpabījena śṛṇu kṣālanamantrakamrūpavānaśvinoryāti rūpaṃ satyena dehi mepitṝṇāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ snānād yāti parāṃ gatimtṛptihetormahābhāga aghorānmāṃ punīhi caagastyasya tu dakṣe ca gatvā snātvā ca tarpya catatra gatvā ca saptamyāṃ pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavetpāvanaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sa māṃ punātu pāpataḥpidhāya tilakaṃ dadyāt kṣetraṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇamtatra devi ṣoḍaśake pitṝn samarcayed budhaḥdakṣiṇādi kramāccātra ekaikairhastakaṃ catuḥgayākūpe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devamumāpatimviṣṇurbrahmā ca rudraśca agastyaśca śatakratuḥcyavanaḥ kaśyapaścaiva pulastyaśca yathākramātatra mātuḥ pṛthak piṇḍamanyatra patinā sahanākasthāśca divaṃ yānti svargasthā mokṣamāpnuyuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ye cāpyakṛtacūḍāśca ye ca garbhādviniḥsṛtāḥbhūmau dattena tṛpyantu tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatimmātā pitāmahī caiva tathaiva prapitāmahīnihatāśca yeagnidagdhāśca ye kecinnāgnidagdhāstathā parepaśuyonigatā ye ca pakṣikīṭasarīsṛpāḥasaṃkhyajanasaṃsthā ye ye nītā yamaśāsanamjātyantarasahasrāṇi bhramanti svena karmaṇāanyeṣāṃ yātanāsthānāṃ pretalokanivāsināmye bāndhavābāndhavā vā ye'nyajanmani bāndhavāḥye ye pitṛkule jātāḥ kule mātustathaiva caye ye kule luptapiṇḍāḥ putradāravivarjitāḥteṣāṃ piṇḍaṃ mayā dattamakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatāmkuladvaye ye mama dāsabhūtā mṛtāstathaivāmṛtasevakāścadevo gadādharastatra praṇipatya pradāpayetmayā gayāṃ samāsādya pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtātvameva sākṣī bhagavānanṛṇo'ham ṛṇatrayātvartulaṃ kārayet piṇḍaṃ kṣīradhārāṃ ca pātayettatra mātṛgayā devi dakṣiṇena sutīrthakamtaṃ praṇamya prayatnena na bhūyo jāyate naraḥdṛṣṭvā maunena viprarṣiḥ pitṝṇāmanugo bhaveturvaśyā dakṣiṇe tīre yā śilā kanakaprabhāupāgamya tu nāmaśaḥsāvitrīñcaiva madhyāhne dṛṣṭvā yajñaphalaṃ labhettatra piṇḍapradānena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mucyate vai ṛṇatrayātmakare vartamāne ca grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥtadbrahmakalpitaṃ sthānaṃ viprā brahmaprakalpitāḥtarpayettu gayāviprān havyakavyavidhānataḥyaḥ karoti mahādānaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ karoti yaḥcatuḥṣaṣṭi dhanurmānaṃ kṣetramāgastyamīritamurvaśī ca tathā sūryaḥ kāmaḥ putraśca vāsavaḥudbandhanamṛtā ye ca galapāśamṛtāśca yenāntyeṣṭirna ca dāhaśca nāśaucaṃ teṣu vidyateamāyāñca samārabhya kuryāccaiva trirātrakamviphalā ca kriyā teṣāṃ careccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratamanyatīrthe [aśvatīrthe] kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gayāyāntu vinaśyatirāmakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ maṇikūṭe vinaśyatinīlaśaile kṛtaṃ pāpamantargehe vinaśyatimaṅgalāyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpam āgastye tu vinaśyatimandare yat kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepe vinaśyati [vajralepo bhaviṣyati]aśvakrānte kṛtaṃ pāpam urvaśyāṃ tadvyapohatidinaṃ nayenmaheśāni rātrau viṣṇuvicintanamtato'nyadivase kālyā [vipra] āgastye snānamācarettatra svāhā maheśāni agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhetjanmajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ hara me parameśvaridevasya pūrvabhāge tu vāpī tiṣṭhati śobhanāāgneye bhasmaśailasya dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥpiśācamocane tīrthe pūjayāmāsa śūlinamvāyavye bhasma kūṭasya dhanurmadanamānataḥ [dhanurvadana-]
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjanīyaṃ prayatnena stotavyaṃ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥtasmin snāto varārohe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohatitasyottare dhanuḥ pañca kapilā nāma vai śivekapilāhnadatīrthe'smin snātvā saṃyatamānasaḥpūrvāśābhimukhenaiva ārohedbhasmakūṭakamārohayāmi śikharaṃ bhasmakūṭaṃ namo'stu tedaśajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyatidhanaṃ putraṃ kalatrañca sarvaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇātvṛṣadhvajasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu devi varānanetadā bhasmācalaṃ gatvā devamabhyarcya yatnataḥgandhādyaiḥ snāpayelliṅgaṃ kamalaiḥ sumanoharaiḥmahātmānaṃ tataḥ kuryānmāsānte pratiparvaṇiprasādena tu mantreṇa rudrapuṣpeṇa pūjayetyaścaturo devadevaḥdhāma dharmaṃ tathā sūkṣmaṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ haramśaktīḥ sampūjayeccaiva rāmādyāḥ proktalakṣaṇāḥpīṭheśāṃśca tathā bāhye pīṭheśāṃścāgrato'rcayetnandīśaṃ mukuṭañcaiva dikpālān pūjayet kramātpraṇamya parameśānam idaṃ stotramudāharethiraṇyakṝtacūḍāya hiraṇyapataye namaḥnamo bālārkavarṇāya jvaladrūpadharāya cabhavāṅgojjhitakeśāya muktakeśāya vai namaḥvarṇāśrameṇa vidhivat pṛthak karmapravartineśvetapiṅgalanetrāya kṛṣṇavaktrekṣaṇāya canamastriśūlahastāya umākāntāya vai namaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasīda pārvatīkānta umānandāya vai namaḥpraṇamya pūjayitvā ca imaṃ mantramudīrayetnirvighnā pātu me siddhiryasmāt pūjā kṛtā'dya mearcayāmyadya deveśa ājñayā te maheśvaram [-ra]devasya paścime bhāge mātaṅgaṃ nāma kṣetrakammātaṅgaṃ pūjayettatra gaṅgādyairbhaktimānnaraḥtatrastho mandiraṃ paśyeddakṣiṇābhimukhena tunamo mandaraśailāya viṣṇurūpāya vedhasevīkṣet sandhyācalaṃ paścādimaṃ mantramudīrayettato'rghyaṃ bhānave dadyāttilavārikuśānvitamādityasya vratāṅge tu arghyadāne viśeṣataḥvicakṣaṇaḥdaśāśvamedhanair-ṛtye dākṣiṇye mama sundaritatrārohaṇamāntreṇa sukṛtañca vinaśyatikaliḥ spṛśati yāṃ dhārāṃ sā dhārā mama vāhinīmandarasya hi caiśānyāṃ dhanuḥṣoḍaśakaṃ mitamgrahāpadoṣajañcaiva pātakaṃ yat kṛtaṃ bahutaddoṣāt pātakaṃ yacca sarvaṃ snānādvinaśyaticakrāṅkitaṃ bhaveddevi nātra kāryā vicāraṇātat phalaṃ prāpya [prāpyate jantuḥ] tejasvī mṛte haripuraṃ vrajettīrtharāja namaste'stu trāhi māṃ bhavabandhanātcakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā vedhasaṃ yastu pūjayetcakratīrthaṃ spṛśan śailaṃ nandanaṃ nāma parvatamjanārdanañca deveśaṃ kalau bauddhasvarūpiṇamkarkaśaṃ pauṇḍravardhañca yā śilācakra udgatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: janārdanasya cihnañca rūpañca parikīrtitamdakṣiṇe gajaśailasya paścime śaubhraliṅgakamevaṃ śatamitaṃ kṣetramasambhavādikaṃ smṛtamtatra piṇdapradānena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥeṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdanakaliśeṣasya [kalāvetasya] pūrve tu dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥtatra piṇḍapradānena na preto jāyate kvacitliṅgaṃ laulaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tiladugdhaiḥ pratarpayetkalidvāparayoḥ sandhau dhanurardhapramāṇataḥbandhanātaṅgāreśañca siddheśaṃ gayādityaṃ gajaṃ tathāgayāgoleśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā snāpayitvā janārdanambrahmalokaṃ prayāntīha puruṣā ekaviṃśatiḥcakratīrthaṃ gamiṣyanti vāramekaṃ dine dinekupādaṣṭaguṇaṃ devi śreṣṭhā mātṛgayā śubhegayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavetpañcakāntaṃ kāmarūpaṃ picchilāntā sarit śubheviraje ca tadhā cāśve karṇivāme ca somakeyatrāgastye mahākṣetre svakaṃ piṇḍaṃ dadettu yaḥsvahaste tu vṛṣotsargaṃ yaḥ karotyaurdhvadaihikampitrośca jīvatoḥ putro na kuryādaurddhvadehikamkṣayakṛṣṇagate putre triputre vā maheśvaridānañcaiva vṛṣotsargaṃ kuryānnaiva daśāhikamekatra maṇḍale kuṇḍe vṛṣotsargaṃ pṛthak caretparagotrakṛte caiva svalpālpaṃ phalamāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pradakṣiṇamkṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ gacchet pratigrahavivarjitāsvargārohaṇasopānaḥ pitṝṇāntu pade padeaśvatīrthe kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ nīlakūṭe ca pañcakeārustye muṇḍanaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ janārdanamviṣuvaddvayeāmaśrāddhe āmamāṃsaṃ pradadyādavicārataḥsāmiṣantu kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yastu bhuṅkte nirāmiṣamdīrghatantumayaṃ kuryād gṛhītvā tatra śāṅkarinirāmiṣaḥ kṛto yena kuryāt śrāddhaṃ nirāmiṣamsadyo nimantrayet śrāddhe karma kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥbrāhmaṇaṃ bhojayed yastu bhuṅkte viṣṭhāñca śāṅkarigaudhaṃ kaurmañca śālvañca śāśakaṃ śaukaraṃ tathāakalau tu gavāṃ māṃsaṃ sārameyañca tattvavitkṛṣṇacchāgasya māṃsena pitṝn yastu pratarpayethīnendriyachāgamāṃsairyastu pitṝn pratarpayetmāhiṣaṃ dvādaśābdena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatīcāmareṇa śataṃ varṣaṃ sāhasraṃ godhayā priyeśālūmāṃsena [vārāheṇa tu] ṣaṇmāsaṃ śāśakena navaiva tuśatābdaṃ [ṣaḍabdaṃ] cāmareṇaiva sthūlamāṃsantu varjayetatisthūlamiti proktaṃ tasmāt tat pūrvasūribhiḥmārgasya vṛhadājasya sthūlasyāpi hi śasyatecaturnakhaṃ vārijātaṃ varjayecca mama priyevarjayet kūrmakaṃ vidvān yadi cakreṇa cihnitammahāśalkaṃ prauṣṭhikañca matsyaṃ ca pārvatīyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bṛhacchalkañca citrañca śrāddhe yatnena yojayetśalkahīnasya madhye tu pradeya kacakadvayamsarpāsyān pīvarāṃścaiva rajanāṃśca vivarjayetsvarṇakaṃ granthivarṇañca śrāddhe yatnena varjayetkṣīramājyaṃ śrāddhe vivarjayettakraṃ ghṛtaṃ vinā kṣīraṃ prayatnena vivarjayetkusumbhaṃ nālikāśākaṃ mālatīkusumaṃ tathāna pradadyāttu gāṅgeyaṃ padyā raktajalodbhavamvinā tilena deveśi vinā gavyena niṣphalamabhāve yajñasūtrasya sūtrayugmaṃ tu vinyasetśāṅkariekajātīyapātre tu dadyādannaṃ samāhitaḥpitṛśeṣantu daive tu punarannaṃ kadācana [na dāpayet]vṛddhau tu kṣālayedannaṃ saṃkrame grahaṇeṣu cayaḥ śrāddhaṃ padmapatre ca karoti sumanoharam [-re]aśvatthasyacchade devi brahmapātre ca śāṅkariraupye daśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ khaḍgapātre śatottarampārvaṇe ca tathā vṛddhau pṛthakjātīṃśca yojayetvarṣādbhavati yo brīhiḥ pretaśrāddhe vivarjayetyajñādau ca tathā śrāddhe dviḥ svinnaṃ parivarjayetsomadhānyaṃ śiśnadhānyaṃ vaṅgāni raktaśālikammādhavañca pradīpañca viṣṇudhānyañca ballabhamdhānyāni śrādhayogyāni vedeṣu ca niyojayetnīvārāṃśca tathā śrāddhe devadhānyaṃ tathā paramtadatra bhakṣaṇādeva pāpaṃ saṃkramate nṛṇām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhakṣaṇe somadhānyasya vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇañcaretrājadhānyaṃ śiśnadhānyaṃ [sisna-] bhakṣaṇād viṣṇulokabhāknārāyaṇaṃ mādhavasya bhogañca mama sundarinimantritaṃ brāhmaṇañca yadi śrāddhe vivarjayetnimantrito yadi gṛhe bhuṅkte vipraḥ kathañcananimantrito vratasthaśca brahmacāryathavā punaḥsadyoghṛtaṃ sadādhānyaṃ māṃsaṃ tailaṃ tathaiva cagayāśrāddhe pretapakṣe tathānumaraṇe priyemuktitīrthaṃ vinā viprā nānugacchet svakaṃ patimkriyā kāryā daśāhena anyatra tu nivārakamparyuṣite śave caiva kṣayakuṣṭhiśave tathābahuputrā sagarbhā ca tathā caiva rajasvalātato'nugamanārthañca ekāhaṃ sthāpayet śavamvideśamaraṇe caivabharturyadvastu vidyatetṛtīyāyāṃ mṛto bhartā caturthyāmapyanu vrajetekatra maraṇe devi piṇḍamekatra nirvapetdampatyoścaiva piṇḍañca vartulaṃ kārayennaraḥna piṇḍena saha kṣīraṃ śuṣkāmraṃ na kadācanadāḍimaṃ bījapūrañca urvārukaphalaṃ tathākaśeruñca yugānañja kapilākṣīrameva cajambūphalañca padmākṣaṃ jīvantīñca nivedayetkuladharmamanujñāya dātavyaṃ mantrapūrvakammantravarjañca vidhivad vahnipākavivarjitaḥśikhareṣu girīndrāṇāṃ puṇyadeśe tu śāṅkarisaṅgrāmeṣu nadīnāñca sāgareṣu ca saptasu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: divyapādapamūleṣu tulasīmadhyageṣu cavirajasyottare tīre lauhityasya ca dakṣiṇepūrveṣu karatoyāyā na deyaṃ śrāddhamucyatepaurṇamāsīṣu śrāddhañca kartavyamakṣagocarenaimittikaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathāvṛddhiśrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ karmākarmādikeṣu cakanyāgate savitari dināni daśa pañca cayo dadāti guḍairmiśrān tilān vā śrāddhakarmaṇikṛttikāsu pitṝnarcya muktimāpnoti mānavaḥmadhāsu ca prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ saubhāgyaṃ phālgunīṣu caapi naḥ pitaro yasya mṛtāḥ śastreṇa cāhaveyadā pañcadaśaśrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ kāmyabhāvataḥdaśamyādikamārabhya pañcamyādikameva caśrāddhaṃ kuryādamāvasyāṃ māsi māsi tadā kvacitnityaśrāddhe tarpaṇe ca surārcā nityapūjaneśrāddhāśaktau pretapakṣe brāhmaṇān bhojayet priyepitrośca jīvatordevi yajñādau śrāddhavāsareabhojite hato yajñaḥ śrāddhañcāpi hataṃ bhavetbrāhmaṇānāṃ bahūnāñca bhojane ca maheśvarigayāṃ gaṅgāṃ tato gatvā kuryāt śrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥtāvat pitṛpurī śūnyā yāvad viṣṇoḥ prabodhanamniśvasya pratigacchanti śāpaṃ datvā suduṣkaramkhaḍgapātreṇa deveśi jīvatpitṛko varjayetkadāpi gayāṃ vrajetevaṃ śāstreṣu niścitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ nāsti na ca pārvaṇamiṣyateśuciṃ deśaṃ viviktañca gomayenopalepayetśamanīyagrahe devi pāpāgāraṃ vivarjayetupaviṣṭeṣu śrāddheṣu kāmabhṛdapi pūjayetpañcaite pitaro ghnanti tasyāṅge hetuvistarambhūyo'pi devasantuṣṭyai tat karyaṃ vā karoti yaḥvaiśvadevasya cārambhe tat śrāddhañca vivarjayetna vidyate śyāmapakṣe tatra snānaṃ vivarjayetcakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpādvimucyatetasya paścimadigbhāge pāṇḍunābho mahāvalībrahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanambrahmakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā siddhiṃ vindati tatkṣaṇātsnānārthaṃ sampradhāvanti tattīrthaṃ devadānavāḥmāhātmyamaṇḍalaṃ [-muttamamaṃ] tasya brahmakuṇḍasya sundarimaṇikāñcanaratnāni yathāvibhavamātmanaḥpacyate narake ghore yāvadindrāścaturdaśatīrtharājasaraḥ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradamviśanti sarvatīrthāni [tāni sarvāṇi] tīrtharāje suniścitamtasmāt [tathā] samastatīrtheṣu śreṣṭho'sau sarvakāmadaḥsnānena tīrtharājasya tathā sarvāghasaṃkṣayaḥadhiṣṭhānaṃ sadā yatra prabhornārāyaṇasya vaitisro navatyaḥ [navatāyutāni] koṭyaśca yatra tīrthāni santi vaiyat kiñcit kriyate puṇyaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavati priyetrijanmanaśca [trijanyajañca] yat pāpaṃ hara lauhitya sarvadāpūjayet parayā bhaktyā mantreṇānena bhāvini
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāsanaṃ hṛdayaṃ vahneḥ priyā dhruvavapuḥ saraḥkulaṃ dhānvantaraṃ yāvad viṣṇukuṇḍamiti śrutamguru cāruśilārūpam agre mañjusamanvitamprāṇasthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yoniśca saritāṃ patiḥsnātvānena varārohe ekādaśyāñca phālgunevṛndārakāhvayaḥ [-samaḥ] śrīmān rūpayauvanagarvitaḥkulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokañca gacchatiekādaśadhanurmānaṃ śivakuṇḍamiti śrutamśivakuṇḍe caturdaśyāṃ māsi māsi mama priyetīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ viṣṇusnānasamudbhavamsnātvā cānena mantreṇa haṃsenārghyaṃ nivedayetpūjayet kamalaiḥ śvetaiḥ karavīraiḥ sitaiḥ śubhaiḥjavāḍhyañca [pūjāḍhyañca] natiḥ paścāduddharet janakādiṣunārado'sya ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā hariḥśvetañca dvibhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ cakraśaṅkhalasatkaramdhyānaṃ kṛtvārcayeddhīmān pātrapūrvāditaḥ kramātbālāñca kamalāñcaiva tathā saṅkarṣaṇādikamlauhitye vidhivat snātvā pāṇḍunātha prapūjayetmanvantaragataṃ sāgraṃ [yāvat] jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥvaiṣṇavampāṇḍunātha namaste'stu namaste mokṣakārakanirmalāmbhodasaṅkāśa [nirmalārkasya] namaste puruṣottamanamaste hemagarbhābha [hemagarbhāya] namaste garuḍadhvajanamaste'ñjanasaṅkāśa namaste bhaktavatsalanamaste vibudhāvāsa namaste vibudhapriya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: namaste vibudhaśreṣṭha namaste kamalodbhavanamaste nīlameghābha namaste tridaśārcitanarasiṃha mahāvīrya trāhi māṃ dīptalocanadevasya nair-ṛte bhāge dhanuḥpañcapramāṇataḥsaṃhitāṃ prajapettatra gītaśāstraśca sañjapetlabhate nātra sandeha ekāvarte sahasrakamdevasya pūrvabhāge tu dhanustāvat pramāṇataḥśrībījena samabhyarcya mālatīkusumairyajetpaurṇamāsyāṃ tulārke tu lakṣmīstasya prasīdatidhanuraṣṭapramāṇañca kolakṣetraṃ vijānīhilolaṃ dṛṣṭvārcayedbhaktyā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchatidhanuryugmapramāṇena tatra snātvā śriyaṃ labhetmantrena snātvā śrītīrthe gatimāpnotyanuttamāmśriyaṃ dehi yaśo dehi pāpaṃ hara namostu tetīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanamdakṣiṇāmūrtimantreṇa snātvā svarge mahīyatedaśajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ hara tīrthaṃ namo'stu tedhanurvedapramāṇañca campakeśaṃ samarcayetmucyate sarvapāpaiśca brahmalokaṃ vrajed yataḥtīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥmanasā saṃsmared yastu puṣkarantu maheśvaritatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥtatra snātvā bhavenmukto brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinamtadābhigamya deveśaṃ purūhūtamaninditamkamalāsya [he puṣkara] mahābhāga namaste ca tripuṣkara
