source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anena snānaṃ kuryāttu anenārghyaṃ nivedayetaṣṭāviṃśaddhanurmānaṃ tīrthaṃ vadarikāśramamgosahasraphalaṃ prāpyaṃ [prāptaṃ] snātvābhyarcya harerdineekena śatakoṭīnāṃ vratasya phalamāpnuyātprāsādena samabhyarcya rudratvamadhigacchatipūjayitvā tatra rudraṃ prasannaṃ parameśvarampūjayitvā namaskuryād gośatānāṃ phalaṃ labhetkumāratīrthe yaḥ snāyād gāṇapatyañca vindatinaramāraṇyakaṃ devi [tīrthaṃ] sarvadevagaṇairvṛtamoṃ oṃ īṃ hūṃ jagadvyāpta pāpaṃ hara kumārakatatra devo mahādevaḥ sthāṇurityabhidhīyatetadvanaṃ campakaṃ nāma siddhabrahmarṣivanditambrahmakūṭasya dhanade śilāpañcakamadhyagamdaśākṣareṇa mantreṇa snātvā kāmānavāpnuyāttrikṛtvā pañcamaṃ vātha kṛṣṇavijayapuṣpakaiḥpūjayitvā paraṃ devaṃ naraḥ śrutidharo bhavetsāpi tadgatimāpnoti śaratkāle viśeṣataḥbilvapatreṇa deveśi śāśvatīṃ siddhimāpnuyātkaulaśca viṣṇuśailaśca śaṅkaraḥ parameśvaraḥnīlaśveto bhūbhāge uttare saṃsthitācalaḥkamalaśca śikhā caiva kapoto marutācalaḥdyumantaḥ kanakaścaiva vāyavyo nīlalohitaḥlohitaḥ kamalaścaiva nair-ṛte nir-ṛtistathāpaścime brahmayūpaśca hayamedho girīśvaraḥādityo vāyukoṇe tu vāyurbhallātakastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aiśānyāṃ maṇḍalaścaiva aśvakrāntaḥ sacandrakaḥtato gacchennīlaśailaṃ madhyāhne parameśvariviṣuve ayane vātha ravisaṃkramaṇe tathāuttare muktikāmastu rājyakāmastu paścimehatarājyo bhaved rājā anyeṣāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥvāyavye cāgninair-ṛtye mahābhayakaraṃ bhavetnāgahārottarīyañca vṛṣabhasthaṃ vicintayetmantreṇārohayet śailam aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhetnīlaścaiva [nīlo hyeṣa] mahābāho dharmakāmārthamokṣadadurgākūpe tu pūrvasyāṃ devamāmnātakeśvaramtasya devasya yāmye tu dhanuraṣṭāntare priyetasya pūrveṇaiva dhanuḥ saṃsthitaśca trivikramaḥtasyāṃśapañcakaṃ yāvad dhanureva pramāṇataḥkrīḍāpuṣkariṇī sā tu kāmākhyāyāḥ sureśvaritasya paścimatīre ca snātvā tatra ca maṇḍalampañcame'nyadine prāpte jale snātvā vidhānataḥpitṝn santārayatyāśu devī loke pramodatenamoṅkārau vaṣaṭ svāhā pāpaṃ hara namo'stu teaiśānye tasya kuṇḍasya lohityo nāma vai saraḥagnau kuṇḍaṃ kālahastaṃ yāmalaṃ nāma vai saraḥnair-ṛte pañcakaṃ hastaṃ saubhāgye parameśvarikolābhyantargataṃ kuṇḍaṃ saubhāgyaparikīrtitamsaubhāgye tāni sarvāṇi mandībhūte divākaretulāviṣuvasaṅkrāntyāṃ yastu snānaṃ samācaretgaṃgāsaro vijānīyāt snātvā viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anantākhyaṃ vijānīyāt kuṇḍaṃ tasyopari priyebhāryām aputraḥ putravān bhavetsnātvā saṃvīkṣayeddevīmagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhetsarvatīrtheṣu deveśi na kuryāt kāmyatarpaṇamvārāṇasīhrade caiva bhārgave merupuṣkarepṛthvīpradakṣiṇe yacca phalaṃ proktaṃ maharṣibhiḥkuṇḍasyāgneyabhāge ca tulādūre vyavasthitamsmareṇa [svareṇa] bhāvayuktena natyantena prapūjayetlakṣmīkānta namaste'stu ananta puruṣottamanamo varadaliṅgāya kamalāya namo namaḥstutvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā tato devīgṛhaṃ vrajetpañcāmṛtena toyena snapayet suśubhairjalaiḥkāmatantraṃ [kāmamantraṃ] kuśītena likheddakṣe mama priyedevyaṅge citrake puṣṭimaṇau khaḍge ca śāṅkariyantre tantre śālagrāme maṇḍalañca visarjayetna gṛhṇāti ca tat pūjāṃ padaṃ [tyaktvā] viṣṇorbrajet purammahāmaṇḍalakaṃ devyāḥ saṃsthitastatra pūjayetaṣṭahastaṃ sapulakaṃ liṅgaṃ lakṣārdhasaṃyutambahumātramitañcaiva prastāre dvādaśāṅgulamurvaśī yamunā dhārā kāverī ca sarasvatīyāti nāstyatra sandeho yo viṣṇuṃ pūjayed hṛdāmāsatrayādhike ṣaṣṭivarṣe śuṣkabalā bhavetśuṣkadhārā bāhye viṇmūtramādiśetbāhye bhavati durbhikṣaṃ tatra kaścinna saṃśayaḥhṛtarājyo bhaved rājā pararāṣṭrasamāgamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karavīraṃ ghṛtānvitamtrimadhvāktena deveśi godhāmāṃsena vā sudhīḥāvartitena kṣīreṇa ājyayuktena homayetanantasya ca pāścātye asirnāma sthitā nadītat paścime ca yā dhārā varuṇā nāma sā nadīsiddheśvaraṃ koṭiliṅgaṃ hemakaṃ muktimaṇḍalampratimāsu calauhitye caiva gaṅgāyāṃ sāgare tīrthasaṅgameyatra kāmaśilā caiva pīṭhaṃ tanmaṇipūrakamśilāyāṃ parva tasyāgre tathā parvatagahvaresampūrṇaphaladāyinīāryāvarte madhyadeśe brahmāvarte tathaiva ca [śrīhaṭṭake]daśaguṇā smṛtātasmāt śataguṇaṃ bhadre maṇikūṭe maheśvaritato daśaguṇā proktā aśvatīrthe jale sthalesarvottamā yathāanyatra viralā devī kāmarūpe gṛhe gṛhesa ceha labhate kāmān paratra śivarūpatāmvāñchitārthaṃ varo labdhvā cirāyurbhavati dhruvam ||]mahāmāyāṃ na gacchet siddhimānasaḥsnānena vīkṣayetspṛśejjātu yuvatiṃ ca viśeṣataḥna vrajet pārvatīgṛhamcaivādīkṣitena canāgajaistilakaṃ kuryān mṛgacarmaṇi saṃviśet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato dīkṣeti deveśi [nāmnā ca khyāyate] kathitā tattvacintakaiḥparamajñānadā yataḥvijñānaphaladā saiva [cādye] dvitīyā [-ye] layakāriṇīsādhārā [ca nirādhārā dīkṣāsiddhividhānataḥ(nirālambā nirādhārā)] sā hi vijñeyā nirādhārā ca muktidāmanovyāpāramātreṇa nirvīryā sammatā [bhavati dhruvam] tathākunakhī śyāvadantaścādhikāṅgaḥ strījitastathāsyāt samayācāravittathāsvapnalabdhañca strīdattaṃ saṃskāreṇaiva śudhyatitataḥ śuddhimavāpnoti anyathā viphalaṃ bhavetraveḥ saṃkrāntidivase yugādyāyāṃ sureśvarimahāpūjādine vāpi śiṣyaśuddhidineṣu vādevīpūjāvidhau yastu manuṣyo bhaktitatparaḥcaitre duḥkhāya dīkṣā syād vaiśākhe sarvasiddhidāśrāvaṇe bahuhāniḥ syād bhādre ca duḥkhadā matāśubhakṛnmārgaśīrṣe ca pauṣe jñānavināśinīgrahaṇe ca mahātīrthe nāsti kālasya niścayaḥkoṅkaṇe ca mataṅge ca tathā kanyāśrameṣu cakartavyaṃ dīkṣitaiḥ śiṣyairguroḥ śāsanamuttamampuraścaraṇacārī syād viśuddhātmā jitendriyaḥprāptamityevamāno'pi guruṇā jñāpitaḥ sadāsayavaṃ cakravākañca krauñcaṃ pārāvataṃ tathāityevaṃ dīkṣitenaiva kartavyaṃ divasaṃ tathātasyāpi pūrvadivasaṃ haviṣyaṃ vā nirāmiṣamcaruṃ śrapitvā bhāgārdhaṃ devatāyai nivedayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhuktvā ca guruṇā sārdhaṃ sarvadīkṣāsvayaṃ vidhiḥmohāndhakāranarake kṛmirbhavati nānyathātasya devaḥ sadā ruṣṭaḥ śāpaṃ dattvā vrajet purampuṣpaprākārasaṅkīrṇe gandhapuṣpādivāsitephalikādau tato mantrī mantraṃ tatra samuddharetyantre samuddharen mantraṃ sambhṛṇaṃ vā prapūritambhūmau tiṣṭhati deveśi janmajanmani mūrkhatāvaṃśe naivollikhed varṇaṃ tasya hānirbhaved dhruvammahālakṣmīpradaścaiva suvarṇasya śalākayātathā agnimaye devi putrapautradhanāgamaḥaṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena daśāṅgulamathāpi vātattadakṣasaṃkhyānāṃ svalpāyuryāti vai dinemāsenāpi phalaṃ vindyādamāne śrīrhatā bhavetdaśāṅgulaṃ tathāṣṭau ca ato hīnaṃ na kārayetsamabhāge maheśāni hastādau rūpabandhanam [bedhakam]prādeśādau bhavedvedhaṃ dvyaṅgule vā samācaretbhāryāhānirbhavedāśu dhanānāṃ vā kṣayo bhavetpustakaṃ kārayet priyeanyavṛkṣatvaci devi tathā ketakipatrakeanyapatre bahudale likhitvā yaḥ samabhyasetbhavet pīḍā vartulaṃ śubhadaṃ bhavetsatye'kṣare sthitaḥ śambhuḥ śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥkṛte yuge pinākī ca kalau lipyakṣare hariḥhariñca [śrīhariṃ] gandhapuṣpādyairvastraiśca sumanoharaiḥbhavedyugasahasrāṇi svargaloke vasecciram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāvadakṣarasaṃkhyānaṃ tāvacca narake vrasetmahābījaṃ vijānīyāt japān muktimavāpnuyātsvayaṃ vadet svarānte ca natiñcaiva hṛdātmikāmādyantavarṇasaṃsthasya ātmajñānavivṛddhayemantrāḥ puṃdevatāḥ proktā vidyā strī devatā smṛtāparameṣṭhī ṛṣicchando gāyatryāḥ samudāhṛtamvidhinā sthāpayeddevīṃ vāriṇā prathamaṃ priyedinadvayāntare devi utthāyāṣṭadināntarepakṣānte caiva māsānte mahāsnānaṃ samācaretvaidikenātha mantreṇa māyayā vā samācaretarghyasnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punaḥ snānaṃ karoti cavāriṇā prathamaṃ snānaṃ kṣīreṇa tadanantaramtilakṣīraṃ dadhitilaṃ madhukṣīreṇa snāpayetgandhodakañca ratnānāmudakaṃ puṣpatoyakamsvarṇaśaṅkhodakañcaiva tāmrādhāramanantarampañcagavyena yo devīṃ tathā dugdhakuśodakaiḥkapilāpañcagavyena tathā kṣīrayutena cakṣīreṇa snapayed yastu śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥghṛtābhyaṅgena devāṃgaghṛtena vidhivat priyebhavārṇavāt samuddhṛtya durgāloke mahīyaterājatena vimānena śivaloke mahīyategaruḍena vimānena viṣṇunā saha modatecandrāṃśunirmalaḥ śrīmān candraloke mahīyatenāgalokaṃ samāsādya krīḍate saha pannagaiḥsauvarṇayānamārūḍho modate vasubhiḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snānakāle prayojyāni devīprītikarāṇi cabhagavatyai naro bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyatesa gacchati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra kāmeśvarī sthitāsnapayedvidhivad bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇupañcāmṛtasya pratyekaṃ phalānāñca śataṃ śatamapāṃ kumbhaśatenaiva tailasyāpi tribhiḥ palaiḥmadhyamantu tadardhena snānaṃ yatra vidhīyateevaṃ yaḥ kārayet snānaṃ naraḥ kaścit kadācanaāyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ saubhāgyaṃ puṣṭireva caevaṃ yastu mahāsnānaṃ karoti bhaktimānnaraḥdaśatolikamānena dravyāṇāñca pṛthak pṛthakaṣṭāṅgulaṃ mukhaṃ tasya ekaviṃśāṅgulodaramsūryaraśmistu lekhikāsarpaṣāṇāṃ catuṣkeṇa raktiketyabhidhīyatetolikā ca catuṣpādaiścatustolaiḥ prasṛtitaḥpalārdhena bhavenmuktirdvimuktī guḍakaṃ matamcandanena sugandhena kārayaṃstilakaṃ [kārayet] sudhīḥmayūrapicchasaṅkāśāṃ snigdhacārusukeśikāmyacca vai lohitaṃ cāsyaṃ suraktakajjalaprabhamkarālaṃ yattu vai vaktraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dakṣiṇagocaramsarvasiddhipradañcaiva sarvārthasya ca sādhakamkauverīnilayaṃ yacca vadanaṃ śyāmalaṃ śivamavyaktaṃ ruciraṃ divyaṃ kuñjikāvadanottamamśuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ sarvaratnasamanvitamsadāraṅgena [vṛṣabhāṃkena] bhṛṅgena nipītaṃ madhusañcayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūryakoṭisahasrāṃśu yadvaktramūrdhvajaṃ priyepara jyotirmukhaṃ bhadre narakeśena cumbitametā maṇḍalasaṃsthāśca devyaḥ śaktisamanvitāḥvaiyāghracarmavasanā sarvasiddhipradā [yathā caiva irodarā] śubhāsunandā locanaprītā vyaktāṣṭādaśalocanāraudrī sarvārthadāyinīnānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇakaṇṭhabhūṣaṇadhāriṇīasthiratnārcitairdivyaiḥ padmakardamanālibhiḥśṛṇu]kapālaṃ pustikā ghaṇṭā muṇḍamālā nivītinīsiṃhāsanordhvasaṃsuptā śavāsanakṛtāśrayānarakeśena saṃśliṣṭā kāmākhyā parameśvarīsvanāmagrahanakṣatraṃ śrīkaṇṭhanyāsapūrvakamdaśadhā yantre saṃsthāpya saṃskṛtya ca yathāvidhipūrvādikramayogena gaṇeśañca gaṇādhipamkrīḍāsaro dakṣiṇe tu mandaraṃ vāmanetrakamnārasiṃhena bījena kṣetreśaṃ paripūjayetgaurīpūtrañja vaṭukaṃ tathā samayaputrakamhaṃsetyanena mantreṇa dhyātvā raktena cārcayetnivṛttiśca kalā paścāt pratiṣṭhā ca kalā tataḥmāyābījena pūrvādi tatra vai hetukādikamvāmavyādikrameṇaiva kālañcaiva karālakamasitāṅgādayaścaiva brāhmyādisiddhisaṃyutāḥṣaṭkoṇāgre ca madanaṃ ratiputrīṃ svapārśvayoḥāsanaṃ pūjayitvā ca uparyuparibhāvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ehyehi parameśāni sānnidhyamiha maṇḍalemahāpadmavanāntasthe kāraṇānandavigrahekāmākṣyāvāhanaṃ kuryāditi mantreṇa śāṅkaripaśūnāṃ pataye caiva sarvānandātmane sadātrinetrāya trikālāya tripurandhāya vai namaḥlohitāya ca dhūmrāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥsūryāya sūryapataye siddhināthāya vai namaḥsarvāśvetā kṛṣṇavarṇā godhikāyā śilā yataḥgayātīrthañca udare uttare parikīrtitamśīrṣapārśve rāmagayā rāmapiṇḍantu dakṣiṇetatra snānaṃ prakurvīta vidhipūrveṇa karmaṇātīrthaṃ pretaśilākhyañca śrāddha svargaṃ nayet pitṝntathākṣayavaṭe śrāddhī brahmalokaṃ nayet pitṝnātmayone maheśāni gayāyāntu tilairvināpaścime vāsudevasya dhanuraṣṭādaśāntareuttare mānase śrāddhī na bhūyo jāyate naraḥdakṣiṇaṃ mānasaṃ taddhi sarvapāpapraṇāśanammahānadyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe brahmalokaṃ nayet pitṝngayāśire piṇḍadānād yathāpucche tathottarekāṅkṣanti pitaraḥ putrān narakād bhayabhīravaḥpaścime kāmanāthasya saptadhanvantare sthitāmṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi devavad bhuvi modatesarvavidyāmavāpnoti rāśīnāmagraṇīrbhavet [vāsīnāṃ]pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā mantreṇānena pūjayetśivādhiṣṭhānarūpāya tintiḍīvṛkṣarūpiṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmahastasya saṃsparśe mālāyā grahaṇe tathāsaṃskuryāt mālikāṃ devi tāmrapātre niveśayetpaścāttenaiva mantreṇa hūṃ siddhyai nama ityutatadānīya spṛśenmālāmantarīkṣeṣu vinyasetgandhacandanakaṃ datvā tathā dūrvākṣatāni caśataṃ sāhasrakañcaiva ayutaṃ niyutaṃ tathāpratimāne cāṣṭahastaṃ sarvaparvaṇi sañjapetmāle māle mahāmāle sarvatraiva svarūpiṇipuṣkarī sakhibījaṃ tvaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmānvitaṃ tathāeṣa pañcākṣaro mantro mālāyāḥ parikīrtitaḥśivaṃ japādau vinyasya japānte tu stutiṃ paṭhetanuloma vilomena mūlamantreṇa pūjayetjaya kāmeśi cāmuṇḍe jaya bhūtāpahāriṇiviśvamūrte śubhe śuddhe virūpākṣi trilocanemahāmāye maheśāni kāmeśvari namo'stu tekarāli vikarāli ca kāmeśvari namo'stu teniśumbhaśumbhamathini kāmeśvari namo'stu tekāmāṃśca dehi me nityaṃ kāmeśvari namo'stu temahiṣāsuravadhe devi kāmeśvari namo'stu tejaya kāmaprade tuṣṭe kāmeśvari namo'stu teaṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ upavāsī narottamaḥsaṃvatsareṇa labhate rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ punaḥsarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchatitrayīmaye devi ca te namāmikare kapāle ca vikalpitāni śubhāśubhānāmapi tāṃ namāmi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśvādhāre mahāmāye kāmeśvari namo'stu tekālagamye pare śānte kāmeśvari namo'stu tepraṇato'smi parāṃ vīrāṃ kāmeśvari namo'stu tesarvataḥ sarvage devi kāmeśvari namo'stu tetathā vigatavastre ca darśanaṃ na tu saṃspṛśetna strīdevīṃ spṛśejjātu taddine darśanaṃ tyajetāśu [evaṃ] jyeṣṭhasitāṣṭamyāṃ kumāro nāvalokayetna rātrau saṃspṛśennārīṃ baliṃ na sparśayet kvacitviprāṇāṃ kṣīrabalayaḥ śālyannaṃ vātha pāyasamdadyāt kṣīrañca dugdhānnaṃ bhaktānnaṃ vā nivedayetrājñāṃ hi paśavaḥ śastā vaiśyānāṃ vrīhayastathānivedayet śoṇatuṇḍaṃ mānuṣaṃ vā lulāyakammeṣañcātha varāhañca godhikāñca nivedayetdaśabhiśchagalaireva kūrma ekaḥ praśasyateśaśakasya sahasrāṇāṃ varāhastu viśiṣyatedve sahasre lulāyasya khaḍgireko viśiṣyatedve sahasre mānuṣasya śoṇatuṇḍaḥ praśasyateśvetagrīvaśatenāpi godhikāpi varaṃ matampaśūnāñcaiva ṣaṇmāsāt parataśca balirbhavetsañjāte gugguluśuddhe śoṇākhyaṃ jambukaṃ tathāmūṣakañca karālañca kṣudramārjārameva caśukaṃ gṛdhrañca kākolaṃ mayūraṃ citrakaṃ tathābṛhatkapotakañcaiva khañjarīṭantathaiva casaṃhate balidānena striyantu na vicārayetśmaśāne mahiṣaṃ dadyāddevakasya ca sannidhau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: antargṛhamṛtānāñca sa yāti brahma śāśvatampatate nātra sandeho jñānadātā sadāśivaḥmahāpātakayukto'pi yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥakāmo vā sakāmo vā prāṇāṃstyajati tatra vaiparadeśārjitaṃ vātha kṛtvā datvā baliṃ nṛpaḥstrījitaṃ vā brahmadviṣaṃ prayatnena na yojayetna nirmālyaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ tāmrapātraṃ tathaiva camodakaṃ kṛśarañcaiva yāmārdhena maheśvariyāvaduṣṇaṃ bhavedannaṃ paramānnaṃ tathaiva camuhūrtaṃ dadhi dugdhañca ājyaṃ yāmena śāṅkarijavā bandhūkamālyañca nirmālya sārdhamāsakemāsārdhena maheśāni tāmbūlaṃ dattamātrataḥkadalī nāgaraṅgañca tathā jambūphalāni caphalaṃ bilvañca dāḍimvaṃ jayantīṃ karkatīṃ tathāna nirmālyañca dāḍimbaṃ tathā bilvaphalaṃ priyekadalaṃ bījapūrañca dugdhaṃ pakvaṃ nivedayetārdrakaṃ lavaṇañcaiva jīvakaṃ pippalīyakamrāmarambhāphalaṃ puṣpaṃ vadanaṃ dhūmratāpitamdhānyaṃ śrāvaṇakaṃ martyo dviḥ svinnañca vivarjayetnivedayenmahādevyai toyaṃ tasya viśeṣataḥbakulasya phalaṃ pakvaṃ padmasya ca phalaṃ tathāśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi puṣpādhyāyaṃ samāsataḥsitaraktaistathā puṣpairnīlapadmasya pāṇḍuraiḥkiṃśukaistagaraiścaiva vakulaiścaiva mandaraiḥmadanaiḥ sindhuvāraiśca durvāṅkurasukomalaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa kāmān prāpya cābhīṣṭān devīloke mahīyatenotsṛjya dadyāt puṣpāṇi vanasthāni kadācanaekaikaṃ kusumaṃ yakṣā rakṣanti daśa vai yataḥtasmādāhṛtya kusumaṃ dadyāddevān pitṝnapiiha kāmānavāpnoti durgāloke mahīyateagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labdhvā sūryaloke mahīyatejyotiṣṭomaphalaṃ prāpya sūryaloke mahīyatevājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti nānyathānīlotpalasahasreṇa yastu mālāṃ prayacchativarṣakoṭisahasrāṇi varṣakoṭiśatāni cavakradhānyodbhavaṃ yacca sūkṣmadhānyodbhavaṃ tathāśastaṃ taṇḍulamakṣuṇṇaṃ saptāṣṭanavasaṃkhyayāaṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ vā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhetkuṅkumena vilipyārghaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhetviliptāṃ pūjayed durgāṃ vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhetkahlāraṃ tulasīñcaiva padmañca śreṣṭhapuṣpakamna duṣyet chinnabhinnañca jātīpuṣpañca śāṅkariśāṅkariśvetāṅgena ca kṛṣṇena vijayena na cārcayetnyāsañca tarpaṇañcaiva homaṃ paṅktyaṣṭakañcaretśuklapakṣe navamyāntu aṣṭamyāṃ parameśvarīm [-ri]sa gacchati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devī vyavasthitāsnātvopavāsaniyamapūjājāgaramārjanaiḥvimānavaramāruhya dhvajamālākulaṃ tathāayane viṣuve caiva ṣaḍaśītimukhe priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tat phalaṃ labhate devi navamyāṃ kārtikasya canavamyāṃ pūjayed yastu tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇutat phalaṃ samavāpnoti nātra kiñcit prapadyate [vicārayet]muktimaṇḍapikaṃ nāma sthānaṃ paramadurlabhamtataḥ kṛtāñjalirmudrāṃ kṛtvā devīṃ prasādayetsaṃsārasāgare magnaṃ trāhi māṃ parameśvaritato'rcayed guruṃ bhaktyā puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥmāhātmyañca mahādevyā gītikāñcāpi kārayetmāsi māsi tathāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥrathe vā śibikāyāṃ vā dṛṣṭvā tatra kadācanamuktimaṇḍapikāṃ nītvā pūjayed yastu śāṅkarīmna kuryād divase yātrāṃ na ca rātrau mahāniśisāyaṃkāle maheśāni sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhetyaścaiva snapayeddevīṃ divase ca na dūṣyatiskandhe devīṃ vahed yastu aśvamedhaṃ pade padeetasminnantare devyāḥ snānārthaṃ parvataṃ tathātasyottare kāmasaro bhānuhastapramāṇataḥkāmakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā yaḥ paśyet kāmamīśvaramcaturbhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ khaṭvāṅgañca varābhayamdakṣiṇāmūrtiyantreṇa pūrayecca prasādayettubhyaṃ kṛpāparāya namo māyāgehe nāśramāyanamo'stute bhīmagaṇānugāya namo'stu nānābhuvanādikartrekanakairbilvapatraiśca raktarudrajaṭairapicaitre māsi trayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ kāmamīśvaramaṣṭamyāñca niśābhāge nayet kāmeśvarīgṛham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasmāt labhate nātra saṃśayaḥyad yat prārthayate tatra tattadeva na saṃśayaḥdhanuraṇṭāntare bhadre yajet koṭīśvarīṃ parāmsarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyatetridhārā dṛśyate tatra madhyadhārā sarasvatīyāmune ca kṛtasnāno mucyate ghorakilviṣātvaruṇāyāṃ kṛtasnāno muktimāpnotyanuttamāmākāśagaṅgā sā devī mahāpātakanāśinīnīlaśailasthite bhadre pāpaṃ me hara jāhnavitasyāḥ kauberadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitaḥsmareṇa pūjayelliṅgaṃ gandhyādyaiḥ pāyasairapirātrau jāgaraṇādatra mucyate sarvapātakātmahāśmaśāne bhagavān krīḍate strīgaṇaiḥ sahaprasādanārthaṃ devasya nityamāyānti cādṛtāḥprāptavān gāṇapatyaṃ hi devānāmapi durlabhamnikṣipya mānuṣāsthīni bhasmībhūya prajāpatiḥdivyalokamavāpnoti bhinnadeho na saṃśayaḥsampūjya tatra deveśaṃ sarvaprītaṃ pitāmahamtryaṃśañca dṛśyate tatra uttarāṅgaṃ haraṃ śrutambhairavo dakṣiṇāṃśaśca tripuretyabhidhīyatevājimedhasya yajñasya labhate phalamuttamammahāvidyāmavāpnoti maṇḍalānnātra saṃśayaḥsarvalokeśvaro yāti jātiśreṣṭho'bhijāyaterajanyāṃ sampradadyāttu kūrmamāṃsaṃ kadācanana spṛśet saptarātrañca śākaṃ vāmahṛdi [kāmeśvari] priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00064 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kūṣmāṇḍaṃ parvatīyañca dūrataḥ parivarjayetekaviṃśatisūtraiśca tathā triguṇitena cakoṣataḥ paṭṭasūtrañca abhāve raktakaṃ nyasetvānaprastho yatiścaiva brahmacārī tathā priyevāmahaste tato dhṛtvā saptabījāntaraṃ priyegṛhadvāre varadāya [samāgamya] tintiḍīkāya vai namaḥkāmeśvarasya pṛṣṭhe tu yāvat siddheśvaraḥ sthitaḥcātra vidhīyateagniṣṭomaśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥpiṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtvā mātṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavetvindhyeśī sā samākhyātā prayajet kamalādināgavāmayutadānena yat phalaṃ [tatra pārvati] labhate priyetasyāḥ pūrvottare deśe iṣukṣepaśatādhikedakṣiṇena ca tasyāgraṃ [tasyāge] kiñciducce ca saṃsthitāaśvatthaṃ nandirūpañca mūle kūrmākṛtiḥ śilāgatipradīpikākāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ sarvāghanāśanamvyāsatīrthe naraḥ snātvā lalitāṃ yo'bhipūjayetviṃśaddhanvantare [sairupacihnitam] prācyāṃ vanadāsasucihnitamtasya mūlasthitā devī uccavāraṇarūpiṇīvṛkṣaṃ tatra sthitaṃ spṛṣṭvā vandhyā garbhadharā bhavetdāḍimasya ca pūrve tu nātidūre pratiṣṭhitampūjayet kāmabījena vijayī jāyate naraḥdevaṃ gadādharaṃ tatra pūjayet kusumādinājalpīśaṃ taṃ mahāliṅgaṃ pūjayettāvaduccaranagniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati mama priye
